chapters.title: Chapter 301: Inner Strength Soaring
paragraphs: Currently, Ding Ling’s power has taken another step forward!
If he were to compete in palm power again.
Ding Ling feels he should surpass Bai Wushuang by half a margin now.
But if Bai Wushuang is indeed Dongfang Bubai, her strongest technique is definitely not the palm technique, but ’Sword Technique’ and ’Needle Technique’.
Bai Wushuang, even with her weakest palm technique clashing with Ding Ling’s strongest palm force, is evenly matched, showing her prowess.
Moreover, the main thing is, Bai Wushuang looks quite young, yet her cultivation is so high, Ding Ling truly doesn’t know how she trains!
’Is Bai Wushuang really Dongfang Bubai?’
Ding Ling is somewhat puzzled and unable to figure it out.
Logically speaking.
Dongfang Bubai is a character from the same era as Ren Woxing, she should be older.
Why does she appear just like a young girl of sixteen?
It’s truly incredible.
Could it be that cultivating the Sunflower Manual to the Transformation Realm can actually ’reverse aging’?!
This matter Ding Ling really can’t understand, so he could only temporarily suppress the complex thoughts in his heart and start concocting medicine to cultivate inner power.
Previously, Tian Boguang had sent someone to take some great medicine to brew.
These great medicines were also taken back by the squad leader of the sub-unit along with the pot.
After all, great medicine is hard to find and rare.
As a renowned escort agency, Fuwei Escort Agency doesn’t have much great medicine in store, and Ding Ling essentially consumed all he could.
Lin Pingzhi also used some concoctions that were less than a hundred years old.
Treating Lin Pingzhi in such a manner.
Ding Ling naturally couldn’t treat Lin Pingzhi poorly.
He decided that once he truly became the World’s Number One, he would teach Lin Pingzhi hand in hand, just like in the Three Kingdoms World.
Once he was invincible, he could naturally calm down and educate others.
If not.
Being benevolent could lead to disastrous consequences, with one mistake, he could be killed by enemies, and by then it would be too late to regret.
The best way is for Ding Ling to quickly advance and achieve the path to become a War God!
At this stage, he could naturally protect his people well.
In the Three Kingdoms World, he acted this way, and in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, he would do the same.
Even if he continued to act wildly.
No matter how his mindset improved.
The distinction between gratitude and resentment.
Is Ding Ling’s principle, and it will not change.
Splash!
Ding Ling immersed his entire body into the medicine barrel.
A huge barrel.
The medicinal power of the great medicine inside has fully permeated, from the outside, the steam is swirling, primordial qi is surging, spiritual mechanism is raging!
Ding Ling’s heart stirred, without any hesitation, he began crazily operating the Breathing Technique.
Sure enough.
Most of these brewed great medicines are over a hundred years, and less than a hundred years old.
The enhancement for the Breathing Technique is nearly zero.
Ding Ling felt somewhat disappointed.
But fortunately, he was already prepared for this.
Without thinking further, he directly operated the inner power heart method of the ’Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill’.
Whosh!
In an instant, surging spiritual mechanism and primordial qi rushed into his body!
With the power of Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill Full Level, these spiritual mechanism and primordial qi were being refined at an incredible speed!
Due to the reason that he also reached Full Level in cultivating the Exorcism Sword Manual.
Ding Ling had already opened several channels in the Eight Extraordinary Meridians, and many other smaller related channels.
After these spiritual mechanism and primordial qi were refined, waves of inner power flowed along these connected channels, starting to grow rapidly.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
It’s uncertain how long had passed.
The full barrel of spiritual mechanism and primordial qi were all refined thoroughly.
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel.
[Inner Power Value +60]
[Inner Power Value: 80]
The previous inner power value was 20.
Now it directly soared to 80.
Ding Ling savored the feeling within himself.
He discovered that some of the channels opened earlier with Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill were already filled with inner power.
As long as he absorbed and refined more spiritual vitality.
The inner power would certainly saturate these channels, by then it would be impossible to quickly advance.
Ding Ling mused:

"The reason I could quickly cultivate inner power before wasn’t due to innate talent or astonishing physique, but because after Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill reached full level, the channels opened had residual inner power scattered everywhere. Once I operated the technique, these scattered inner powers would rapidly gather, causing my power to soar."
’But based on my observations. The scattered inner power value reaching 20 is already the limit. Which is one-fifth of the inner power value increase after reaching full level.’
The specific facts are unknowable.
After all, currently Ding Ling has only two inner power heart methods at full level.
He doesn’t dare to practice the Exorcism Sword Manual.
Once he acquires more inner power heart methods in the future, he could naturally explore to understand the truth in them.

"Today I cultivated Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, inner power soared purely because Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill is at full level, along with the abundance of great medicine and spiritual vitality, and also due to my high physical constitution!"

"Of course. The more crucial factor is that after reaching full level in Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, the related channels were opened, allowing inner power to freely circulate in them, thereby achieving rapid growth."
This is well understood.
Just like in the real world, ’to be rich, build roads first’ is the principle.

If roads are not accessed, unable to communicate with the outside, unable to absorb external ’nutrition’, then naturally can only self-provide, richer places are okay, but poor places are difficult to turn around.
Ding Ling’s bones were not ideal, similar to people from those impoverished places.
But he cheats, forcefully opening various roads, allowing him to rapidly absorb outside nutrition to benefit himself.
Of course.
The prerequisite is that there must be nutrition for him to absorb.
And great medicine is one of those nutrients.
"When the inner power value reaches 100 points. It’s likely that it will be hard to go further."
"Because the limit of endurance for the channels linked with Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill is 100 points."
"Unless I can open more related channels. Unfortunately, there’s no inner power heart method."
The channels opened by Exorcism Sword Manual have nothing to do with Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, so they cannot help increase through channels opened by Exorcism Sword Manual.
"Continue."
Ding Ling did not soak in the medicine bath again this time.
Previously soaking in the medicine bath was to prevent the great medicine brewed by Tian Boguang from going to waste.
Now without soaking, it’s because Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill is at full level, Ding Ling can directly chew and consume to quickly absorb the medicinal power for his own use.
After he finished chewing all the remaining great medicine.
[Inner Power Value +18]
[Inner Power: 98]
At this moment, the inner power in Ding Ling’s Dantian is extremely active.
Ding Ling applied a bit of force, and with a movement of his palm, boom! A mark was imprinted on the table.
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows slightly:
"I just used inner power without any external force, Breathing Technique, or other strengthening, and achieved such an effect. The inner power of this Martial World is indeed extraordinary."
Ding Ling secretly nodded:

"I’ve only opened less than one-third of the channels related to Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, and I’m already so strong. If I open all of them, wouldn’t I advance to the First-class Great Success Realm?"
Ding Ling estimated the 98 inner power value should only be equivalent to a third-class master of the Qingcheng Four Talents’ caliber.

chapters.title: Chapter 302: Qianyuan Heart Method Full Level
paragraphs: This kind of thought is quite normal.
It’s because Ding Ling felt something.
With just this bit of Inner Strength, he couldn’t harm a single hair on him.
If it really were the Inner Strength Value of a First-class Expert, it would definitely not have such an effect.
"It seems that the Inner Strength Value in the Martial World is somewhat greater than the value of the body’s Four-dimensional Attributes."
Ding Ling contemplated:
"A 98 point Inner Strength Value is only comparable to a third-rate expert. How much Inner Strength Value does a First-class Expert need?"
Ding Ling didn’t know.
This requires him to slowly explore.
But the growth of Inner Strength.
Still brought him much joy.
Because he knew that when the Vigorous Qi of the Breathing Technique fused with Inner Strength, it would unleash explosive effects.
Previously, he had only used a mere 20 Inner Strength Value, combined with the Vigorous Qi of the Breathing Technique, to compete with Bai Wushuang’s Palm Force and achieve a stalemate.
And now 98 points of Inner Strength Value combined with the Vigorous Qi of the Breathing Technique would definitely unleash an even more ferocious and explosive effect.
Ding Ling tentatively exerted the Vigorous Qi of the Breathing Technique and all his Inner Strength Value.
Rumble!
A muffled thunder erupted in the void before the Vigorous Qi was even released, with thunderous sounds bursting and dissipating outwards.
Ding Ling was taken aback; he quickly dissipated the Vigorous Qi and was secretly delighted:

"I never thought that the fusion of the Vigorous Qi of the Breathing Technique with Inner Strength would produce chemical reaction-like magical effects. Incredible! It seems that as the Breathing Technique continues to increase and Inner Strength continues to rise in the future, this Vigorous Qi could create earth-shattering effects when unleashed."
Ding Ling was expectant.
He stepped out of the room and glanced at the sky.
It was somewhat dark.
It seemed that quite some time had passed.
Sure enough.

After taking just two steps, he saw Lin Pingzhi waiting at the side. Upon seeing Ding Ling, Lin Pingzhi’s spirits lifted, and his previously tired and slack expression was instantly banished, turning into excitement:
"Master!"
"Hmm. Where is Fei Bin?"
"He’s gone."
Lin Pingzhi appeared a bit dejected, as if he had been humiliated, and the whole person seemed somewhat dejected and disheartened:

"He said he’d come back tomorrow to see Master. If Master continues to refuse guests, it would mean deliberately belittling him, Fei Bin, and showing disrespect to the people from the Mount Songh Sect."
"Heh."

Ding Ling chuckled lightly. He didn’t ask Lin Pingzhi about the specifics, as he could tell that Lin Pingzhi must have been humiliated by Fei Bin. Ding Ling would, of course, settle this score with Fei Bin in time:
"I’ll see him tomorrow. For now, let’s go have a meal together. I can guide you a bit on martial arts where you’re unsure."
"Yes, Master!"
The next day.
Ding Ling sat at the chief seat in the branch hall’s living room.
Sitting to the right in the living room were two people.
One, broad-shouldered and robust, sat unmoving like a mountain, full of smiles, resembling a God of Wealth, was Fei Bin;
The other, slender and gloomy-faced, with a breezy demeanor, was Lu Bai.
They were two of the Thirteen Grand Protectors of Mount Songh, both junior brothers of Zuo Lengchan.
After finishing the tea.
Fei Bin took the initiative to stand up and said:
"Ding Ling, I won’t waste words. I’ll get straight to the point."
He paused, seeing Ding Ling didn’t react at all, and continued:
"We came this time hoping to invite you to join the Mount Songh Sect."
"What’s in it for me?"
Ding Ling asked.
"Hmm?!"

Fei Bin was taken aback. He had expected Ding Ling might refuse, envisioned a big fight, prepared for a cold reception, and even imagined a pleasant collaboration... but he did not expect Ding Ling’s first words to be directly asking for benefits.
This caught him off guard.
But soon after.
He steadied himself and solemnly said:
"The benefits are countless, provided that Ding Ling, you can join us."
"I don’t want anything else. Just bring the Martial Arts Secret Manual from the Mount Songh Sect for me to browse through."
"Oh?"
Fei Bin was skeptical:
"Just browse through it and then return it?"
"Correct."
Ding Ling said boldly:
"As long as you can do it. Everything is negotiable."
"This..."
Fei Bin hesitated for some time and said:
"I can’t make this decision by myself. I need to discuss it thoroughly with my fellow brothers."
"Alright. I await your good news."
Ding Ling smiled mildly and said.
Some time later.
Fei Bin and Lu Bai both left.
They came hurriedly.
They left even quicker.
Lin Pingzhi was somewhat stunned and whispered:
"Master, are we really going to join the Mount Songh Sect?"
"Who’s to say?"
Ding Ling’s eyes were deep, without any ripples:
"When the time comes, you’ll naturally know."
Fei Bin and Lu Bai acted swiftly.
They left in the morning.
And returned in the afternoon.
With them came over a dozen Secret Manuals.
They presented the Secret Manuals and said:
"Ding Ling, this is our heartfelt gesture and our most sincere offer. Are you certain you’ll join the Mount Songh Sect?"
"Once I finish browsing, I will give my reply."
Ding Ling stood with hands behind his back:
"Are you giving the manuals or not? One word."
"We’ll give them."
Fei Bin and Lu Bai exchanged glances, gritted their teeth, and decided to take a gamble.
They didn’t believe that anyone could memorize all these Secret Manuals in such a short time.
No matter how photographic a memory one might have, it couldn’t be that exaggerated.
These are Martial Arts Secret Manuals!
Moreover.

These Martial Arts Secret Manuals, being third-rate and second-rate manuals, are not the Mountain Guardian Secret Technique of the Mount Songh Sect and were initially intended to deceive and placate Ding Ling, so even if Ding Ling memorized them, they wouldn’t lose much.
In their perspective.
Cultivating First-class Secret Manuals for decades only led to progressively slower progress in their skills, and in recent years, it had virtually come to a halt.
Cultivating Second-rate and Third-rate Secret Manuals?
That would be a waste of time!
Even if these Secret Manuals were gifted to them, they wouldn’t cultivate them!
However.
What they didn’t know was.
Ding Ling precisely lacked Martial Arts Secret Manuals, and whether second-rate or third-rate, as long as they were Martial Arts Secret Manuals, he needed them.
He opened the first Secret Manual.
"Qianyuan Heart Method"
The name sounded illustrious.
Just seeing the name made Ding Ling’s spirits lift, and his eyes brighten a lot.
However, upon finishing it.
Ding Ling was utterly disappointed.
This Qianyuan Heart Method turned out to be just a third-rate Inner Power Heart Method Secret Manual, far inferior to the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill.
Even so.
Ding Ling wasn’t discontented, and he gently closed his eyes.
Soon after.
A book materialized on the bookshelf of the library.
"Full Level Qianyuan Heart Method"
"Inner Power Value +10"
In the blink of an eye.
The Heaven and Earth Primordial Qi surged forth, pouring into Ding Ling’s body, opening some minor meridians and a small portion of the occluded meridians in the Eight Extraordinary Meridians.
Ding Ling moved on to the next Secret Manual.
"Wulei Heart Method"
Rustling!
He quickly finished browsing.
Another book materialized on the library’s bookshelf.
"Full Level Wulei Heart Method"
"Inner Power Value +50"
Ding Ling was pleasantly surprised to discover that the Wulei Heart Method was actually a second-rate Inner Power Heart Method.
The Inner Power Value could directly increase by 50.
Along with the previous accumulations.
The Heaven and Earth Primordial Qi, swiftly refined into Inner Power, directly broke through one of the Eight Meridians.
Ding Ling’s breathing suddenly changed.
Becoming increasingly profound and boundless.
He started browsing the third Secret Manual.

This Qianyuan Heart Method turned out to be just a third-rate Inner Power Heart Method Secret Manual, far inferior to the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill.
Even so.
Ding Ling wasn’t discontented, and he gently closed his eyes.
Soon after.
A book materialized on the bookshelf of the library.
"Full Level Qianyuan Heart Method"
"Inner Power Value +10"
In the blink of an eye.
The Heaven and Earth Primordial Qi surged forth, pouring into Ding Ling’s body, opening some minor meridians and a small portion of the occluded meridians in the Eight Extraordinary Meridians.
Ding Ling moved on to the next Secret Manual.
"Wulei Heart Method"
Rustling!
He quickly finished browsing.
Another book materialized on the library’s bookshelf.
"Full Level Wulei Heart Method"
"Inner Power Value +50"
Ding Ling was pleasantly surprised to discover that the Wulei Heart Method was actually a second-rate Inner Power Heart Method.
The Inner Power Value could directly increase by 50.
Along with the previous accumulations.
The Heaven and Earth Primordial Qi, swiftly refined into Inner Power, directly broke through one of the Eight Meridians.
Ding Ling’s breathing suddenly changed.
Becoming increasingly profound and boundless.
He started browsing the third Secret Manual.

chapters.title: Chapter 303: Fei Bin of the Thirteen Grand Protectors Sent Flying with a Single Palm
paragraphs: Not long after.
[Zhang’s Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +10]
In the blink of an eye again.
Endless Primordial Qi surged from the heavens and earth, pouring into Ding Ling’s body.
Ding Ling read books as if flipping through pages, very quickly.
One Secret Manual after another was read by him.
There were Inner Power Heart Methods.
There were Sword Techniques, Saber Techniques, Spear Techniques.
By the time he finished reading the ninth Secret Manual.
Lu Bai and Fei Bin couldn’t hold back any longer and shouted in unison:
"Hold on!"
Ding Ling ignored them.
He continued flipping through the books.
Since he had started, was there any reason to stop?
Moreover, once he understood these were mediocre Heart Methods and Martial Arts, he realized the intent of these two.
They wanted something for nothing!
No.
To be more precise.
When they arrived, Ding Ling, through his Full Level Skills like Observing People Skill, psychology, and acting, realized they were putting on a show.
Pretending to be in a dilemma, acting magnanimously!
Yet they delivered a bunch of ’trash’!
Did they take Ding Ling for a fool? Or a beggar?
That’s also because he had the Divine Skill Automatic Full Level cheat. If other First-class Experts saw these Secret Manuals, they would scoff and despise Lu Bai and Fei Bin.
Because Ding Ling already knew some inside stories about the Martial World.
He knew that to become an Absolute Expert, one must have top-tier Inner Power Heart Methods; otherwise, no matter how hard one tries, it would be in vain!

These secondary and tertiary Secret Manuals would never be practiced by disciples of a Renowned Sect because it would be a waste of time. Even after seventy or eighty years of practice, they might not even defeat a random disciple of a Renowned Sect. What’s the point of practicing then?
Of course, it could be a comfort to oneself, definitely stronger than ordinary people.
But Ding Ling was now a master renowned in the region!
He was the strongman who defeated Tian Boguang!
The Void Shatterer Ding Ling!

Even knowing Ding Ling was a First-class Expert needing the Mount Songh Sect’s top Secret Manuals, Lu Bai and Fei Bin still sent a bunch of secondary and tertiary Secret Manuals to brush him off, to offend him.
Their behavior was utterly disgraceful, evident without further explanation.
However.
Ding Ling didn’t find the Secret Manuals worthless.
To him.
It was like a free gift; why not take it? He was in need of such Secret Manuals.
[Liu’s Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +10]
Another Inner Power Heart Method full level.

This time, it seemed the Eight-direction Primordial Qi was drained, and Ding Ling could sense distant Primordial Qi transforming into streams of light, rushing into the branch’s domicile, soon merging into his body.
Ding Ling’s body trembled slightly.
Another key meridian related to the Eight Extraordinary Meridians was cleared.
These over ten Secret Manuals.
Surprisingly, ten were Inner Power Heart Methods. The key was all these Inner Power Heart Methods were full level for Ding Ling.
The gains were incredibly huge.
Even though it couldn’t directly increase Ding Ling’s Inner Power Value.

But after reaching full level, it helped in clearing blocked meridians, leaving traces of Inner Power here and there, which Ding Ling could later absorb for his use, resulting in rapid cultivation advancement.
"I told you to stop!"
Fei Bin shouted angrily, leaping up, and launching a palm attack towards Ding Ling’s back.
The palm strike came crashing down like the heavens and earth collapsing, with a majestic Palm Power bursting from the palm, instantly stirring up Fengyun, as if a blazing sun leapt out of his hand.
Ding Ling responded with a palm strike without turning his head.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Ding Ling’s palm strike was like lightning, the Heaven-Flipping Palm flew out, seemingly a mountain descending upon the world, with thunderous booming sounds, colliding heavily with Fei Bin’s palm.
Just one strike.

Fei Bin was struck as if by lightning, his whole body seemed hit by a massive hammer directly in the abdomen, causing it to cave in, his back slightly arched, with a groan and scream, unable to block even one move from Ding Ling, and was knocked backward seven or eight meters away, landing heavily on the ground, rolling several times before seemingly dispelling that horrific Vigorous Qi.
"Junior Brother!"
Lu Bai’s face changed drastically, flying out, leaping to Fei Bin’s side, supporting him while angrily glaring at Ding Ling:
"You, Ding! Don’t push people too far!"
Clatter, clatter!
Ding Ling kept flipping through the Secret Manuals, ignoring them.
With another Martial Arts reaching full level, Ding Ling’s aura deepened slightly.
Lu Bai and Fei Bin watched in shock.

When Ding Ling flipped through the first Inner Power Secret Manual, they noticed the Heaven and Earth Primordial Qi acted strangely, but at that time, they didn’t link it to the Martial Arts Secret Manuals they sent.

Because no matter how you think about it, it’s unimaginable! How could someone gain something just by glancing at an Inner Power Heart Method, causing the Heaven and Earth Primordial Qi to rush in actively!
Moreover, they were secondary and tertiary Inner Power Heart Methods, it was downright absurd!
They didn’t believe it.

However, as Ding Ling continued flipping through one Secret Manual after another, causing unusual movements in the Heaven and Earth Primordial Qi, they began to suspect it might really be related to the Secret Manuals they sent.
Involuntarily hesitated with doubt.
Fei Bin immediately demanded Ding Ling to stop looking! He just wanted to study what exactly was going on.
But Ding Ling ignored them.
This made Fei Bin angry!
He had already waited for Ding Ling for an hour yesterday, angered to the point of bursting, and being treated like this today fanned the flames of murder in his heart!
He had always held a ’goodwill’ recruitment thought towards Ding Ling, if not successful then intimidation, threat, or simply eliminating him!
Ding Ling dared to ignore him now!
He immediately turned vicious!
Unfortunately, what shocked him immensely was Ding Ling’s strength, which was simply unimaginable!
A single encounter.
He was almost spatting blood, with faint pains in his inner organs, obviously injured in just one move!
Fei Bin, both shocked and enraged, grew more cautious while his murderous intent inevitably soared uncontrollably.
"Go."
Fei Bin grabbed Lu Bai and turned to leave.
They weren’t opponents.
Staying any longer would be self-humiliation.
Most crucially, Fei Bin realized that the intelligence he gathered was severely inconsistent with reality.
According to the intelligence gathered from various sources.
Ding Ling was just a Great Success-level First-class Expert.
Facing such an expert.
Even if outmatched.
It shouldn’t result in serious injury with just one move.
But the result was far beyond expectations.
If he had known Ding Ling was so fierce and terrifying, he wouldn’t have rashly visited the Fuwei Escort Agency’s branch domicile with just two people to see Ding Ling.
At the minimum, he would have prepared thoroughly before going.
And he would absolutely not have intimidated or threatened.
Unfortunately...
He realized it too late.
He enjoyed acting imperiously and was used to pressuring people with power. Facing Ding Ling, he instinctively used the great influence of the Mount Songh Sect to oppress and tempt Ding Ling.
If Ding Ling didn’t comply, he would become enraged and further resentful!
But upon realizing Ding Ling’s terrifying strength.
He couldn’t help but feel regret and frustration.

chapters.title: Chapter 304: Explosive Power and Speed (11/11)
paragraphs: This has provoked such a formidable enemy for the Mount Songh Sect.
It truly shouldn’t have happened!
Although Fei Bin was filled with regret, the situation was already as it was, and he needed to find a way to make amends:

"No matter how formidable Ding Ling’s martial arts are, he’s still just one man. Our Mount Songh Sect’s influence spans across the great rivers and southern lands. With just a few tactics, isn’t it easy to take his life?"
Although Ding Ling is a Void Shatterer, his strength has not reached the invincible level comparable to an Earth Immortal.
Ding Ling’s battle with Tian Boguang further revealed his actual combat strength to everyone. While very strong, he is not invincible.
Fei Bin, confident with the support of the Mount Songh Sect, was full of self-assurance.
Thinking that upon returning this time,
he must execute lethal measures against Ding Ling immediately. Whether through fire, water, or a large amount of poison, such a scourge as Ding Ling must be annihilated.
Of course, if Ding Ling willingly, like other experts of both the black and white paths, agrees to serve as a dog for the Mount Songh Sect!
Fei Bin would definitely accept him.
With these thoughts,
Fei Bin no longer hesitated, preparing to leave with Lu Bai.
"Leaving so soon?"
Ding Ling had already skimmed through all the martial arts secret manuals at this time.
His power had further elevated.
The inner strength of the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill was flowing even more smoothly.
Many of the meridians just opened by the newly mastered Inner Power Heart Techniques coincided with those of the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, making them usable by its inner strength.
This increased the speed and power with which Ding Ling could unleash his inner strength.
Upon merging with the vigorous qi of the Breathing Technique, its immense power was evident, as seen in the previous palm strike that sent Fei Bin flying, clearly unmatched.
As he activated his inner strength and amplified himself using the Breathing Technique, the full-level Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill was unleashed, whoosh!
Like a gale sweeping through the earth, in the blink of an eye, Ding Ling appeared before Fei Bin and Lu Bai.
After merging with the vigorous qi of the Breathing Technique,
the power not only had explosive effects but also an extraordinary speed.
However, such power could not be stored within the body for long, lest it explode inside, causing severe injury to Ding Ling.
He could only use this special power to burst forward at high speed.
As expected,
once used, it displayed an exceptional effect, allowing Ding Ling to dash out 30 to 40 meters in an instant, like teleportation, now facing opposite Fei Bin and Lu Bai.
When had Fei Bin and Lu Bai ever seen such speed?!
They couldn’t help but be astonished and speechless:
"You, you!"
"For no reason, you attempt to assassinate me, Fei Bin..."
Ding Ling stood with hands behind his back, his garments flowing in the breeze, the demeanor of a Grandmaster clearly evident, awe-inspiring and drawing attention.
His eyes shone with a hidden light, scanning both men, like an Overlord eyeing fallen soldiers, deeply enthralling:
"Do you wish to die?"
Intimidated by Ding Ling’s gaze, Fei Bin involuntarily stepped back, but quickly regained composure, stepping forward again, looking at Ding Ling with both shame and anger:
"I am one of the Thirteen Grand Protectors of the Mount Songh Sect! I personally came to invite you, showing you enough respect. It is you who ignored me."
"So you wanted to assassinate me?"
Ding Ling coldly looked at Fei Bin:
"You struck me once, I returned the favor once. If you can withstand it and not die, consider yourself lucky. If you die, don’t blame me for not showing mercy."
As his voice fell,
not waiting for Lu Bai to intervene,
Ding Ling had already launched a palm strike.
Heaven-Flipping Palm!
Palms spread like a forest, condensed mid-air like a mountain!
With the vigorous qi of the Breathing Technique and inner strength merging, the mountain seemed ready to explode at any moment. A massive, surging force boiled within, as if ready to erupt!
"Ah!"
Seeing this, Fei Bin, caught between fear and anger, roared and used all he had learned in a lifetime:
"Great Songyang Divine Palm!"
Both palms pushed forward, hot air surged within, akin to merging into a midday sun that could suffocate the oncoming vigorous qi.
But against Ding Ling’s Heaven-Flipping Palm, it appeared insignificant, like a lake facing the sea. With just one meeting, boom!
With a loud crash,
accompanied by the ’crack’ of bones fracturing, Fei Bin’s hands seemed to be crushed by a mountain, shattered one by one, all bones fractured and pushed out like limp noodles in an instant.
"Ah!"
Amidst Fei Bin’s screams, his chest was struck by immense force, sent flying seven or eight meters away, rolling on the ground, spinning over ten times before finally stopping.
But at this moment,
he was out of breath, his face ashen, like a dying man.
Lu Bai, both furious and fearful, watched Ding Ling with vigilance.
Wanting to take action,
yet not daring to,
he could only rush to Fei Bin, lifting him up, taking a deep breath, suppressing the murderous rage within:
"Hero Ding, may we leave now?"
"Leave."
Ding Ling coldly regarded Lu Bai:
"If there’s a next time, simply breaking hands won’t suffice.
What kind of figure is Ding Ling?
He’s the All-Purpose King.
With one glance, he saw through the murderous intent of Fei Bin and Lu Bai against him.
He too felt a murderous impulse, but considering the bright daylight, if he were to kill these two at the Fuwei Escort Agency branch, it might bring great calamity to the agency.
Moreover,
he wasn’t ready to fight to the death with the Mount Songh Sect yet.
He only ’slightly punished’ Fei Bin.
Drawing their attention and hostility solely onto himself.
Afterwards,
he would gradually take action against the Mount Songh Sect.
Given they are mortal enemies now,
there’s no need for mercy.
But it’s best carried out in secrecy, lest Shaolin, Wudang, and other righteous factions criticize and besiege him.
Otherwise, becoming the Great Demon hunted by all in Jiuzhou would make Ding Ling’s journey extremely difficult.
Wouldn’t that be too unfair?
This was why he originally intended to kill Fei Bin but held back at the last moment.
As of now,
he wasn’t keen on outright killing a so-called ’righteous’ expert in broad daylight.
If killing was necessary, he’d do it secretly.
After all, the Mount Songh Sect and Shaolin Temple are neighbors, hard to justify they have no ties whatsoever.
What kind of major sect is the Shaolin Temple?
Would it allow the Mount Songh Sect to grow right under its nose?
Ding Ling didn’t believe so.
The world is bustling all for profit, all rivalry is for gain.

Shaolin Temple has many martial monks, and cultivating requires substantial resources like Great Medicine and meat. Without sufficient fame and status, how would Shaolin Temple earn money or acquire Great Medicine?
The decline of the Five Mountains Sword Sect would ultimately benefit only Shaolin Temple.
This mutual rise and fall is an age-old principle.
’Even if I secretly eliminate members of the Mount Songh Sect, and they openly accuse me of murder, as long as there’s no evidence, I can deny it.’
Ding Ling pondered:
"This way, Shaolin Temple, Wudang Sect, and other distinguished sects would have no reason to besiege or slander me."
Ding Ling considered:
"If even after all this they still aim to slander or besiege me, then they shouldn’t blame me for being discourteous."

"This way, Shaolin Temple, Wudang Sect, and other distinguished sects would have no reason to besiege or slander me."
Ding Ling considered:
"If even after all this they still aim to slander or besiege me, then they shouldn’t blame me for being discourteous."

chapters.title: Chapter 305: Qu Feiyan (1/12)
paragraphs: Ding Ling is clear about grudges.
After Lu Bai left with Fei Bin in a fury and full of fear.
Ding Ling immediately instructed Lin Pingzhi to find a way to inform his parents not to conduct business openly, to keep a low profile, lest they be fatally attacked by the Mount Songh Sect.
Lin Pingzhi’s heart trembled, and he immediately went to make arrangements.
He had just witnessed everything himself, and his awe and admiration for Ding Ling increased further!
He truly did not expect that the famed Great Songyang Hand Fei Bin would be so easily defeated under his master’s hand!
Defeated in one move!
And almost killed!
How extraordinary is this?
If only I had such skills as my master...
Just thinking about it made Lin Pingzhi’s heart boil.
Not long after Fei Bin and Lu Bai left.

A graceful shadow suddenly flashed from one side, and Ding Ling instinctively prepared to strike, but upon hearing the words ’Hero Ding Ling,’ his heart jumped, and he quickly redirected his palm towards the ground.
Peng!
A handprint was left on the ground.
The owner of the shadow, charming and adorable, and her posture elegant, involuntarily took a step back, her face slightly pale upon seeing this.
Ding Ling saw it was the young woman from Yanhui Pavilion who had earlier stood up for him, rebuking Linghu Chong, and turned his gaze:
"Next time you come, you need not take the side path, you may use the front door."
The young woman seemed to want to argue but her eyes reddened at the thought of something, seemingly about to cry.
Ding Ling was stunned.
The young woman turned her back, seemingly composing herself, and after a moment, she turned around again with a smile:
"I’m sorry, Hero Ding Ling. I didn’t want it to be like this. Truly, there are too many people coming and going at the front gate of your Fuwei Escort Agency branch. I was afraid of being seen.
I could only climb over the wall, sneaking in to find you."
Saying this.
She seemed a bit embarrassed, shy.
But then suddenly, she raised her head to look at Ding Ling, with a pair of bright eyes radiating brilliant, shiny light:
"I came to find you and happened to see the scene where you shattered Fei Bin’s arms with one palm. It was truly shocking."
She paused for a moment, then said:

"Fei Bin, that villain met his calamity, truly confirming the saying, ’It’s not that there won’t be retribution, it’s just that the time hasn’t come.’ After many evil acts, someone will surely deal with him!"
"What exactly happened?
Ding Ling invited the young woman for tea, letting her sit and talk, and said:
"If you don’t mind, you can tell me about it."

The young woman, being smart and witty, brave and charming, spoke crisply and decisively, which was her initial impression for Ding Ling. Yet now, she appeared so distressed and sad, implying that she must have encountered something extremely troubling, or else she wouldn’t be like this.
Thinking that the young woman was most likely Qu Feiyan.
And recalling the recent major event of the Golden Basin Hand Washing, Ding Ling’s heart skipped a beat, leading him to say:
"Could it be something unexpected happened at Mount Heng Sect Liu Zhengfeng’s Golden Basin Hand Washing ceremony?"
"Hero Ding Ling, did you know?"
The young woman was surprised.
"I was only guessing. Please tell me, don’t hide it from me. If you take me as a friend."
Ding Ling said gently.
He held a favorable impression of the young woman.

Back then, with everyone watching, knowing well that Linghu Chong was a disciple of the Huashan Sect, she dared to stand up against Linghu Chong and showed unreserved favor towards him, calling him Hero Ding Ling repeatedly, which made Ding Ling somewhat embarrassed.
After all, this was the first time someone called him Hero Ding Ling!
It left a deep impression on Ding Ling, naturally understandable.
"Friend?"
The young woman was moved, excited:
"Hero Ding Ling, do you truly regard me as a friend?"
"Yes."
Ding Ling nodded in affirmation.
"I, Qu Feiyan, actually have a friend like Hero Ding Ling!"
The young woman was quite delighted:
"If grandfather knows, he would be very happy indeed."
Speaking of her grandfather.
Qu Feiyan’s eyes reddened slightly, her face showed anxiety.
Ding Ling let her speak slowly.
Qu Feiyan seemed a bit impatient, speaking quickly:
"Yesterday, Ding Mian, Lu Bai, and others from Mount Songh Sect went to the Golden Basin Hand Washing ceremony, spoke disrespectfully to Eunuch Liu, and directly attacked Sister Liu and others.
Poor Sister Liu, at such a youthful age, hadn’t even started truly living, but died tragically at the doorstep!
She became more agitated, more angry as she spoke:
"Mount Songh Sect, despite being a reputable sect! They attacked unarmed women and children! They’re practically beasts."
Ding Ling listened solemnly.
He also did not expect.
He was only in seclusion, cultivating for a period.
And Ding Mian brought people to annihilate Liu Zhengfeng’s entire family.
Ding Ling sighed internally.

Despite many players interfering, Liu Zhengfeng’s family met their fate for being killed, indicating that Liu Zhengfeng surely didn’t believe or didn’t take it seriously, or else they wouldn’t have ended up like this.
Ding Ling was not familiar with Liu Zhengfeng and couldn’t possibly impose himself on others!
He also considered it rash to visit abruptly, coupled with needing time for cultivation and teaching Lin Pingzhi, hence he didn’t go.
In Ding Ling’s view.
With players flooding into The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, aiming for the Achievement Medal and Inner Power Secret Manual, to report Liu Zhengfeng was almost a certainty.
Other players couldn’t resolve it, Ding Ling could only be certain he could resolve it?

Anyway, for something unfamiliar and likely to not be recognized by others, he wouldn’t be too eager. It’s not cold-hearted but inherently, he doesn’t like meddling in other’s affairs, just as in the Three Kingdoms.
The same applies here.
But if he truly sees some corrupt matter that’s easy to resolve, he won’t hesitate.
Ding Ling is quick in seeking justice but won’t partake in foolish actions that would hurt loved ones and please enemies.
Considering this, Ding Ling suppressed his complicated feelings and asked:
"Mount Songh Sect entered this Earth Realm in full force. Could Liu Zhengfeng have been unaware?"
"He knew."
Qu Feiyan’s voice was somewhat trembling but still extremely pleasant, crisp, and melodious:

"Many people either through our means or voluntarily went to persuade Eunuch Liu, but Eunuch Liu didn’t believe that the reputed Mount Songh Sect would commit such vile deeds, instead driving away those who tried to advise him."
Upon hearing this, Ding Ling slightly raised his eyebrows, thinking:
"Liu Zhengfeng is indeed stubborn to the extreme! If I had gone, I might have been rejected as well."
Concerning rejection.
Ding Ling absolutely wouldn’t engage in it!
"Once his entire family was massacred. Eunuch Liu was regretful, remorseful, in despair, and about to draw his sword to kill himself. It was my grandfather who appeared and rescued him..."
Qu Feiyan spoke very quickly.
But her articulation was extremely clear, akin to pearls dropping onto a jade plate, with crisp sounds, she clearly explained the course of events.
Qu Feiyan’s grandfather was indeed the Demon Sect Elder spoken of by the reputed sects, the very Elder Qu Yang of the so-called Sun and Moon Divine Sect!

chapters.title: Chapter 306: Who’s Afraid of Slacking Off? (2/12)
paragraphs: Qu Yang was a cultivated person, who loved music passionately, excelled at playing the zither, and became close friends with Liu Zhengfeng of the righteous sect due to their shared love for music.
Gradually, over time.
Their bond deepened.
Even Qu Feiyan became best friends with Liu Zhengfeng’s daughter.
This matter naturally couldn’t be hidden and was discovered by others.
When Liu Zhengfeng found out, he chose to leave Jianghu, living as a wealthy man, so that his friendship with Qu Yang was no longer a matter for those in Jianghu.
Unfortunately.
He was naive, overestimating the honor of the righteous sect.
Many players even came to warn him, yet Liu Zhengfeng ignored them, viewing players as spreading false rumors, making mountains out of molehills, and deceiving the public!
When disaster actually struck.
Liu Zhengfeng’s regrets came too late.
After Qu Yang rescued Liu Zhengfeng, they fled together.
But due to players currying favor with the Mount Song Sect, their whereabouts were continuously leaked, leaving them with nowhere to hide.
In this regard,
Ding Ling understood well.
Players are driven by interests; they come to this world to learn martial arts. Whoever can teach them Martial Arts Secret Manuals and Inner Power Heart Methods, they will follow and aid.
It was entirely possible to switch allegiance from Liu Zhengfeng to the Mount Song Sect instantly.
Not even considering those players who always sided with the Mount Song Sect from the beginning.
With so many players leaking information,
Qu Yang and Liu Zhengfeng were practically like bones in a grave, constantly threatened with extinction.
In her anxiety, worry, and despair, Qu Feiyan suddenly thought of Ding Ling, who was skilled in martial arts, brimming with Righteous Qi, and fearless of the Huashan Sect’s influence.
She had only met Ding Ling once.
Having no confidence to persuade him to help, she anxiously went to the Escort Agency branch to find Ding Ling, hoping for assistance.
Unexpectedly, she saw Ding Ling delivering a palm strike that almost killed Fei Bin, the Mount Song Sect master known as the Great Songyang Hand.
"...That’s the situation."
Qu Feiyan finished speaking, looking at Ding Ling with hope, fear, anxiety, and embarrassment.
Her expression was complex and changing.
Clearly, her Heart Lake must be turbulent, difficult to calm.
She hoped Ding Ling would agree to help, yet feared rejection. Embarrassed to beg for help after only one encounter, she truly felt ashamed and uneasy, but in this unfamiliar Earth Realm,
The family of Liu Zhengfeng, the ones she knew best, was nearly wiped out.
After much thought.

Ding Ling was the only one who could help her, so she shamelessly asked, but even after speaking, still felt guilty, not daring to face Ding Ling directly, just glanced at him before quickly lowering her head, twisting the hem of her dress, seemingly unaware, her charming, jade-like face growing increasingly confused.
"Alright.
As soon as Ding Ling uttered these two words.
Qu Feiyan felt disheartened, instinctively stood to leave, prepared to rescue people alone.
But Ding Ling’s next sentence, "Lead the way. We go now!" filled her with joy, hardly believing her ears.
She boldly raised her head to look at Ding Ling, her eyes slightly reddened:
"Ding, Hero Ding Ling, you, you..."
"Just call me Ding Ling, hero sounds distant."
Ding Ling smiled slightly, patted Qu Feiyan’s head:
"Let’s go. Don’t waste time, so as not to delay matters."
He was already adversaries with the Mount Song Sect, with no chance of reconciliation, so he took the opportunity to eliminate a batch of them.
Thinking of this, Ding Ling walked to the side, picked up a bow and arrows, stepped into the courtyard, and whistled.
Neighing!
Two Ferghana Horses galloped over.
When they arrived close.
Ding Ling leaped up, landing on a horse’s back, and looked at Qu Feiyan:
"On the horse."
"Oh, oh."

Qu Feiyan, brave and daring, sharp-tongued, seemed flustered facing Ding Ling and responded dazedly, instinctively using Lightweight Body Technique and flew onto the horse Ding Ling rode, reaching out her delicate hand to clasp Ding Ling’s waist.
Ding Ling paused.
His intention was for Qu Feiyan to ride the other Ferghana Horse!
However, since Qu Feiyan was already in this position, he couldn’t ask her to dismount, so he let her lead the way.
Qu Feiyan naturally had no objection.
Clip clop, clip clop!
The Ferghana Horses stepped out of the courtyard, ran through the branch’s front gate, speeding forward in the direction Qu Feiyan pointed.
Regarding the Mount Song Sect people.
Ding Ling originally thought: handle secretly, don’t let the righteous sect discover.
But now the Mount Song Sect openly slaughtered righteous sect people’s families!
Not involving innocents is something many Demon Sect members know.
Would the Mount Song Sect not know?
Yet they did it.
Showing their audacity, arrogance, and recklessness!
In that case.
Ding Ling wouldn’t play coy.
He’ll directly butcher them!
However, to be on the safe side,
Ding Ling still disguised himself en route, also disguising Qu Feiyan, truly getting seen at the time, he’d simply deny being Ding Ling, claim ignorance of the situation.
Although Mount Song Sect wouldn’t believe this, thinking Ding Ling regarded them as fools.
Ding Ling’s action was mere surface work, ensuring Shaolin Temple and Wudang Sect had no excuse to attack him.
He would not admit it.
What could Shaolin Temple do?
As Ding Ling thought:
"If they present all kinds of witnesses and evidence? Useless, I’d say witnesses lied, evidence stolen by a thief. What could they do to me?"
To deal with shameless folk.
Be shameless in return.
Ding Ling was like this in the Three Kingdoms World too.
Facing righteous and kind people, he reciprocated with kindness.
Facing vile and shameless ones, Ding Ling became shamelessly audacious too!
Who fears whom?
Feigning ignorance, competing on the same level, who couldn’t do it?!

"Even if Shaolin Temple decides I’m the culprit, labels me as a demon head, I won’t fear. My aim is to delay time. Given enough time, I’ll become the world’s number one master! If strong enough, suppress the world; who would dare speak a word? I’d beat them till they’re unrecognizable!"
Ding Ling’s habitual approach is to charge ahead.
Not play tricks with anyone!
He possesses this capital and potential, Divine Skill Automatic Full Level Cheat isn’t a joke.
Clip clop, clip clop!
Ding Ling disguised as a rugged, bold warrior with a beard.
Qu Feiyan disguised as a hideous girl with facial moles.
Their facial features remained, ensuring acquaintances could recognize, undoubtedly hard to hide from many.
Ding Ling’s main goal was merely to cover it up, deny throughout, thus not worrying much.
"Right there."
Outside the city.
Galloped swiftly for tens of miles.
Qu Feiyan pointed to a forest’s direction:
"Inside there. My grandpa previously took Eunuch Liu to hide and heal in there. Uncertain if still inside."
"Let’s go check."
Ding Ling dismounted, activated Four Great Breathing Techniques, Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, deployed Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill, pulling Qu Feiyan towards the forest’s direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 307: Elder Qu Yang
paragraphs: Whoosh!
Ding Ling’s Breathing Technique and Inner Strength fused together, creating an explosive effect again, his speed burst forth; in the blink of an eye, he dashed over a hundred meters.
His speed was as fast as lightning!
The fierce wind rushed towards him, and Qu Feiyan couldn’t even open her eyes.

She was shocked, her admiration for Ding Ling deepened further; she never thought Ding Ling’s skills in Martial Arts, Sword Technique, would be outstanding, but his speed was also extraordinarily fast!
Faster than a galloping horse!
This kind of speed is rare to find in the world.
At least, in her understanding, only the renowned Sect Leader Dongfang might possess such speed!
Whoosh, whoosh!

Ding Ling’s burst was temporary, yet his normal speed was exceptionally fast, incomparable to ordinary people. He noticed that Qu Feiyan was slowing down, so he simply tucked her under his arm and continued sprinting.
Qu Feiyan was both shy and anxious; due to the strong wind, she could only squint her eyes, continuously guiding Ding Ling.
She felt shy realising only now that she was a girl, and should mind gender norms.
Her anxiety stemmed from the clanging echoing deep in the woods, making her heart jump to her throat.
She recognised the sound.
The place was where her grandfather and Eunuch Liu were hiding.
She figured it out.
Ding Ling’s keen senses far surpassed hers, naturally hearing it clearly.
Immediately, he operated the Four Great Breathing Techniques, Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, integrating Vigorous Qi and Inner Strength. Boom!
A thunderous rumble echoed past his ears.
With Qu Feiyan under his arm, Ding Ling shot forward like a cannonball, with an explosive noise, whoosh, he soared out a hundred meters, too fast for the eye to discern.
Ding Ling was secretly astonished.

It seems after reading so many Martial Arts Secret Manuals and unlocking more of the Eight Extraordinary Meridians, the operation of Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill was smoother, and due to reaching Full Level, in the process of constantly stimulating Vigorous Qi and Inner Strength fusion.
The Inner Strength scattered throughout the meridians was once again frantically absorbed by the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill.
Ding Ling’s Inner Strength unknowingly increased rapidly.
This was the source of his surprise and astonishment.

Seems like no need for meditation training in the future, as long as enough Eight Extraordinary Meridians are unlocked, the Full Level Cultivation Technique in his walking and movement can naturally absorb the scattered Inner Strength for personal use, thus rapidly increasing his Inner Strength.
"Very good."
Ding Ling was rejoiced within, making a decision.
’Having completely torn faces with the Mount Songh Sect. I must go to Mount Songh, and at that time, quickly scour their Secret Manuals, I expect my power will have another leap forward.’
As Ding Ling thought about this.
Without realizing it, his eyes brightened.
Taking another look.
He discovered he had arrived at a spacious area.
Not far ahead, there was a grassy field blanketed with lush green, at the end of the grass was a dirt slope.
In the slope, there was a ’cave.’
The cave wasn’t big, someone fell over inside, chest motionless, unknown if alive or dead.
Outside the cave, an elegant man was being besieged by several people, his shoulder bleeding, complexion pale, seemingly on the verge of collapse.
"Grandfather."
Qu Feiyan urgently cried upon seeing this.
"Who’s there?!"
The elegant man must be Qu Yang.
And surrounding Qu Yang were several people of varying statures, none of them lacking in imposing presence and extraordinary aura.

Among them, a middle-aged man with three strands of long beard and a cold expression seemed to hear the commotion, quickly glanced sideways, seeing Qu Feiyan and Ding Ling, first stunned, then laughed loudly:
"The Demon Sect brat is here! Originally thought you ran away, I was worried where to find you. Unexpectedly, you delivered yourself here, perfect, we deal with you together!"
He signalled to dozens of Mount Songh Sect disciples standing by.
These disciples were encircling from all directions to prevent Qu Yang and Liu Zhengfeng from escaping, now upon the man’s signal, five or six leapt out, charging towards Ding Ling and Qu Feiyan.
Ding Ling sneered.
No one among this group recognized him.
Very good.
Perfect for action.
Ding Ling took out his big bow, picked up three arrows, bent the bow and nocked the arrows, aiming at the six Mount Songh Sect disciples charging at him.
Double Extremes Arrow!
Tornado Arrow!
Zing, zing!

Under the simultaneous enhancement and amplification of the Four Great Breathing Techniques and Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, the Double Extremes Arrow and Tornado Arrow displayed terrifying power, its arrowhead initially kept ringing, as if it might explode at any moment.
As Ding Ling released the string.
Whoosh, whoosh!

The three arrows burst out with a speed far greater than before, like bullets piercing the clouds and breaking waves, shooting with a sizzling sound through the void, sparks and lightning along the way!
Boom, boom, boom!

In lightning speed beyond a cover-up’s reach, three Mount Songh Sect disciples charging at them were instantly hit by the arrows, with explosive sounds, the arrowheads erupted simultaneously inside their bodies.
The three disciples were pierced through the chest and abdomen on the spot, dying horrifically and without even having a chance to scream.
Ding Ling was secretly shocked.
The power of these arrows exceeded his expectations.
It seems the Vigorous Qi and Inner Strength of the Breathing Technique continue to grow and fuse, enhancing the power accordingly.
Very good!
With renewed energy, Ding Ling plucked three more arrows and shot again.
This time he didn’t use Inner Strength, only amplifying with the Breathing Technique, even so, the three arrows were as fast as wind and lightning, hard to capture with the naked eye.
Only silhouettes of arrows penetrating the air could be seen!
Of the six Mount Songh disciples, three died immediately, and very tragically at that, while two stood stunned in fear, not daring to advance, one promptly turned to flee.
But no matter their actions.
They couldn’t evade the next three arrows.
Whoosh, whoosh!
The piercing sound resonated past their ears.
Taking another look.

The three Mount Songh disciples were already shot dead on the spot, due to the immense force on the arrows, their bodies were propelled and flown more than ten meters away, landing heavily on the ground.
"Hiss!"
The remaining Mount Songh disciples watching all gasped, eyes wide open.
Qu Feiyan was overjoyed.
Qu Yang was invigorated, mustering residual courage, striving to defend.
The Mount Songh Grand Protectors besieging Qu Yang all had their complexion changed, looking at Ding Ling with peculiar eyes, someone finally seemed to recall who Ding Ling was:
"A master of the bow! You are the one who killed Tian Boguang and severely injured Yu Canghai!"
Responding to them were Ding Ling’s three arrows!
Whoosh, whoosh!

All three arrows contained Vigorous Qi from the Breathing Technique and Inner Power Heart Method’s Inner Strength, the arrowheads ringing along the way, seemingly ready to explode at any moment, and as they shot towards the Mount Songh Grand Protectors.
One of the Grand Protectors saw he couldn’t avoid them, couldn’t help but leap out, attempting to block the three arrows with his own strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 308: Ding Ling vs. Mount Songh Sect Tower Hand (4/12)
paragraphs: Clang! Clang! Clang!
The one who attacked was none other than the Nine Bends Sword Zhong Zhen, one of the Thirteen Grand Protectors of the Mount Songh Sect!
He stood tall with a cold face resembling Yama, his eyes glowing with a ghostly light, as if an Asura walking out of hell.

At this moment, his sword danced in his hand, the blade vibrating and ringing, fully unleashing his eerie sword technique. In the void, sword shadows surged endlessly, spinning into whirlwinds that seemed to reflect and counter everything as if forming nine bends and eighteen curves.
Such a sword skill clearly reached the First-class Supreme Realm!

But even with such prowess, when Ding Ling’s arrow blasted towards his sword, boom boom boom! The arrowheads exploded in succession, shattering his Nine Bends Sword into three pieces, catching him unprepared.
He was hit in the chest by the three arrows that followed closely!
Boom boom boom!
The arrowheads exploded.

Zhong Zhen’s physical quality was average, not in armor, only wearing casual clothes. How could he withstand such exploding arrowheads? His chest exploded on the spot, with a miserable cry, he flew backward, crashing into another Grand Protector who rolled sideways on the ground with him.
"Junior brother, junior brother!"

It was a short, plump, with sallow and swollen complexion, middle-aged man in his fifties who was knocked over by Zhong Zhen. He was none other than Le Hou, the Great Yin Yang Hand. A First-class expert among the Thirteen Grand Protectors!
Watching as it took less than two rounds for his junior brother Zhong Zhen to be shot dead by Ding Ling.
Le Hou was both shocked and furious, let out a long howl, drew the treasure sword from his back, pointed it at Ding Ling, and shouted loudly:
"Ding, don’t push people too far!"
"Truly brothers, even their words are the same."
Ding Ling thought of what Lu Bai said, sneered without moving, continued to draw his bow and arrow, aiming at Le Hou and several other First-class experts.
Swoosh swoosh swoosh!
The sound of sharp arrows breaking through the air was unceasing.

With the Four Great Breathing Techniques and Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill amplifying each other, and their vigorous qi melting into the arrowheads, then fully activated by the Double Extremes Arrow and Tornado Arrow.
Making these three arrows as violent as a hurricane from the sky, fiercer than a prehistoric T-Rex, roaring with the most ferocious of anger upon release.
Thump thump thump!
The sound of vibrating strings was continuous.
Qu Feiyan very cleverly handed arrows to Ding Ling on the side.
Ding Ling picked up three arrows at once, each arrow blasting, unstoppable, with terrifying lethal power. A slightest mistake would see a First-class expert instantly shot dead!
Qu Feiyan watched in wild joy, her worship and admiration for Ding Ling rising at a visibly rapid pace, to the point where she was almost completely infatuated!

When she was most desperate, Ding Ling, like a Celestial God, drew with her, killing out, one bow, one arrow after another, causing the experts of the Mount Songh Sect to not dare show their heads, retreating under the sharpness of the arrows, being slain one by one.
"Ah!"
The cries of agony rose one after another.
Within moments, several disciples of the Mount Songh Sect were dead. Often, it’s just one arrow, easily piercing through a person’s abdomen, yet with strength left to kill another immediately.
In just a few breaths, the vibrating strings scared the birds in the forest to scatter entirely.
And the experts of the originally crowded Mount Songh Sect were reduced to only a few First-class experts!
Le Hou’s voice was filled with tremendous anger and murderous intent:
"Ding, if I can escape today, I will tear you to pieces!"
"You cannot escape."
Ding Ling emptied the quiver, threw away the big bow, reached back, clang! The Giant Que Sword unsheathed:
"Let me test your Mount Songh Sect’s sword technique!"
His Breathing Technique’s vigorous qi merged with his inner strength, unfolding the Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightweight Body Technique, swoosh!

His body, like a shooting star, dashed out over tens of meters in an instant, arriving right in front of Le Hou in the blink of an eye. The large sword slashing down towards Le Hou’s head like a rainbow!
"Ah!"

Le Hou was both shocked and furious, both terrified and alert, Ding Ling’s speed was too amazing. Before he even reacted, Ding Ling had already arrived in front of him, this speed was like a Ghost God, how many in the world today could match it?
"Together!"

Le Hou only crossed swords with Ding Ling’s Giant Que Sword for a moment, clang! He seemed to be struck by lightning, his fat body uncontrollably backing up over a dozen steps, still with force remaining, stepping back a few more steps.
He was astonished in his heart, shouted loudly:
"Be careful, this kid has innate divine power! Don’t confront him head-on!
The other Mount Songh Grand Protectors were Tower Hand Ding Mian, Golden Lion Gao Kexin.
One with a fat head and big ears, tall and plump, full of wild arrogance;
The other majestic, towering to the extreme.

Without exception, both were stunned by Ding Ling’s archery, both too busy to kill Qu Yang, only knowing to avoid the sharp arrows to avoid being shot, yet unexpectedly, Ding Ling’s arrowhead turned, targeting other disciples of the Mount Songh Sect,
Making it so that in just mere moments, dozens of elite disciples of the Mount Songh Sect had perished!
This loss was unbearable for the Mount Songh Sect.
Thinking of Zhong Zhen’s death with the Nine Bends Sword.

The duo felt deep pain and anger to the extreme, hearing Le Hou’s shouts, they exchanged glances and then together drew their swords, one stabbing towards Ding Ling’s neck from the left, the other towards his abdomen from the right.
Qu Feiyan’s pupils shrank as she couldn’t help but shout, ’Be careful!’

Ding Ling gave a long laugh, turning the Giant Que Sword in his hand, Sword God Skill, Pine Wind Swordsmanship, Qing Frost Swordsmanship, Moon Shadow Swordsmanship were deployed in succession, in an instant.

But saw in the void, a hundred flowers bloom, the sword flowers blossomed, condensing into frost, into the moon, guarding Ding Ling impenetrably, not even a drop of water could enter, nor needle could pierce, the sword stabs from Ding Mian and Gao Kexin struck on the Giant Que Sword’s blade, only to be met by a huge counter-shock force that numbed their palms.
The two were horrified in their hearts, truly realizing Ding Ling’s fearsome power for the first time.
It’s fine if not confronting him.

Once truly facing him, they felt they were like a stone meeting an egg, a mantis trying to stop a chariot, an ant trying to shake a tree, that sense of powerlessness made them despair as if about to fall into the abyss of hell.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
Ding Ling swiftly counterattacked, the shadow of the Giant Que Sword layered and unfolded, enveloping Gao Kexin, Le Hou, and Ding Mian all at once!
One person facing three.

In a short span, only saw the sword light flickering in the field, blood blossoms occasionally spewing into the air, Ding Mian, Le Hou, and Gao Kexin couldn’t resist, often getting wounded by Ding Ling’s Giant Que Sword.
Qu Yang watched with his heart trembling, filled with admiration.
Thinking:

"Ding Ling didn’t have this kind of power at Yanhui Pavilion before. How long has it been now? How come it feels like his skill has advanced by at least several levels? So profound I can’t even see through it?"

Qu Feiyan was jubilant and encouraging, but so as not to cause Ding Ling trouble, she didn’t seize the chance to run over to see Qu Yang, just stayed in a safe place, looking at Ding Ling with bright eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 309: One Sword Subdues Three Guardians! Qu Feiyan Faints
paragraphs: With her eyes alight, filled with a sparkling glow, Qu Feiyan looked at Ding Ling with a face that was both shy and joyful, perfectly embodying the bashful joy of a maiden.

Qu Yang glanced over, his expression subtly changed, but quickly, as if he had thought of something, his tense face relaxed. He looked at Ding Ling with a scrutinizing, evaluating gaze, and after a moment, seemed to have made a decision, exhaling a long breath as he straightened his back to watch the battle.
Clang!
Clang, clang, clang!
In just a moment, Ding Ling had already reached a point of white-hot intensity in his battle against the three on the field, including Ding Mian.
The more they fought.
The faster Ding Ling’s Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill operated.
The inner strength that lingered in his meridians was rapidly absorbed and drawn for his own use by the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill.
Unbeknownst to him, Ding Ling’s Inner Power Value had broken through 100 and was advancing rapidly.
In just a short while.
All residual inner strength had been completely absorbed.
Ding Ling’s Inner Power Value had astonishingly reached around 140 points!

Previously, after seeing the Inner Power Heart Method Full Level in the branch, he had cleared many meridians, and the small portion of inner strength lingering in the meridians was now fully absorbed by Ding Ling!

A continuous flow of up to 140 points of inner strength, when fused with the Vigorous Qi of the Breathing Technique, produced even greater power! If it were to explode, it could easily inflict serious injury on a First-class Supreme expert!

One must know that Ding Ling’s strength and agility were now vastly different from before, and with the amplification from the Four Great Breathing Techniques, the force he unleashed was even more violently intense!
The vigor and inner strength fused, creating a noticeable chemical reaction effect.
As the sword blade quivered, clusters of sword flowers blossomed and burst in midair. Every collision with the likes of Ding Mian left their palms trembling.
After several exchanges.
They showed signs of struggling to hold on.

Ding Ling, having now completely drained his inner strength, no longer needed to prolong the battle. He immediately flicked his wrist, and the Setting Sun Diagram, formed by the Dawn Swordsmanship, flashed and vanished in the void.
Clang!
With a swish of the sword, accompanied by three crisp sounds of "poof, poof, poof".
Three blood-red lines appeared on the necks of Ding Mian and the others.
Their pupils dilated instantly, and the hands that had been holding swords went limp and powerless, thudding! The swords fell from their hands to the ground, making a thud-thud sound.
They clutched their necks with one hand, pointing at Ding Ling with the other, seemingly wanting to say something, but as they opened their mouths, all that came out was blood.

With faces filled with resentment, hatred, annoyance, and regret, they staggered backward continuously, some collapsing to their knees as if a golden mountain had fallen, others toppling directly to the ground.
[Achievement Medal Earned: Shocking Ding Mian.]
[Note: Ding Mian, as the leader of the Thirteen Grand Protectors, has extremely powerful skills and profound sword techniques, having already stepped into the First-class Supreme Realm!
He is arrogant and wild, accustomed to oppressing others with force, bullying, and persecuting the weak!

Such a demeanor has existed for over a decade, never once failing, and he believes that with the backing of the Mount Songh Sect, his skills, and the collaboration of his senior brothers, there is no obstacle in the world they cannot overcome!
Thus.
Even the sect leaders of the various factions across the world are not taken seriously by them.
As a Void Shatterer yourself, you were initially treated with caution, but once your true strength was found to be comparable to theirs, they no longer took you seriously.
They even decided that if they couldn’t win you over, they’d kill you! This attitude wasn’t the first or second time, they had become accustomed to it.
However, they suffered a major defeat at your hands!
Ding Mian felt shocked, powerless, annoyed, and regretful. If given another chance, he would never underestimate or ignore you!]
[Achievement Medal Earned: Shocking Zhong Zhen.]

[Note: Nine Bends Sword Zhong Zhen’s half-life of glory ended abruptly with you. He didn’t even realize what had happened before he died. In his final moments, he felt a bewildering, terrifying shock! If he had another life, he would never have rashly stepped out to block your arrow!]
[Achievement Medal Earned: Shocking Le Hou.]
[Achievement Medal Earned: Shocking Gao Kexin.]

[Note: As two of the Thirteen Grand Protectors, they were overwhelmingly strong, yet even the three together suffered a tragic defeat at your hands. They both fear and respect you. If they could do it again, they would certainly run as soon as they saw you.]
Four Achievement Medals.
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows slightly.
Previously, defeating Fei Bin did not yield an Achievement Medal.
This shows that Fei Bin was outwardly acquiescent but not sincerely convinced.
Dealing with these Thirteen Grand Protectors, perhaps only by truly killing them and confronting their fear of death and regret for life could their inner arrogance and conceit be shattered!
Thus serving as a deterrent.
Ding Ling thought as much, meanwhile, Qu Feiyan was already running joyfully towards Ding Ling, expressing admiration and gratitude before running to Qu Yang’s side.
Such understanding of etiquette!
Far better than the so-called upright sects!
"Cough, cough."
Qu Yang coughed dryly, spilling threads of blood.
Blood dripped from his mouth.
Qu Feiyan watched, shocked, fearfully stuttering:
"Grandfather, grandfather, are you, are you alright? Don’t scare me."
"Feifei.
Qu Yang sighed heavily:
"Grandfather can’t make it."
"Grandfather."
Qu Feiyan’s eyes turned red, tears immediately falling. She seemed to want to say something, but her heart was overwhelmed by immense sorrow, rendering her speechless.
Drawing closer.
She finally saw that her grandfather’s body was covered in sword wounds, and through the torn clothes at his chest, a visible, purplish-red palm print could be seen!
From head to toe, apart from his face, there was no intact part on Qu Yang.
The sight was appalling.
The more Qu Feiyan looked, the dizzier and more sorrowful she became. Ultimately, unable to withstand it, she collapsed to the ground.
Qu Yang wanted to help her up but realized he could no longer manage.
He should have died in battle long ago.
But Ding Ling’s timely arrival gave him a last chance to ’say his final words’, prompting him to fight on with remaining strength.
Now he had reached the point of being utterly exhausted.
He glanced at Liu Zhengfeng’s body with a look of compassionate sorrow and then unconsciously looked towards Ding Ling.
Only to see Ding Ling had already picked Qu Feiyan up from the ground.
Qu Yang forcibly suppressed the mixed emotions in his heart, looking at Ding Ling with admiration, coughed dryly, and said:
"Are you Ding Ling?"
"Yes."
Holding Qu Feiyan, Ding Ling could not bow properly and said formally:
"Greetings, Elder Qu!"
"No need for such formality with me."
Qu Yang propped himself up with his long sword, supporting his body, taking a breath, fixing his eyes on Ding Ling:
"I’m dying. I have a request before I die."
"Please tell me, Elder."
Ding Ling’s medical skills were exceptionally advanced.
With support from a Full-level People Observation Skill and others.
How could he not see that Qu Yang was on the brink of death?
Even if he intervened, he could only delay it for a little while.

chapters.title: Chapter 310: The Secret Manual of Liu Zhengfeng from the Mount Heng Sect! Final Arrangements
paragraphs: Although this was the case, Ding Ling still did not readily agree to Qu Yang’s request.
Seeing Ding Ling’s prudence, Qu Yang was not angry but rather pleased, and he smiled slightly:
"A young man who’s not arrogant, composed and competent, decisive in his actions, yet extremely gentle toward the little girl."
He praised:
"To behave in such a detailed manner—it’s truly rare."
Saying this, he changed the subject and reached into his robe with some difficulty, pulling out a few secret manuals and handed them to Ding Ling:
"These are my supreme skills and all my lifelong learnings, as well as the musical score ’The Smiling, Proud Wanderer’ that I created together with Liu Zhengfeng. I’m giving them all to you."
"This..."
Ding Ling hesitated:
"I can’t accept without earning it."
He wasn’t being false; he feared that Qu Yang would present him with a condition he couldn’t fulfill.
That’s how he was.
For those who treat him kindly, anything he promised, he’d make sure to deliver!
For the insincere, hostile, or ill-natured, promises mean nothing, and he wouldn’t hold them dear.
He judged people by their words, refusing to be overly pedantic.
He despised Liu Zhengfeng’s pedantry; how could he become a pedant himself?
"Rest assured."
Qu Yang couldn’t hold back, and he laughed heartily:
"Young man at this stage won’t easily accept my benefits, fearing they can’t fulfill the promise to me! Well, well, well!"
He showed a happy expression:
"To meet someone as virtuous and principled like you before I die is rare. Alright, I won’t waste words with you."
He pointed at Qu Feiyan:
"My only concern is my granddaughter Feifei! I hope you’ll help look after her."
He sighed, looked at Qu Feiyan with great compassion, and, with eyes slightly closed, said with difficulty:
"Feifei has relied on me since a young age. After I die, she’ll have nothing left to depend on. Just thinking of her drifting alone in this treacherous, perilous Jianghu twists my heart.
Fortunately, Heaven has opened its eyes.
Allowing me to find someone I can entrust before I die!"
He opened his eyes, looking at Ding Ling with pleas:
"Ding Ling, can you help?"
He handed the manuals to Ding Ling:
"I don’t have much left. This is all I have. I hope you won’t disdain it."
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate any longer, stepping forward and taking Qu Feiyan in one arm while grabbing the manuals with the other.
Seeing Ding Ling truly accept the secret manuals.
Qu Yang felt relieved and joyfully laughed, his voice shaking the heavens.
Clearly experiencing one last burst of energy, nearing his end.
The laughter vibrated Qu Feiyan’s ears.
In a breath’s worth of time.
She whimpered and awoke from Ding Ling’s embrace. Upon awakening, she instinctively mourned ’Grandfather’, then noticed she was in Ding Ling’s arms, blushing involuntarily.
Ding Ling hurriedly put her down.
Qu Feiyan didn’t care for girlish shyness and pounced toward Qu Yang, delicately supporting him, looking up at him with tear-filled eyes, appearing helpless, anxious, and grief-stricken:
"Grandfather."
"Feifei."
Qu Yang reached out to touch Qu Feiyan’s head, smiling:
"I’ve entrusted you to Brother Ding Ling. After Grandpa’s gone, follow him well. Treat him well, like how you treat Grandpa. Understand?"
"Grandfather."
Qu Feiyan involuntarily glanced at Ding Ling, seeing Ding Ling also watching her, a warmth surged through her heart, only for it to be overwhelmed by immense grief.
She looked at Qu Yang, pearl-like tears sliding from the corner of her eyes:
"I don’t want you to die; Feifei can’t be without you."
"We are children of the Jianghu, no need for such hesitation."
Qu Yang’s heart was also saddened, but to keep Qu Feiyan from worrying, he forcibly suppressed it, laughing:
"Who in history has not died? Parting through life and death is indeed the most normal of things."
He fixed his gaze on Qu Feiyan:
"Feifei, remember this. You are my granddaughter, from now on you mustn’t cry easily. Rather bleed than shed tears. You must learn to be strong and courageous!"
Qu Feiyan dutifully wiped her tears, merely nodding, unable to speak.
"Hahaha..."
Qu Yang, heart aching, yet feigning ease, howled to the sky:
"In my life, I’ve been carefree, had friends, confidants, an understanding granddaughter, and met an honorable hero like Ding Ling before dying. I have no regrets."
His words came to an end.
The laughter abruptly stopped.
Suddenly passed away.
Yet his eyes unknowingly closed.
Seemingly rested in peace.
"Grandfather."
Qu Feiyan embraced Qu Yang, crying heartbreakingly.
Those who heard were moved, saddened, and turned away.
Ding Ling’s heart also felt sorrow; he looked up at the Great Sun in the sky, thinking:
"Sorrows and joys, partings and reunions, have always existed. It’s best to have more joy and less sorrow. To accomplish this, I must be strong enough to prevent anyone from hurting me."
Ding Ling’s desire to become strong rose once more.
He thought without achieving immortality,
he couldn’t afford to relax and must advance courageously!
Several hours later.
Ding Ling left with Qu Feiyan.
He had personally erected a monument for Qu Yang and Liu Zhengfeng!

The monument was a stone monument carved with the Giant Que Sword. With the special energy produced from the fusion of the Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi and Inner Strength, combined with the Giant Que Sword, no mountain or stone could withstand it.

The inscription was personally carved by Ding Ling, each stroke like the work of the Calligraphy Saint, exuding an aloof, grand, carefree, and empathetic aura, perfectly matching the music score ’The Smiling, Proud Wanderer’ of the two confidants Liu Zhengfeng and Qu Yang.
Qu Feiyan knelt for a long time before the grave.
Finally, under Ding Ling’s sigh, she obediently followed him away.
Departing, her steps frequently turned back.
Though her eyes were red and swollen, she didn’t cry anymore.
She remembered Qu Yang’s words well.
Better to bleed than to shed tears!
Ding Ling mounted his horse with Qu Feiyan and headed toward the branch office of the Fuwei Escort Agency.
Qu Feiyan sat behind him, tightly hugging his waist, her face pressed against his back.
Ding Ling could clearly hear her occasionally slow and heavy; occasionally fast and lively heartbeat.
At this moment, Qu Feiyan’s feelings were undoubtedly turbulent.
Ding Ling did not disturb her with words.
For some matters.
Especially such significant ones.
Others speaking too much might have adverse effects. If at all, it should be when her emotions have calmed, when she’s perhaps more receptive to advice.
Inside the Escort Agency.
Ding Ling summoned Lin Pingzhi to arrange food and accommodation for Qu Feiyan.
Unexpectedly, Qu Feiyan suddenly looked up at Ding Ling and said crisply:
"Brother Ding, I don’t want to be separated from you. I want to stay with you."
Naturally shifting from ’Hero Ding Ling’ to ’Brother Ding’.
Clearly now, Ding Ling holds a significant place in Qu Feiyan’s heart.
