chapters.title: Chapter 311: Full Level Black Blood Divine Needle Technique
paragraphs: It might not be an exaggeration to say Ding Ling is the only person in the world on whom Qu Feiyan relies and clings.
Such a result may occur.
Besides Ding Ling’s rescues like a Celestial God which deeply impressed her and moved her,
the most crucial aspect was Qu Yang’s approval of Ding Ling and his entrustment!
And Qu Yang’s particular instructions to Qu Feiyan.
Qu Yang instructed Qu Feiyan to treat Ding Ling as she would have treated him.
Qu Feiyan kept this in mind and naturally did not forget.
During this time together, Ding Ling was courteous and respectful, detailed amidst the rough, overbearing yet gentle, allowing Qu Feiyan’s fragile and despairing heart to instantly find a reliance.
This is a kind of instinctive behavior when sinking into darkness, and seeing hope, naturally considers this thread of hope as something to lean on!
To Qu Feiyan,
Ding Ling is that ray of light that shines through her dark world.
Her choice to rely on Ding Ling becomes understandable.
Like a drowning person clutching at a life-saving straw, unwilling to let go.
Qu Feiyan roamed the Jianghu, her only reliance already passed away.
Now one could say she is without reliance, without friends, with Qu Yang’s prior instructions, she thinks to follow Ding Ling closely at all times, which is normal.
Ding Ling understood, after pondering for a moment, he said:
"It’s fine to follow me. You can stay in the room next to mine."
"I want to stay with you."

Qu Feiyan seemed not yet calmed down; her voice was clear like an oriole calling but carried some hoarseness, obviously from crying too hard previously, injuring her voice. Yet, at this moment, her expression was extremely firm:
"I used to sleep with grandfather every day. I want to treat you as good as I treated him. So I want to eat and drink with you every day from now on."
Ding Ling’s eyes twitched twice and said:
"Staying together is fine. We must sleep in separate beds."
"Mm."
Qu Feiyan nodded:
"I used to sleep in separate beds with grandfather too."
"Whew."
Ding Ling discreetly wiped a cold sweat.
Though Qu Feiyan appeared like a girl, she was only thirteen or fourteen years old, still too young; how could Ding Ling possibly entertain any improper thoughts about such a girl?
He indeed has standards.
Currently, he only sees Qu Feiyan as a younger sister.
In the following period of time,
Qu Feiyan stayed close to Ding Ling.
While Ding Ling mentored Lin Pingzhi, she watched from the side, and Ding Ling did not avoid her. Lin Pingzhi even curiously asked if she was his martial sister?
Qu Feiyan immediately shook her head and said no, saying Ding Ling is her Brother Ding.

Lin Pingzhi solemnly turned his thoughts, yet his demeanor inevitably seemed somewhat different, but he dared not ask further, merely after this, he maintained a respectful distance from Qu Feiyan, and did not allow anyone from the escort agency except Ding Ling to get too close.
After mentoring Lin Pingzhi,
Ding Ling took out the Secret Manual given by Qu Yang.
The first secret manual recorded was surprisingly:
"Black Blood Divine Needle Technique"
Ding Ling read line by line, page by page.
Soon, he completed reading the first booklet.
In the library, a book quickly condensed.
In an instant.
[Black Blood Divine Needle Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
This is a High Tier Hidden Weapon Array Skill!
When cultivated to flawless mastery, so long as inner strength is sufficiently profound, even flowers and leaves can be used as hidden weapons.
Ding Ling slightly opened his eyes, flicked his fingers, Bang! The teacup shattered, Ding Ling reached out and caught a fragment, casually flicked it! Whoosh!
Poof!
The fragment flew dozens of meters, entering the nearby wooden post like a flying knife for a full inch!
"Not bad."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
With this hidden weapon technique, Ding Ling has gained another life-saving and attacking skill in Jianghu.

He just now did not use inner strength, merely applying the vigorous Qi from the Four Great Breathing Techniques to activate the Black Blood Divine Needle Technique when shooting, yet the effect was still extremely astonishing.
It is evident this Black Blood Divine Needle Technique can be displayed not only with inner strength but also with the Qi from the Breathing Technique.
"Is this?!"
Qu Feiyan was shocked, hardly believing:
"Just now, Brother Ding, were you refining the Black Blood Divine Needle Technique?!"
"Yes."
"You hadn’t come into contact with it before?!"
"No."
Though Qu Feiyan was still in mourning for Qu Yang’s death, not yet recovered, she was nonetheless astounded by Ding Ling’s unparalleled cultivation speed.
This shows how greatly Ding Ling shocked her!
Ding Ling said little.
He continued flipping through the next secret manual.
"Hundred Transformations and Thousand Illusions Hengshan Cloud Mist Thirteen Techniques"
Ding Ling quickly flipped through it.
Upon finishing,
he closed his eyes slightly.
In the library, a book promptly condensed, engraved with the words Hundred Transformations and Thousand Illusions Hengshan Cloud Mist Thirteen Techniques.
[Hundred Transformations and Thousand Illusions Hengshan Cloud Mist Thirteen Techniques Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
In just the blink of an eye, this Mount Heng Sword Technique reached full level.
Ding Ling used his finger like a sword to rehearse in the void.

In a flash, sword light glittered, as swift as lightning, with cold glints flashing from time to time, transforming into clouds and mist to obscure the space, making this swordsmanship seem dreamlike and fantastical, making it difficult for others to see clearly!
Ding Ling silently praised.
This is an absolutely top-tier sword technique!
If someone could cultivate it to mastery, it would definitely surpass the Gale Blade Technique.
"This is Eunuch Liu’s Supreme Skill!"
Qu Feiyan could not believe:
"Brother Ding, you just got involved with this Supreme Skill, and already cultivated to mastery?!"
"Yes."
"This, this..."
Qu Feiyan, smart and perceptive, guessed some of it, but never imagined it to be reality; she was stunned again, saying:
"Eunuch Liu practiced this swordsmanship for decades, barely reaching the Transformation Realm. Brother Ding, you’ve practiced for how long?!"
She remembered clearly that many disciples from the Mount Heng Sect practiced this swordsmanship.
Unfortunately, their performance was mediocre, indistinguishable from third-rate sword techniques, unable to unleash the essence of this peak-level swordsmanship.
Yet Ding Ling achieved it easily.
Such talent!
It’s simply astonishing to the world!
Qu Feiyan was thus, stunned and breathless for a moment!
"Hehe."
Ding Ling smiled slightly, provided no further explanation, merely proceeded to flip through the third secret manual.
"Cloud-Piercing Step"
This is Qu Yang’s lightweight skill.
Soon finished reading.
[Cloud-Piercing Step Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
Another absolute High Tier top-grade lightweight skill!
Ding Ling was moved.
His foot moved slightly.
It seemed like clouds flashed across the ground, upon looking again, Ding Ling was already stepping on the clouds, seemingly flying continuously, advancing dozens of meters!
He maneuvered and rotated, rapidly moving through the air, Qu Feiyan saw, unable to see Ding Ling’s figure clearly for a moment, only watching illusionary figures swiftly pass by!
Lin Pingzhi also arrived at this moment, and seeing this, he could not help but feel amazed, envious, and shocked.
Observing Qu Feiyan’s expression again.
His heart slightly stirred.

the most crucial aspect was Qu Yang’s approval of Ding Ling and his entrustment!

chapters.title: Chapter 312: Ren and Du Meridians Unlocked (8/12)
paragraphs: Lin Pingzhi pondered:
"Could it be that the Kung Fu my master is practicing is Qu Feiyan’s family supreme skill?"
He caught glimpses within the shadows of the Cloud-Piercing Step that bore resemblance to Qu Feiyan’s stepping technique in motion.
"Could it be that the Cloud-Piercing Step has reached the Great Perfection level and entered the realm of mastery?!"
Qu Feiyan was so shocked she was speechless.

"You must know that even my grandfather took many years to reach perfection in this Cloud-Piercing Step. I haven’t reached perfection yet despite my practice. Brother Ding only looked at it once and achieved perfection?!"
She couldn’t imagine that there could be an extraordinary genius like Ding Ling in this world.
It’s terrifying!
Practically godlike!
Ding Ling continued to read the secret manual.
Next came.
"Profound Yuan Inner Power Heart Technique"
Finished reading.
A book immediately manifested on the library shelf.
And then...
[Profound Yuan Inner Power Heart Technique at Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
In just an instant!
Boom!
The Heaven and Earth Primordial Qi surged in.
In just a moment, it engulfed Ding Ling.
Ding Ling could clearly feel one or two of his meridians within the Eight Extraordinary Meridians being further developed.
This time, it was the Chong Meridian and the critical Ren Meridian that were opened!
"Only the Du Meridian remains unopened."
If the Du Meridian were also opened.
Then all the Eight Meridians within the Eight Extraordinary Meridians would be completely opened.
Once open.
Ding Ling’s Eight Meridians would all be interconnected.
In his cultivation journey, there would be no more obstructions or barriers.
He would transform into a true genius in the practice of inner power.
Many geniuses, even with abundant and profound inner power, cannot open the Ren and Du Meridians! Becoming a true supreme master!

But Ding Ling relied on the divine skill automatic full-level cheats, generating that explosive and powerful ’Qi Force’ while cultivating the Inner Power Heart Technique, brutishly breaking through various blocked meridians!
This is something ordinary people simply cannot achieve.
Because for ordinary people, cultivation is an accumulation over time, advancing step by step. Breaking through shackles depends solely on years of steady accumulation.
But Ding Ling is different!

"As long as the inner power reaches full level in an instant, you can crazily absorb the primordial qi and spiritual mechanism of heaven and earth, then transform them into violent inner power to shatter all sorts of shackles and barriers! Opening up every closed meridian!"
"This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for me."
"Once all meridians are opened, one can imagine that later practice of martial arts will be unimpeded and vice versa."
If the powerful inner power doesn’t open the meridians,
this violent inner power being blocked in the Dantian could result in either exploding the body or severe injury!
The more he practiced the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill,
the deeper and more numerous the Inner Power Heart Techniques he encountered.
Ding Ling felt this increasingly profoundly.
"Therefore, the inner power chooses to first break through blocked meridians to ensure clearance of the ’pathway’!"
Ding Ling understood.
No longer overthinking.
He began to continue flipping to the next secret manual.
"Mount Heng Basic Inner Power Heart Technique."
Read it.
Instantly full level.
Without any anomaly occurring, Ding Ling was initially surprised and puzzled, then after careful reflection, he understood:

"The reason is that my inner power value has already exceeded the 100 baseline value of third-class inner power masters. So now, the third-class inner power full level is ineffective. Just like in the Three Kingdoms World with me.
At a certain stage, the secret manual becomes useless, only to transform into a foundation."
At this moment, the Mount Heng Sect’s basic internal power secret manuals are also the same logic, only transforming into a foundation, enhancing Ding Ling’s accumulation in inner power.
Next book.
"Mount Heng Wind Heart Technique"
Finished reading.
Upon the condensation of the related secret manual in the library.
[Mount Heng Wind Heart Technique at Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
Whoosh whoosh!
Again, the rolling primordial qi surged through.

Rapidly absorbed, refined, transformed into domineering inner power impacting against the barrier of the last Du Meridian, boom! In just a moment, the domineering inner power transformed into a charging army of thousands!
Each one smashed to bone shards, but the blockade line and barrier wavered.
After eighty percent of the ’soldiers and horses’ were smashed, that barrier was finally breached.
The last of the Eight Meridians was opened.
Rumbling!
The surging inner power drilled into the Du Meridian.
From this, forming a perfect cycle.
At that moment.
The aura around Ding Ling changed once more, becoming even more profound, majestic, towering, limitless!
"This kind of aura!!"
Lin Pingzhi and Qu Feiyan’s hearts were overturned, unable to remain calm.
If not seen with their own eyes, who could believe that a person could possess such terrifying accomplishments in cultivating inner power.
As if, just by flipping through, his inner power cultivation reached an extremely profound realm, causing the heaven and earth primordial qi to voluntarily enter his body!
Such phenomena, can only be seen on some legendary deities, right?
How could a mortal create such a miracle?!
Lin Pingzhi, having followed Ding Ling for quite some time now, was in no way ordinary in terms of knowledge and understanding, and knew well that Ding Ling was genuinely a genius, a monster.
But even so, witnessing these scenes now, he couldn’t help but take a sharp breath, marveling silently, thinking:
"Isn’t the cultivation of inner power supposed to be gradual, requiring years of effort day by day to finally succeed? Master, how, how, how did you achieve this?! Incredible!"
Qu Feiyan, at this moment, was too shocked and in disbelief, momentarily seemed to forget her sorrow, staring wide-eyed and slack-jawed at Ding Ling, as if looking up to a Venerable Lord!
"It’s done."
Ding Ling felt joy in his heart.
All the Eight Meridians within the Eight Extraordinary Meridians had been completely opened.
After practicing numerous inner power heart techniques to full level, he finally unlocked everything!
From now on, his cultivation in inner power would advance rapidly!
As long as he has enough resources, he will easily reach a first-class level in inner power.
"First-class inner power!"
Ding Ling was secretly excited, also quite moved in his heart.
He truly did not expect.

Among the secret manuals Qu Yang gave him, not only were there personal inner power heart techniques, formations, lightweight step techniques, but also Liu Zhengfeng’s superior swordsmanship, inner power heart techniques!

He initially thought that the things Liu Zhengfeng gave to Qu Yang must have been some ordinary worldly items or secret techniques from other sects he collected unexpectedly; they turned out to be the Mount Heng Sect’s treasured sword techniques, inner power heart techniques.
To Ding Ling, this is nothing short of heaven-sent rain!
"Wanting to obtain the Mount Heng Sect’s sword techniques, heart techniques on my own, the difficulty is unquestionably high."
Because Ding Ling realized, some masters in this world, like Yu Canghai, directly imparting every detail to Yu Renyan, are rare to find.

The majority of them do not teach everything at once but part by part, slowly instructing, or only teaching some basics, and when the disciple’s cultivation is profound, imparting other profound related techniques.
This method of teaching also made Ding Ling realize that capturing some life-cherishing and fearful disciples, then threatening for the secret manuals might be very difficult.
Even risk alerting the world, with people branding him as a Great Demon, subsequently pursuing him for vengeance.
Ding Ling is not yet invincible in the world.
He doesn’t want to make enemies of everyone.
He wants to give himself time to grow.

chapters.title: Chapter 313: Nine Bends Swordsmanship! Lion’s Roar
paragraphs: Ding Ling has already greatly offended the Mount Songh Sect; if he offends other sects, they will definitely join forces to attack him.
Ding Ling doesn’t want to face such an awkward situation.
At least, not at the moment.
"If people do not offend me, I will not offend them.
If someone offends me or deliberately provokes me, I will not be polite to them.
But it’s better to be cautious when possible, remain stable when possible.
Since I am already a mortal enemy of the Mount Songh Sect, there is no need to be polite with them. However, it’s necessary to restrain myself a bit with other sects."
Ding Ling suppressed his complex thoughts and turned his mind to the matter of the Secret Manual, pondering:

"Ordinary disciples most likely do not possess the complete Secret Manual. Only those like Young Leader Lin Pingzhi and Young Sect Leader Yu Renyan, who are of extremely high status, might have received the complete version."
’In the future, if I really need to capture someone, I should target people like them; otherwise, the likelihood is that I’ll only get incomplete versions of Cultivation Techniques.’
Ding Ling mused:
"It’s better to capture those with significant importance; they would certainly have invaluable items and Martial Arts on them."
Ding Ling once again opened a Secret Manual.
This was a Secret Manual obtained from the corpse of Nine Bends Sword Bell Town.
Ding Ling spotted it from his exploded clothing on the side.
Fortunately, the Secret Manual was perfectly intact.
"Like the Thirteen Grand Protectors, almost everyone has secret treasures!"
The manual from Nine Bends Sword Bell Town is a Sword Technique manual.
Ding Ling finished reading.
[Nine Bends Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Power +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
Again, a top-notch Sword Technique.
Once Mastered at Full Level, it unravels like a serpentine path, resembling the twists and turns of eighteen bends, winding and looping, making it dizzying to behold.
Ding Ling practiced for a while using his finger as a sword, then abruptly stopped and put the Nine Bends Swordsmanship manual aside, picking up another Secret Manual.
This one was from the body of Great Yin Yang Hand Le Hou.
Finished reading.
[Great Yin Yang Hand Seal Full Level]
[Power +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
Also a High Tier Technique, but this one is a palm technique.

Ding Ling did not employ Inner Power, instead, he used the Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi to perform the palm strikes, discovering he could similarly execute moves and activate the technique. Upon reaching Mastery, this palm technique’s skill seemed ingrained in his bones; a single palm strike, amidst the Vigorous Qi bursting forth, delivered a heavy sound.
Directly causing the heavy stone table to sink several inches!
Lin Pingzhi and Qu Feiyan were dumbfounded, unable to speak.
Without exception, both revered Ding Ling as a deity.
Lin Pingzhi was already convinced by Ding Ling’s prowess, now his admiration was even greater.

Qu Feiyan already acknowledged Ding Ling highly; witnessing him practicing Martial Arts as effortlessly as eating and drinking water had shocked her into stupefaction. Her inner recognition, admiration, and worship for Ding Ling were skyrocketing!
Ding Ling continued to flip through another Secret Manual.
This one came from the Golden Lion Gao Kexin.
Finished reading.
[Lion’s Roar Full Level]
[Power +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
Ding Ling slightly raised his eyebrows.

After mastering Lion’s Roar at Full Level, he felt his throat region had been greatly enhanced, becoming exceptionally resilient, with its meridians and the like seemingly reforged anew, distinct from before.
Ding Ling slightly turned to signal Lin Pingzhi and Qu Feiyan to cover their ears before opening his mouth and roaring.
Roar!
Like ten mighty lions roaring furiously at the sky, the sound pierced the heavens, shaking the leaves on the trees ahead into a tremble, causing many to fall immediately.
The roar startled even spirits!
Ding Ling clicked his tongue in secret thought:
"Could this Lion’s Roar be the Buddhist Lion’s Roar? I wonder how Gao Kexin acquired it?"
When fighting him, Gao Kexin had also used Lion’s Roar against Ding Ling, but its effect was not evident; the most likely reason was that Lion’s Roar is a non-discriminatory area attack technique.
Gao Kexin was probably afraid of harming his companions and didn’t dare to use it recklessly.
Of course, it might also be that Gao Kexin never actually mastered this Lion’s Roar!
Otherwise, he wouldn’t be constantly bringing up comprehension.
As for why Nine Bends Sword Bell Town kept the manual after mastering the Nine Bends Swordsmanship, perhaps it was just a habit—like Tian Boguang?
"What a pity, Tower Hand Ding Mian only had a sharp dagger, no other Secret Manual."
Ding Ling casually gifted the dagger to Qu Feiyan.
He had Giant Que Sword and Heaven-Swaying Sword, holding such a short sword was unsuitable for him.
"In one breath, learning so many techniques."
Ding Ling glanced at his Character Panel:
Strength: [Base 2 (normal human at 1 point), Wisdom 3, Power 37.8, Agility 38.4, Constitution 37.7, Defense 36.7, Charm 11. Inner Power Value: 140]
Power, agility, and other attributes had significantly increased.
Making Ding Ling’s Breathing Technique increasingly wild and fierce in his strikes!
Though the Inner Power Value remained unchanged.

But Ding Ling only needed to retreat for a few days into cultivation, the residual Inner Power left from the just newly mastered Inner Strength and Eight Extraordinary Meridians would be absorbed, refined, and incorporated quickly, causing a surge in Inner Power Value.
"After clearing the Eight Extraordinary Meridians, will it directly increase Inner Power when I cultivate?"
Ding Ling speculated to himself:
"If it directly increases Inner Power, wouldn’t I soon become the world’s number one?"
Ding Ling anticipated.
He looked at the task progress:
[1: Defeat more than 20 Plane experts: 6/20.]
Yu Canghai, Tian Boguang, Ding Mian, Bell Town, Le Hou, Gao Kexin.
These are the six First-class Experts above.
Ding Ling severely injured Fei Bin.
Yet Fei Bin’s name was not listed.
Which shows that the guy did not yield to Ding Ling in his heart, nor was he intimidated.
Almost dead, yet not intimidated, his bones are really tough.
Thinking of this, Ding Ling asked Lin Pingzhi about the whereabouts of Fei Bin and Lu Bai.
"The two of them ran away."
Lin Pingzhi said:
"They fled before Master returned to town."
"Looks like someone tipped them off."
Ding Ling understood.
He and Qu Feiyan spent considerable time burying Liu Zhengfeng and Qu Yang.
His battle with the Thirteen Grand Protectors surely attracted the notice of someone who immediately reported back to Lu Bai.
The informant is certainly a player.
Many players show interest in Ding Ling; he could sense numerous hidden sentinels watching him at the Darts Master’s Mansion’s branch location.
When he left town, even these sentinels showed signs of activity.
"These players cannot be killed for good, and once slain they quickly return."
Ding Ling felt helpless.
He could only choose to ignore them.
As long as he can quickly become the world’s top expert.
No matter how many strategies the players employ, they will only be swept away and suppressed by him!
"I’ll stay at the branch for another two days, then we’ll head north to Huashan."
Ding Ling made his decision.
In these two days, he would retreat to cultivate Inner Power.
Once he absorbed all the residual Inner Power in the various meridians, he would leave.
As for the Mount Songh Sect?
Once his Martial Power is high enough, he’ll personally visit Mount Songh Sect!

sentences.text: Ding Ling has already greatly offended the Mount Songh Sect; if he offends other sects, they will definitely join forces to attack him.
Ding Ling doesn’t want to face such an awkward situation.
At least, not at the moment.
"If people do not offend me, I will not offend them.
If someone offends me or deliberately provokes me, I will not be polite to them.
But it’s better to be cautious when possible, remain stable when possible.
Since I am already a mortal enemy of the Mount Songh Sect, there is no need to be polite with them.
However, it’s necessary to restrain myself a bit with other sects."
Ding Ling suppressed his complex thoughts and turned his mind to the matter of the Secret Manual, pondering:
"Ordinary disciples most likely do not possess the complete Secret Manual.
Only those like Young Leader Lin Pingzhi and Young Sect Leader Yu Renyan, who are of extremely high status, might have received the complete version."
’In the future, if I really need to capture someone, I should target people like them; otherwise, the likelihood is that I’ll only get incomplete versions of Cultivation Techniques.’
Ding Ling mused:
"It’s better to capture those with significant importance; they would certainly have invaluable items and Martial Arts on them."
Ding Ling once again opened a Secret Manual.

Ding Ling spotted it from his exploded clothing on the side.
Fortunately, the Secret Manual was perfectly intact.
"Like the Thirteen Grand Protectors, almost everyone has secret treasures!"
The manual from Nine Bends Sword Bell Town is a Sword Technique manual.

[Agility +0.2]

Finished reading.

[Power +0.2]

Directly causing the heavy stone table to sink several inches!

Without exception, both revered Ding Ling as a deity.
Lin Pingzhi was already convinced by Ding Ling’s prowess, now his admiration was even greater.

Her inner recognition, admiration, and worship for Ding Ling were skyrocketing!

chapters.title: Chapter 314: Xiaang Wentian
paragraphs: It was just one day of closed-door cultivation.
Ding Ling’s inner strength surged once again.
[Inner Power Value: 180]
Reaching this level of inner power.
If it were to fuse with the Breathing Technique’s vigorous qi, its explosive power would be even more evident.
Sufficient to effortlessly severely injure or even kill a First-class Supreme expert!
Dealing with First-class martial arts experts, Ding Ling was becoming more adept and at ease.
"To further enhance inner strength, unless I find Great Medicine. Otherwise, I can only persist in closed-door hard cultivation."
Ding Ling had the Full-Level Inner Power Heart Technique.
He could directly chew Great Medicine to increase inner strength.
Just like how, after maxing out his Breathing Technique, he could directly chew Great Medicine to enhance body strength, agility, and physique, it’s the same principle.
Compared to chewing Great Medicine,
closed-door hard cultivation was indeed time-consuming and labor-intensive, not worth it!

Of course, chewing Great Medicine was only suitable for someone like Ding Ling with maxed-out inner power; if Lin Pingzhi were to directly chew it, he might find it ineffective or even suffer injuries from being unable to refine it. His martial prowess might not increase but decrease instead.
"It’s time to set off for Huashan."
Ding Ling had been thinking about the Five Mountains Sect’s sword techniques at Reflection Cliff on Huashan for some time.
But the events in between truly prevented him from leaving.
"I wonder if now that I’m going to Huashan, is Reflection Cliff still accessible?"
Ding Ling was very skeptical.
Compared to Linghu Chong, who discovered the secret of Reflection Cliff but didn’t inform his master and mistress.
Players, to gain benefits, would definitely disclose everything.
Afraid of speaking late and having other players claim the Achievement Medal, wouldn’t that be a huge loss?
Whether it was the Three Kingdoms or The Smiling, Proud Wanderer,
there were no secrets to speak of.
Because the players’ ’competition’ was too fierce!
With them around, preserving secrets was impossible, because if one person didn’t speak, another definitely would! Someone would always reveal it!
Ding Ling was well aware of this.
Therefore,
his trip to Huashan was just to try his luck, not to insist on it.
If he could obtain it, great; if not, it didn’t matter much.
After all, he had already mastered the ’Hundred Transformations and Thousand Illusions Hengshan Cloud Mist Thirteen Techniques’ of the Mount Heng Sect to the full level.
And Sword God Skill, Calm Wind Swordsmanship, Human Emperor Swordsmanship, etc., were not weaker than the Mount Heng Sect’s sword skills.
No matter how strong other sects’ sword techniques were, could they surpass Sword God Skill? At most, they could only be on par with the Mount Heng Sect’s sword skills.
Therefore,
Ding Ling lacked not sword skills,
but ultimate sword techniques like Dugu Nine Swords, which could crush other sword techniques!
"I wonder if Feng Qingyang is still at Huashan Peak?"
Ding Ling was highly doubtful.
With more players,
Feng Qingyang’s whereabouts were no secret.
Huashan Sect, could he still stay there?
"If he’s not with Huashan Sect, then where might he be?"
Ding Ling thought it was still necessary to take a trip.
The next day.
Ding Ling, Lin Pingzhi, and Qu Feiyan prepared food and other essentials.
Ding Ling took out a Storage Pouch and packed wine and food into it, leaving Qu Feiyan and Lin Pingzhi wide-eyed and astonished!
Ding Ling casually said it was an item brought from the broken void.
Although the two were somewhat relieved, they were still amazed, feeling like frogs in a well, and were curious about the lower realm where Ding Ling previously stayed.
Qu Feiyan was slightly better.
Though lively and active, her mood was quite low, only showing a smile when facing Ding Ling. Even so, she was not too proactive about many things and would likely only fully recover after some time.
Now that Lin Pingzhi’s parents were both alive, and his martial prowess was continually increasing, his mindset was excellent. Driven by curiosity, he asked anything and everything.
Ding Ling would say what he could; if he couldn’t say, he’d simply gloss over it, and Lin Pingzhi, being understanding, wouldn’t pester further.
The three of them rode six horses.
They galloped all the way.
That day,
while they were taking shelter under a large tree from the scorching sun and having a meal,
Clip-clop!
A horse galloped toward them along the main road.
Ding Ling frowned.
Lin Pingzhi leaped up, drew his sword, and stood in front of Ding Ling and Qu Feiyan.
Qu Feiyan, unwilling to be outdone, also drew her short sword and stood up, staring directly at the approaching figure.
Yet, from the horse leapt down a person.

This person was over eight feet tall, robust in build, with a resolute face and eyes gleaming with spirit. A long beard with three locks floated under the chin, and he stood holding a Guan Saber, as if Guan Yu Guan Yunchang had crossed the river of time to come.
Lin Pingzhi was taken aback and hurriedly asked:
"I wonder who you, senior, are?"
"Ha ha ha..."
The newcomer laughed heartily:
"I go by a fixed name whether walking or sitting. My surname is Xiaang, and my name is Wentian! Known in Jianghu as the Celestial King of old!"
"The Bright Left Envoy of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect!"
Qu Feiyan changed color:
"What are you doing here?"
"It’s you, little girl."
Xiaang Wentian, seeing Qu Feiyan, was momentarily startled and looked around:
"Hmm. Aren’t you always inseparable from your grandfather? Where’s Qu Yang? I haven’t seen him in a long time; let him come out, I want to drink three hundred cups with him!
Upon mentioning Qu Yang,
Qu Feiyan couldn’t help but tear up again.
Xiaang Wentian’s heart skipped a beat, thinking of some rumors he’d heard recently, he couldn’t help but be shocked:
"Could it be that Qu Yang was really harmed by those punks from the Mount Songh Sect?!"
It was unclear whether he said this deliberately,
or if he blurted it out in surprise.
But it made Qu Feiyan’s mood more and more depressed.
Ding Ling frowned, stood up, and looked directly at Xiaang Wentian:
"I wonder if Left Envoy Xiaang encountered us by chance, or if he came specifically to find us?"
"Are you Ding Ling?"
Xiaang Wentian didn’t answer but instead asked a question.
"Yes."
"I came specifically to find you!"
Xiaang Wentian admitted frankly:
"To be honest, I have a favor to ask."
"Why should I help you?"
Ding Ling was surprised.
"I can offer you a generous reward, provided you help me complete the task."
"Sorry."
Ding Ling refused:
"I hate doing must-complete deals with strangers the most!"
If his personality were noble, it would be a different story.
Could Xiaang Wentian be noble?
Ding Ling was unsure, so he wouldn’t make any promises to such a person.
"How about this then."
Xiaang Wentian pondered for a while and said:
"If you can surpass me in music, chess, calligraphy, and painting, I will teach you a treasured Inner Power Heart Technique of mine."
Ding Ling’s eyes brightened slightly.
He had now cleared the Eight Meridians of the Eight Extraordinary Meridians!
Even the Ren and Du Meridians had been opened.
The operation of inner power could be described as extremely rapid!
At this moment, he thought that if he cultivated an Inner Power Heart Technique, the inner power transformed from rolling Heaven and Earth Primordial Qi could be directly assimilated.
By that time,
wouldn’t he instantly leap into a First-class expert?
Even someone more powerful!
"Besides. If you fulfill the first condition and accompany me to a place, I can offer you another secret technique!"
Xiaang Wentian spoke with sincerity, looking at Ding Ling expectantly:
"How about it, Ding Ling? Could you consider cooperating?"

chapters.title: Chapter 315: Smiling Proudly in the World (11/12)
paragraphs: Ding Ling had no reason to refuse.
This was an Inner Power Heart Method delivered right to him.
Moreover, Xiaang Wentian, hailed as the Celestial King, the Bright Left Envoy of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect, must have first-class Inner Power Heart Techniques in his collection!
What Ding Ling lacked now was a first-class Inner Power Secret Manual!
Third-rate ones were useless to him.
Second-rate ones were too mediocre. First-rate ones would help him become a top expert faster!
"Alright!"
Ding Ling nodded:
"How do you plan to compete?"
"Haha..."
Xiaang Wentian laughed heartily:
"Alright, alright, worthy of Ding Ling, the Void Shatterer. Truly straightforward!"
He took out paper and pen from his bosom, looking around:
"Let’s compete right here!"
His voice was sonorous and powerful:
"Let’s start with painting. As long as you can create a painting that utterly surpasses my skills and satisfies me, you win."
"Isn’t this competition a bit of cheating?"
Lin Pingzhi protested:
"According to you, in order to win, you must also create a painting that surpasses my master’s skills and satisfies him, right?!"
"That’s correct."
Xiaang Wentian nodded with a smile:
"Indeed, that’s what I mean!"
"Xiaang Left Envoy is being sneaky and evasive."
Qu Feiyan unhesitatingly sided with Ding Ling, accusing Xiaang Wentian:
"Competitions must be fair. What’s the point of cheating like this? My Brother Ding can also choose not to compete!"
"No longer calling Xiaang Uncle."
Xiaang Wentian glanced at Qu Feiyan, half-smiling:
"Your Brother Ding? It seems your heart has fallen for Ding Ling."
These words made Qu Feiyan blush.
She glanced at Ding Ling.
Seeing Ding Ling’s calm expression, she inexplicably felt a sense of emptiness, but quickly gathered herself and said crisply:
"According to your terms, if all three rounds end in a draw, won’t my Brother Ding waste his efforts? You must give that Inner Power Heart Technique Secret Manual as compensation."
"This..."
Xiaang Wentian was momentarily speechless under Qu Feiyan’s argument, and after contemplating he said:
"Alright. As long as you truly surpass me, regardless of whether I’m satisfied, you win."
Ding Ling chuckled ambiguously.
Peeping through a tube at a leopard.
It was clear that Xiaang Wentian was definitely not a narrow-minded, serious, high-principled person!
Zhang Zhongjing and Hua Tuo of the Three Kingdoms World were the epitome of integrity and compassion!
Dealing with someone like Xiaang Wentian, Ding Ling naturally wouldn’t be too pedantic.
He immediately gestured for Xiaang Wentian to start.
Xiaang Wentian walked to the horse’s side, took out two sets of brush, ink, paper, and ink slab.
One set per person.
Prepared meticulously.
It seemed Xiaang Wentian had forethought before coming!
This was an extremely intelligent person with hidden strategies.
Ding Ling did not underestimate Xiaang Wentian and immediately focused, starting to paint.
His painting skills were at full level.
In the Three Kingdoms, he extensively observed various celebrities’ painting skills, resulting in his skills reaching perfection and peak level!
Calling him a Grandmaster level painter who integrated ’Hundred Schools of Celebrities’ painting skills is not an exaggeration at all.
His painting skills were originally at full level.
But lacked the essence from various schools.
Also lacked the capability to get Jiuzhou and Western Realm’s Kingdoms to voluntarily or passively contribute their painting skills.
It was precisely due to the phenomenal accumulation of the Three Kingdoms World.
That led to Ding Ling’s current ability to paint and write effortlessly!
In just moments.
A scene of three people riding horses and viewing landscapes came to life on the paper.
Vivid and lifelike.
Impeccable and true to life.
Lin Pingzhi went over for a look and couldn’t help but exclaim loudly:
"Master, your painting skills are astounding. In such a short time, you’ve produced such an astonishing work, it’s unbelievable!"
Qu Feiyan also came over and was deeply moved and shaken, looking at Ding Ling with an increasingly unusual gaze.
"Hmm?!"

Xiaang Wentian had just started by the time he heard Lin Pingzhi’s exclamations, and was puzzled; he immediately set his brush aside, walked two steps to Ding Ling’s side, and looked closely. Upon seeing it, he was struck as if by lightning and stood there in shock.
After a long while.
He clapped Lin Pingzhi’s shoulder, loudly cheering:
"Good, good, good. Hahaha..."
He laughed heartily:
"Such a painting is worthy of being called a divine product! Even compared to ancient masterworks I’ve found, it’s more captivating and soul-stirring! Excellent, excellent!"
He gazed intently at Ding Ling with a face full of admiration, saying:
"No need to continue competing here. You’ve won this round."
He stroked his long beard under his chin with a face full of emotion:

"I truly couldn’t have imagined it. That in this world, there exists someone like you, Ding Ling, a Painting Saint! And you’re so young, with such high Martial Arts skills. Truly appalling, appalling!"
He shook his head and walked over to crumble his own work, disdainfully saying:
"Compared to you, my painting work is just dog poop, no need to show it and embarrass myself. Next, we shall compete in calligraphy."
Moments later.
Ding Ling, with brush strokes like flying dragons and snakes, finished a calligraphy piece that amazed Lin Pingzhi, who shouted ’Master, amazing!’ and caused Qu Feiyan’s eyes to sparkle.
Stunned, Xiaang Wentian laughed heartily:

"Excellent, excellent! To think that Ding Ling’s painting skills equate to the Painting Saint and his calligraphy to the Calligraphy Saint. Truly invincible! With you at hand, those so-called Advanced Scholars and Champion Scholars of the world today would all feel ashamed!"
He grew more excited.
As if he hadn’t lost, but won:
"Next, we will compete in music. I won’t play."
Xiaang Wentian gave in, his eyes glowing as he looked at Ding Ling:
"I’d like to see you play."
From the horse’s side, he unexpectedly took out a Guqin, held it with both hands, and handed it to Ding Ling:
"Come, give it a try."
"Alright."
Ding Ling smiled softly.
Took the Guqin, placed it to the side, and immediately began to play the sheet music for The Smiling, Proud Wanderer.
Although without the accompaniment of a flute.
His solo performance of this high-difficulty Smiling, Proud Wanderer.
Still left everyone present in awe.
The tune, full of blood, freedom, and grandeur, embodying the essence of the Jianghu in Smiling Proudly in the World, was finished.
Lin Pingzhi was moved, tears of excitement surged in his eyes.
Qu Feiyan’s previously downcast heart was invigorated.
Xiaang Wentian was silent for a while, then slapped his thigh in amazement:
"Excellent, excellent! This tune should only exist in heaven; how often can it be heard on earth! Lingering for three days wouldn’t suffice to describe its brilliance!
Who could’ve thought in my lifetime, Xiaang Wentian, I would hear such a Divine Song. Truly worthwhile, extremely worthwhile!
But what is the name of this tune?
Why is it so pleasant, captivating, and touching,
yet never heard before?"
Ding Ling explained the tune’s origin.
Xiaang Wentian sighed and lamented:
"Two friends, soulmates, have just passed like this. Damn the Mount Songh Sect scoundrels! Someday, I will make them pay with blood."
He gritted his teeth, seemingly genuinely eager to devour the Mount Songh Sect people’s flesh.
How much was acted out.
How much was genuine?

chapters.title: Chapter 316: Full Level Pure Yang True Skill (12/12)
paragraphs: Ding Ling, a master with Full Level Observing People Skill, can only discern a bit, unable to see comprehensively.
He couldn’t help but be shaken, thinking to himself:
"Xiaang Wentian is a man of cunning and deep scheming; I must guard against him to avoid capsizing in a sheltered bay."
Thinking thus.
Lin Pingzhi couldn’t resist asking about the result.
Xiaang Wentian sighed in defeat:
"Do I need to say it? I am already in awe, naturally willing to concede defeat!"
He then took out a chessboard and pieces, smiling at Ding Ling:
"It’s the final round. As long as you satisfy me, I’ll offer my treasured Inner Power Heart Method immediately."
Ding Ling nodded.
The two then sat cross-legged and began to play chess.
At the start.
Both played rapidly, their moves like thunderbolts, the sound of placing pieces ringing sharply, extremely decisive.
But as the game progressed.
Xiaang Wentian’s pace slowed down.
An hour later.
Seeing his pieces scattered, unable to find a breakthrough, he sighed deeply, taking out a Secret Manual from his bosom and handing it to Ding Ling:

"Although my methods can be unconventional, sometimes demonic in nature, I value my word. Here. This is the top-tier Inner Power Heart Method that I got by sheer chance. You’ll see once you’ve read it."
Ding Ling took it.
Opened to the first page.
"Pure Yang True Skill"
Ding Ling’s pupils shrank.
He couldn’t resist glancing at Xiaang Wentian.
Xiaang Wentian nodded and smiled, looking somewhat pleased:
"I spent a lot of effort to acquire this Secret Manual."
With this statement, he slipped.
Anyone with keen observation could tell.
He definitely didn’t acquire it by mere chance.
He seemed to realize his slip but didn’t mind it, laughing loudly to cover his embarrassment.
Ding Ling wasn’t bothered, refocusing and carefully studying the Secret Manual.
He read quickly.
Rustle!
In moments, he browsed through it.
Slightly closing his eyes to recall.
A book immediately condensed on the library’s shelf.
[Pure Yang True Skill Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
Instantly!
Boom!
A whirlwind of Primordial Qi swept through the realm, submerging Ding Ling in a blink.
Ding Ling sat in the tide of Primordial Qi, effortlessly inhaling and exhaling strands into his lungs. One could clearly see streams of white emanating from his nose.
This was the pinnacle manifestation of condensed Primordial Qi.
"How is that possible?!"
Xiaang Wentian’s eyes bulged wide as bronze bells.
This was despite his mental preparedness, still shaken to the point of internal upheaval, unable to contain himself.
He heard many speak of Ding Ling, the Void Shatterer, a young omnipotent prodigy! Not only was he the All-Purpose King, but his Martial Power was exceedingly profound.
Thinking of Ren Woxing, the Sect Leader trapped within West Lake Mei Manor.
Xiaang Wentian spent considerable resources to track down and locate Ding Ling’s group heading north.
Upon testing.
Ding Ling’s prowess was as many described, even more exceptional.
He sighed with admiration at the time, marveling at how such a remarkable person could indeed exist! But considering Ding Ling as the unheard-of Void Shatterer, he found reason.
Such a figure must be an extraordinary unparalleled genius throughout the ages!
Given this mental preparation.
Xiaang Wentian did not doubt Ding Ling’s ability to master the highly challenging Pure Yang True Skill.
Yet Ding Ling took one glance and mastered it, seemingly achieving an exceedingly profound realm.
Xiaang Wentian felt overwhelming shock.
His heart nearly leaped out of his chest at the moment!
However.
Upon noticing Lin Pingzhi and Qu Feiyan appearing unfazed, he realized that Ding Ling’s actions weren’t a first!

"Terrifying. How could such a prodigy arise in the world!? Is this Ding Ling perhaps the reincarnation of the Martial God from the heavens? What else could explain such fearsome skill?! It’s totally mind-blowing!"
Xiaang Wentian couldn’t calm himself.
Lin Pingzhi and Qu Feiyan naturally noticed it too, generating a sense of pride and contentment. After all, this is their master (Brother Ding)!
Whoosh, whoosh!
Swiftly, the sky-roaming Primordial Qi was completely absorbed and refined by Ding Ling.
Ding Ling’s Inner Power rapidly surged.
Within moments.
[Inner Power Value: 280]
After gaining 100 points.
Ding Ling’s Inner Power indeed shot up to 280.
Moreover.
Ding Ling’s Inner Power Heart Technique replaced the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill with a stronger Pure Yang True Skill!
At present.
Pure Yang True Skill was operating frenziedly within Ding Ling, converting the Inner Power from the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill.
Visibly.
Comparing the fiery Inner Power of Pure Yang True Skill.
The Inner Power of the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill was like decaying wood, collapsing upon contact.
Sucked and transformed by the fiery Inner Power of Pure Yang True Skill.
Ding Ling sat where he was.
He sat.
For one day.
After one day.
Ding Ling exhaled deeply, a plume of energy spitting out, seemingly igniting the air with crackling sounds.
"Succeeded."
Ding Ling opened his eyes, a penetrating brilliance flashing across them.
This was a manifestation of successful Inner Power cultivation.
Ding Ling hadn’t expected.
Upon mastering Full Level Pure Yang True Skill, such occurrences would unfold.

Previously, the Full Level Profound Yuan Inner Power Heart Technique and Mount Heng Wind Heart Technique were high-tier Inner Power Heart Methods, yet they showed no intention to replace the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill.
Pure Yang True Skill, the moment it appeared, seemed to engulf the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill like a whale swallowing the ocean, transforming everything into nourishment.
Now.
Flowing through Ding Ling’s Eight Meridians was the exclusive Pure Yang Inner Power of the Pure Yang True Skill.
Compared to the mediocre Inner Power of the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill.
This Pure Yang Inner Power was noticeably superior by more than one tier.
To put it plainly:
Though both are human, one is a robust two-meter tall man, the other a frail man of one and a half meters—there’s no comparison!
"Comparing the Inner Power of the Exorcism Sword Manual, this Pure Yang Inner Power seems somewhat weaker."
The Inner Power from the Exorcism Sword Manual was more dominant, scorching like the blazing sun, searing earth fire, challenging for Ding Ling to withstand.
Yet Pure Yang Inner Power, surpassing the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill and others, was more gentle, causing no harm to the body while nurturing and maintaining health!
Ding Ling could distinctly sense that as Pure Yang True Skill continually operated, his constitution seemed to be slowly improving!
This was rare!

"It means that if I break through the Eight Extraordinary Meridians’ eight meridians and later learn the Exorcism Sword Manual, it’s likely its Inner Power will absorb and transform the Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill’s Inner Power. Then, I’ll automatically practice the Exorcism Sword Manual uncontrollably?!"
"At that point, would I be forced to castrate myself?!"
Just the thought.
Made Ding Ling’s scalp tingle uncontrollably.
Now he felt most fortunate that, when his Inner Power reached Full Level, it was initially used to open the Eight Extraordinary Meridians!
If not.
Ding Ling might now be ’disabled.’

chapters.title: Chapter 317: Ding Ling vs. Xiaang Wentian (1/10)
paragraphs: Ding Ling felt that before his physical condition met the standard,
he would absolutely not consider practicing the Exorcism Sword Manual.
However, unexpectedly obtaining the Pure Yang True Skill this time,
was something worth celebrating for Ding Ling.
He didn’t ask Xiaang Wentian where the Pure Yang True Skill came from. Needless to say, the means must not be clean. Asking would only expose the scars of others.
Ding Ling wouldn’t do such a foolish thing.
After finishing his practice, he stood tall, letting out a long roar, his voice piercing through the heavens.
"Hahaha..."
Xiaang Wentian, seeing this, felt invigorated and burst into laughter:
"Congratulations Brother Ding, congratulations indeed, the Divine Skill has reached Great Success, the future is promising!"
He started calling him Brother Ding.
This showed how highly Xiaang Wentian recognized Ding Ling at that moment.
Indeed, that was the case.
A short while ago,
Ding Ling heard a notification sound.
[Achievement Medal Earned: You have gained Xiaang Wentian’s recognition.]
[Note: As the Bright Left Envoy of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect, Xiaang Wentian is highly skilled in martial arts, bold, resourceful, and undeniably talented.
He is quite proud of his knowledge in martial arts and believes himself to be far superior to other martial arts experts.
However, your appearance shattered his worldview, making him question his life!
He had never seen someone as powerful as you, the All-Purpose King! He was dumbfounded, terrified, and might never understand how such a genius like you exists in this world!]
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows slightly, looked at Xiaang Wentian, and smiled:
"I haven’t yet thanked Left Envoy Xiaang for bestowing upon me the true skill!"
He returned the Secret Manual to Xiaang Wentian.
Xiaang Wentian took it back, glanced up and down at Ding Ling, clicked his tongue in wonder, and finally couldn’t help himself:
"Could you let me test your true skill level?"
"How shall we test it?"
"How about we have a duel?"
Xiaang Wentian was eager to try.
"Hehe."
Ding Ling chuckled softly, setting himself in position:
"Alright, you go first then."
"Then I won’t hold back."

Xiaang Wentian placed the Guan Saber to one side, suddenly channeling his power, transforming into a piercing arrow heading towards Ding Ling, his palm striking like lightning, his fist moving like the wind.
With transitions between palm and fist, it was natural and smooth, as if done with ease, as light as a feather though heavy, clearly a master adept in fist and palm techniques.
Ding Ling let out a long laugh.
He pushed his palm forward.
His palm was as dense as a forest!
This time, he only used his Inner Strength to fight Xiaang Wentian.
Soon.
Crash! Bang!
The two quickly entered a fever pitch of battle.

Halfway through the fight, Ding Ling realized the level of his current Inner Power and slightly incorporated some of the Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi, and with a detonating sound, Xiaang Wentian cried out in surprise as he was hit and flew several meters away.
He looked at Ding Ling, uncertain and suspicious:
"What kind of qi was that just now?!"

Xiaang Wentian could clearly sense the terror of that qi, akin to the Scythe of Death that could reap souls, more like the flood of the Celestial River that could overturn the heavens at any moment, surging and roaring, turbulent and rushing! One misstep, and it could snatch your soul away, leaving you dead on the spot!
A cold sweat broke out on him, finding it hard to believe.
He was one of the top-notch masters rare to find in the world.
Yet under this kind of qi, felt a sense of insignificance like a mantis trying to stop a cart or an ant shaking a tree.
How could this be possible?!
"It’s the Vigorous Qi of the Breathing Technique."
Ding Ling did not conceal it, as there were too many players, and some of them might understand the Breathing Technique:
"If this Breathing Technique achieves Mastery through Great Success, its Vigorous Qi will naturally blend with Inner Power, creating such an effect."
However.
This only applied to Ding Ling.
Ordinary players, even if they mastered the Breathing Technique, could never achieve what Ding Ling did.
Simply because Ding Ling had mastered four kinds of Breathing Techniques, with their Vigorous Qi combined, far surpassing any single Breathing Technique!
It crushed those who hadn’t achieved Mastery in the Breathing Technique.
"Remarkable."
Xiaang Wentian marveled:
"Although my Inner Power is greater than yours to some extent, in terms of overall cultivation, I am far behind you."
It was the truth.
Ding Ling’s current Inner Power was 280 points. He was infinitely close to a First-class Expert, only slightly behind Xiaang Wentian.
Ding Ling estimated Xiaang Wentian’s Inner Power to be 300 points.
As for the specifics.
Ding Ling still needed to explore further as he progressed.
But his Inner Power being infinitely close to a First-class Supreme Expert was a fact!
And because he had opened up the Ren and Du Meridians and cultivated the top-tier Inner Power Pure Yang True Skill, his combat power was not inferior to a First-class Supreme Expert!
If combined with the Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi.
Ding Ling could now crush a First-class Supreme Expert.
If Dongfang Bubai appeared,
Ding Ling now dared to contest with her!
As he progressed into First-class in Inner Power.
Ding Ling realized a fact.

"Earlier, Bai Wushuang’s Inner Power was refined and concealed. This must be an indication that her Inner Power cultivation reached the Transformation Realm. Previously, my Inner Power cultivation wasn’t high enough to determine the specifics. Now, I’m able to understand a bit."
Ding Ling thought of his previous encounter with Bai Wushuang, and felt secretly awed:
"Clearly, Bai Wushuang held back in our last encounter. She didn’t give it her all."
Ding Ling pondered:
"It seems Bai Wushuang merely wanted to assess the Void Shatterer’s strength. Unfortunately, I didn’t meet her expectations. But she seems to regard the Void Shatterer quite highly?
No, to be accurate.
She met the Void Shatterer for the first time and wanted to see my potential.
So she’s willing to give me some time. In a few months, we will battle again at Huashan Peak!"
After figuring it out.
Ding Ling became more convinced that Bai Wushuang was most probably Dongfang Bubai.
Otherwise, besides Dongfang Bubai, who else in this world could have such mastery?!
However, judging from Qu Feiyan’s descriptions, it seems that Dongfang Bubai is a tall and strong man, not the graceful and slender Bai Wushuang!
As for what exactly it is, it might not be known until a few months later.
Ding Ling and Xiaang Wentian had a ’joyful conversation.’
After a battle.
Xiaang Wentian admired and respected Ding Ling even more, naturally treating Ding Ling with more caution and respect than before, rather than his previous casualness and impudence.
This is the transformation brought about by strength.
Without strength.
No matter where you go, you are the weak!
Lin Pingzhi watched and felt proud, his face glowing.
Qu Feiyan now had her heart entirely with Ding Ling, naturally hoping Ding Ling would do better, and she was happier than anyone when Ding Ling won.
After a while.
Xiaang Wentian, after feeling they’ve talked enough, started mentioning matters related to Ren Woxing, the former Sect Leader of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect.
When this topic was brought up.

It naturally led to some criticisms of the traitors who betrayed Ren Woxing. Although Dongfang Bubai wasn’t mentioned by name, his words carried enough resentment to show his great discontent with Dongfang Bubai.
Otherwise.
He wouldn’t be so intent on rescuing Ren Woxing.

Qu Feiyan was shocked hearing this from the side, wanting to mention Ren Woxing’s fearsome nature, but seeing Xiaang Wentian present, she decided to hold back her anxiety, planning to find Ding Ling after Xiaang Wentian and Ding Ling parted to explain everything clearly.

chapters.title: Chapter 318: Absorption Technique (2/10)
paragraphs: Qu Feiyan and Qu Yang wandered the Jianghu, their footprints spanning the North and South of the Great River, and naturally, they were deeply familiar with many deeds of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect.
Ren Woxing was arrogant and overbearing, ruthless in his decisions, far surpassing the current Dongfang Bubai.
If Ren Woxing were rescued, the Jianghu might again be swept into a bloody storm.
Regarding this,
Qu Feiyan saw clearly but did not dwell on it. For her, the most pressing concern was still Ding Ling.
She worried that after rescuing Ren Woxing, Ding Ling might have a conflict with him, which would be troublesome.
Ding Ling was inseparable from Xiaang Wentian.

Qu Feiyan couldn’t find an opportunity to speak until the agreement was made, and they were each about to mount their horses and leave. Qu Feiyan deliberately leaped onto Ding Ling’s mount, hugged his waist, and whispered to him about Ren Woxing.
Ding Ling understood and patted the back of Qu Feiyan’s hand to indicate that he knew.
Qu Feiyan, born with a keen heart, understood that Ding Ling was prepared, so she refrained from saying more, and instead, resolved to protect Ding Ling at all costs if anything happened to him.
She treated Ding Ling as she would her grandfather.
Qu Feiyan always remembered that sentiment.

Yet, as she spent more time with Ding Ling, that sentiment slowly changed, unbeknownst to anyone, perhaps even Qu Feiyan herself, despite Ding Ling always treating her gently like a sister, causing her to feel discouraged and anxious, refraining from further thoughts, choosing only to serve Ding Ling wholeheartedly.
That day.
The group rode into West Lake Mei Manor.
As soon as they appeared.
Someone recognized Ding Ling, shouting loudly by the roadside, waving to signal:
"Idol, Idol! Here, here, remember me? We met in the Three Kingdoms World!"
Some were trying to ingratiate themselves.
Some were dumbstruck, tongue-tied:
"Whoa. It’s really Ding Ling! Ding Ling has actually come to West Lake Mei Manor. With him here, we can forget about the Star Absorption Technique!"
"Who would have thought West Lake Mei Manor is so large! It’s much bigger than depicted in TV dramas and novels! Common folks entering would surely get lost, let alone find where Ren Woxing is held!"

"Even if they found it, could they defeat the Four Great Manor Masters of Mei Manor? Each of them is highly skilled. The Second Manor Master’s Profound Celestial Finger can freeze water into ice; without being a first-class expert, who could achieve such a feat?!"
They were players.
Engaged in fervent discussions, talking big.
Ding Ling listened, discerning clearly.
With a brief contemplation.
Ding Ling understood:
No doubt, these players must have tried to rescue Ren Woxing to obtain the Star Absorption Technique, but unfortunately, they couldn’t even find the entrance.
Or, having entered Mei Manor, they were quickly killed by One-Character Electric Sword Ding Jian and others.
Thereafter.

The players contemplated joining forces with the Four Manor Masters of West Lake Mei Manor, seeking an opportunity to obtain the secret technique, but ironically, the Four Manor Masters did not accept outsiders.
The players found it impossible to master the technique, lingering outside the gates.
Many old-timers saw no hope and left, followed by a new batch of newcomers.
Over time, the players outside West Lake Mei Manor changed many times.
No matter how many times they changed.
Upon seeing Ding Ling, they couldn’t help but cheer, uproariously celebrating.
Of course, there were also those who belittled and opposed him.
Yet, from partial glimpses, a broader picture emerges.
Ding Ling’s popularity now is aptly described as being at its peak.

Seeing Ding Ling’s fame, Xiaang Wentian immediately changed his plan to impersonate a disciple of the Five Mountains Sword Sect and rode over to Ding Ling to discuss the details, saying that soon he would pose as the steward of the Void Shatterer’s household.
Ding Ling naturally agreed without objection.
Upon arriving at West Lake Mei Manor.
Lin Pingzhi suddenly demanded Xiaang Wentian’s secret manual and said:
"As agreed, when we reach West Lake Mei Manor, you will give my master a secret technique. You can’t go back on your words."
Xiaang Wentian hesitated, glanced at Lin Pingzhi, and felt increasingly annoyed by him. He figured if Lin Pingzhi hadn’t mentioned it, Ding Ling might have forgotten, allowing him to maneuver things.
Yet Lin Pingzhi had managed to reveal it.
His eye twitched twice, and with a silent sigh, he could only feign generosity, saying:
"Promises must be kept; it’s my principle in the Jianghu. How could I go back on my word?"
Once again, he took out a secret manual from his bosom and handed it to Ding Ling:
"This is my secret technique, the Absorption Technique. Here!"
Ding Ling smiled slightly, accepted it without hesitation, and began reading on the spot.
After finishing,
[Absorption Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.2]
This is a technique for Transplanting Flower and Wood, leveraging one’s strength against the opponent!
If mastered to the Flawless Realm, one could perfectly absorb the opponent’s Vigorous Qi during an inner strength attack, channel it into the ground, remaining unscathed.
This technique.
The higher the physical condition, the more meridians unblocked, the more potent the technique becomes!
Of course.

Only when perfected in mastery would the technique’s true power be demonstrated. In the Great Success Realm, those with lower physical condition and who haven’t unlocked the eight meridians would definitely miss out on the unparalleled power of the Absorption Technique, considering it overhyped.
In reality, the technique is indeed a high-tier ultimate skill, as can be seen from the increment in attribute points; it must not be underestimated.
"Take it."
Having finished, Ding Ling felt a special surge of Vigorous Qi flowing between his limbs, knowing it was formed after entering mastery with the Absorption Technique.
When this energy fully merged with his body, Ding Ling could effortlessly use this technique to ’leverage strength against the opponent!’
"Successfully cultivated?"
Xiaang Wentian couldn’t help but ask, glancing sideways.
"Yes."
Ding Ling nodded.
Despite preparing mentally, Xiaang Wentian still appeared stunned. After a while, he regained his composure, sighing:

"Impressive, impressive. I’ve been cultivating this Absorption Technique for years. Long since achieving the Great Success Realm, I could never enter the flawless mastery. I suspect it’s because of inadequate physical condition or insufficiently spacious meridians. What do you think?"
"You’re right."
"Really?!"
Xiaang Wentian felt a chill in his heart, saying:
"I always thought this Absorption Technique was just bluffing. The harm to the opponent is negligible. Even if mastered, what use is it?
Upon realizing I couldn’t achieve flawless mastery, I stopped practicing. At what realm have you now cultivated?"
"Perfect mastery."
This was no secret.

Previously, Xiaang Wentian had witnessed Ding Ling cultivating the Pure Yang True Skill to the Realm of Perfection, and the difficulty of the Absorption Technique was far less than Pure Yang True Skill, so Ding Ling had no need to conceal the truth.

chapters.title: Chapter 319: West Lake Mei Manor
paragraphs: If there’s a real fight, Ding Ling could use this technique to leverage strength and absorb inner power into the ground. Xiaang Wentian has also practiced the Absorption Technique, so he would certainly be able to see through it.
Therefore, keeping it a secret is useless.
"Impressive."

Xiaang Wentian admitted his inferiority, fully convinced by Ding Ling’s abilities. He didn’t mention testing Ding Ling’s Absorption Technique because Ding Ling had already demonstrated his exceptional learning and cultivation skills. Testing it again would make Xiaang Wentian look foolish.
"I hope you’ll cooperate with me well."
Xiaang Wentian stated plainly:
"If we’re able to rescue Sect Leader Ren, I will certainly recommend you to become the Bright Right Envoy of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect!"
Ding Ling smiled without speaking.
He wasn’t keen on associating with Ren Woxing, an arrogant and domineering person.
He came here.
Not just to learn the Star Absorption Technique.
But also to study the Exotic Skills of the Four Great Manor Masters.
From TV shows, novels, and other places, the strength level of the Four Great Manor Masters seemed high, otherwise, how could they freeze water using inner strength?
This skill alone.
Is worth learning by Ding Ling.
But how to obtain it?
Ding Ling thought about their obsession with music, chess, calligraphy, and painting, perhaps he could start from there.
With this in mind, Ding Ling followed Xiaang Wentian on horseback to the entrance of West Lake Mei Manor.
Dong dong!
Xiaang Wentian took the initiative to knock on the door.
Before long.
A refined gentleman, with a treasure sword at his waist and brows as sharp as sword edges, came out. He glanced at the crowd and said:
"Our West Lake Mei Manor does not entertain outside guests."
Xiaang Wentian was taken aback.
He had just clasped his hands to speak, but was directly rebutted by this man.
Ding Ling smiled slightly, knowing the situation well.
Needless to say, the man in front of them is undoubtedly annoyed by the players!
The fact that he had the patience to open the door and say a word was already giving a lot of courtesy. If it were someone with a worse temper, they might not even bother to open the door.
Thinking of this, Ding Ling stepped forward and said:

"We have come here hoping to discuss the paths of music, chess, calligraphy, and painting sword techniques with the four Manor Masters. We guarantee the satisfaction of the four Manor Masters, and if not, we are willing to apologize."
"Oh?"
The man glanced sideways, looking directly at Ding Ling, with a slight displeasure:
"What is your name, to dare speak such wild words!"
"Haha..."
Xiaang Wentian cheered up, laughing and saying:
"You may not know, but the person in front of you is Ding Ling, the Void Shatterer, who is all-capable and excels in everything!
"The Void Shatterer Ding Ling?!"
The man’s expression changed slightly.
Xiaang Wentian noticed this and was overjoyed, laughing loudly:

"Exactly, exactly. It seems One-Character Electric Sword Ding Jian is not completely oblivious to external affairs. You know the Void Shatterer Ding Ling. Since you know him, you should also be aware of his formidable and terrifying aspects, so what more concerns could you have?"
His prepared arguments were all changed.
Going with the flow and seizing the opportunity to this point.
He truly lived up to the reputation of a shrewd man.
"It’s Ding Ling, then there’s no more to say."
Ding Jian said solemnly:
"Please!"
He stepped aside:

"The Four Great Manor Masters at Mei Manor have also heard of your name, Ding Ling, but they have always harbored doubts about your reputation as an All-Powerful King. They lamented many times about not having met you before.
If not.
They would certainly want to compete with you.
Now that you’ve come, Ding Ling, I believe the Four Manor Masters will be very pleased."

Yet he didn’t know.
The arrival of players not only stirred up the Jianghu.
But to gain recognition from the Four Manor Masters.
They often talked about various strange and remarkable events.
In the eyes of the players, Ding Ling is considered the most extraordinary of the extraordinary, and his all-around skills would surely intrigue the Four Manor Masters!
And it was indeed true.

When merely one or two players said so, it might have been fine, but with many players highly endorsing Ding Ling, the Four Manor Masters could not remain calm. They even instructed Ding Jian specifically that if he saw Ding Ling, he should not block him but directly let him into West Lake Mei Manor.
This is also the reason for Ding Jian’s actions.
Bada-bam!
A group of people followed Ding Jian into West Lake Mei Manor.
What they saw upon entering.
Was a vast array of vegetation, seemingly concealing mechanisms and arrays within. Ding Ling, having some understanding of Array Dao, could see right through it and muttered to himself:
"No wonder few can break into West Lake Mei Manor, with its operational illusion and trapping arrays. Not to mention players, even martial arts experts without understanding Array Dao.
Barging in recklessly would highly likely get trapped."
Ding Ling realized why even with players’ help, Xiaang Wentian couldn’t help seeking Ding Ling for rescuing Ren Woxing.
There was really no other way.
Otherwise, why go to great lengths to find Ding Ling and even pass out the family’s suppressed skills and heart techniques!
However, this also demonstrated.
Xiaang Wentian’s loyalty to Ren Woxing, as ordinary people wouldn’t bear to contribute such a secret technique.
Bada-bam!
They twisted and turned through the path.
Walking several miles.
Only then did they arrive at Mei Manor’s main hall.
Lin Pingzhi muttered:
"This Mei Manor is too large."
Ding Jian smiled slightly:
"The original layout of Mei Manor wasn’t like this; it’s only after numerous reconstructions and expansions that it became like this."
He was very courteous and respectful to Ding Ling, and by extension quite polite to others too:
"Everyone, please sit down. Have a cup of tea first. I’ll go and invite the Manor Masters."
"Alright."
Ding Ling sat down and said:
’Sorry to trouble you.’
"This is my duty."
Ding Jian casually spoke to Ding Ling and left to find the Four Manor Masters.
Thus, a full quarter-hour passed.
After finishing their tea.
They finally saw Ding Jian leading four men, each with different appearances and expressions, coming over.
At a distance.
Ding Ling saw an elderly man with graying hair, a warm smile on his face, carrying a guqin under his arm laugh heartily and say:
"Guests from afar, if there has been any neglect on our part, we do seek your forgiveness."
Ding Ling stood up, offering a formal gesture and said loudly:
"Arriving uninvited, we haven’t yet apologized for disturbing the Manor Masters."
"Haha..."
A delicate-looking man with a pale complexion, somewhat resembling a lively zombie, laughed and said:
"The All-Purpose King Ding Ling is indeed so humble and courteous. It’s truly better to see once than hear a hundred times."
He moved swiftly.

In a flash, he leaped more than ten meters, appearing before Ding Ling in several flickers, with a level of lightweight skill rarely matched. His eyes were alight as he stared intently at Ding Ling and said:
"Many have said you excel in music, chess, calligraphy, painting, as well as all weaponry without exception. I wonder if that’s true?"
"If the Manor Masters are interested, why don’t we have a debate?"
Ding Ling smiled slightly.
"That’s precisely what I hope for."

chapters.title: Chapter 320: The Four Friends of Jiangnan
paragraphs: A chubby, short man with an oil-smooth bald head said with a face full of joy:
"I dare not claim my calligraphy skills to be the best in the world, but few can compare. Why don’t we discuss the art of calligraphy first?"
"It’s still better to compare paintings."
A fresh-looking, handsome man looked Ding Ling up and down and smiled:
"Ding Ling. You don’t come to West Lake Mei Manor for no reason. Your sudden visit can’t be just to discuss the Dao with us, right?"
Needless to say.
Some are siding with Xiang Wentian.
Certainly, some players are siding with the four Manor Masters of Mei Manor.

Judging by the expression and demeanor of the handsome man, he seemed quite wary of Ding Ling and his group, needless to say, some players must have leaked the information about Xiang Wentian’s plan to rescue Ren Woxing.
Regardless of whether this is true or not.
It’s natural for people to be cautious.
Compared to the pedantic Liu Zhengfeng, these people are clearly more seasoned and slick; they neither fully trust the players’ words nor completely dismiss them.
Xiang Wentian’s heart skipped a beat, and his heart raced; he realized he had underestimated the caution of these Manor Masters in front of him.
He was very upset and didn’t know if he could succeed this time.
At this moment, he could only rely on Ding Ling since he was definitely not able to compete against the four Manor Masters of Mei Manor in music, chess, calligraphy, and painting.
However, he had collected some precious paintings, music scores, and such.

But having competed with Ding Ling, he knew Ding Ling’s painting skills were far superior to the sages of the past, so he gave up on using paintings and such to lure the four Manor Masters, placing all his hopes on Ding Ling.
With this in mind.
He, too, stared at Ding Ling with eager eyes, full of expectation, unable to share with outsiders.
"Indeed."
Ding Ling, with full-level acting, looked seriously at the four Manor Masters:
"I am here not only to discuss the Dao but also to exchange my skills in painting, calligraphy, and playing the zither with the life-long learning of the four Manor Masters."
The four Manor Masters’ expressions changed simultaneously.
Each looked as if they were about to refuse.
Ding Ling quickly said before they could speak:
"Of course, if my skills cannot satisfy you Manor Masters, you are free not to exchange."
He smiled slightly and said:
"Manor Masters, this deal is mutually agreeable and fair for all ages. So, how about it? Do you want to give it a try?"
"Alright."
An elderly man with gray hair laughed heartily, stroking his beard:
"Ding Ling, you’re straightforward, no need for any pretense. We won’t be courteous with you either. Let’s do it!"
He made the decision:
"Let’s give it a try first. If any of us is convinced by you and wants to exchange, I won’t stop it.
Xiang Wentian watched at the side, a bit bewildered.
He wasn’t sure what Ding Ling was up to.
Only Qu Feiyan understood and thought:
"Needless to say, Brother Ding must be doing all this to learn new martial arts. Such a great effort."
Her eyes rolled as she thought to herself:
"I must find a way to help Brother Ding. But where can I find a lot of martial arts secret manuals? Oh right, Shaolin Temple! But how do I sneak into Shaolin Temple?"
While Qu Feiyan was pondering.
Ding Ling had already set up.
He laughed aloud:
"I will compete with the four Manor Masters simultaneously."
"Ding Ling, don’t be too conceited."
The zombie-faced man’s expression looked a bit unnatural:
"Each of us brothers has a unique skill, studied for decades, or at least for ten years. Competing with all of us at once might be too conceited."
"If not, how would I convince the Manor Masters?"
Ding Ling clapped his hands.
Lin Pingzhi and Qu Feiyan immediately stepped forward and prepared the writing tools.
Ding Ling picked up the brush and started painting without a word.
But within moments.
A portrait of the four Manor Masters emerged vividly on paper.
The portraits were lifelike, radiant, as if ready to step out at any moment.
The four Manor Masters were moved.
Before they could react.
Ding Ling picked up the brush again, with swift strokes, he produced a piece of calligraphy that shocked ghosts and gods.
The four Manor Masters gasped.
Then Ding Ling sat before the guqin and played ’The Smiling, Proud Wanderer.’
For a long time.
The sound of the zither faded away.
The Manor Masters still seemed entranced.
It wasn’t until Xiang Wentian coughed a few times that they seemed to wake from their daze.
At that moment.
The Manor Masters looked at Ding Ling as if he was a god.
The gray-haired one looked at Ding Ling with enthusiasm:
"I never thought that I, Huang Zhonggong, would hear such divine music in my lifetime. I can die without regrets, die without regrets!
Ding Ling’s zither skills were at full level.
After collecting the zither skills of various masters in the Three Kingdoms World.
His zither skills rose all the way to the pinnacle, reaching a grandmaster level!
At this point.
It’s not an exaggeration to call him a Zither Saint.
A song ’The Smiling, Proud Wanderer’ played with boldness and grandeur to the extreme; anyone hearing it would find it hard not to be enchanted.
Pursuing and indulging in the Dao of the zither all life, Huang Zhonggong was immediately convinced by Ding Ling and was the first to speak:
"I have devoted all my life’s learning to the Seven-string Invisible Sword. If Ding Ling, you don’t mind, would you be willing to exchange your zither skills with me?"
"I couldn’t wish for anything more."
Overjoyed, Ding Ling maintained a calm facade and said sternly:
"In pursuing all kinds of Daos in my life, it would be an honor to learn your supreme skill, Elder Huang!"
"Haha..."
Huang Zhonggong, comforted and gratified, laughed while stroking his beard:

"I had never found a suitable successor for my Seven-string Invisible Sword. None in Mei Manor could learn it. Your zither skills are extraordinary, which pleases me greatly. Passing the Seven-string Invisible Sword to you would be a great honor."
From this, one could see.
Compared to the other Manor Masters, Huang Zhonggong was honest, generous, and kind-hearted.
Meeting such an elder.
Ding Ling had immense respect.
He immediately expressed his intention to impart his life’s zither skills to Huang Zhonggong.
Huang Zhonggong was, of course, overjoyed, but that’s another story.
Meanwhile, the handsome one couldn’t wait to say:
"Since Big Brother has spoken. I won’t hold back. Ding Ling, I, Dan Qingsheng, am also willing to exchange with you."
"And me, Tubi Elder."
The short, chubby, bald man held out his pen, eyeing Ding Ling with enthusiasm:
"Your regular script is too strong, simply invincible. I’m curious about your cursive script."
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate.
He picked up the brush and, with a simple gesture, completed a cursive script.
Tubi Elder immediately leapt forward, examining and appreciating it, completely engrossed.
"Big Brother, Third Brother, and Fourth Brother were all convinced by you."
The zombie-faced man stepped out, looking solemnly at Ding Ling:
"I am curious about your chess skills."
"Come."
Xiang Wentian brought out the chessboard and pieces:
"Why don’t you two have a match now?"
