chapters.title: Chapter 321: Seven-Stringed Invisible Sword Full Level
paragraphs: Xiaang Wentian felt rather frustrated.
Initially, he couldn’t figure out what Ding Ling was thinking, but later he realized.
He could only suppress his displeasure and assist Ding Ling.
Hoping that once Ding Ling achieves his goals, he would help rescue Sect Leader Ren.
"Please."
Ding Ling gestured.
The zombie man immediately sat down.
He began to play a fast-paced chess match with Ding Ling, exchanging moves quickly.
The zombie man’s chess skills were exceptionally high.
However, Ding Ling had absorbed the chess skills of various ancient saints in the Three Kingdoms World, making his expertise unparalleled!
The zombie man was no match for him.
In less than an hour, Ding Ling’s fierce offensive had utterly routed and overwhelmed him.
He was dejected, disheartened, and unwilling:
"Let’s play another game. I wasn’t prepared just now."
Ding Ling smiled slightly, neither agreeing nor disagreeing.
They immediately started another game.
This time, Ding Ling played whimsically, setting up encirclements with ease, reaching a level of effortless mastery!
The zombie man lost even faster.
He smiled bitterly, casting the pieces onto the board and sighed:

"I didn’t expect that although I, Hei Baizi, pride myself on unmatched chess skills in the world, I was effortlessly defeated by Ding Ling. It’s truly embarrassing and shameful, leaving me with no face to see anyone!"
Huang Zhonggong patted Hei Baizi’s shoulder and said:

"Second brother, look on the bright side. Just know that you lost to the invincible, rare Void Shatterer, Ding Ling. Then you can feel at ease. Besides, if you’re willing, you can learn Ding Ling’s chess skills anytime, anywhere."
Hei Baizi, however, was somewhat unwilling:
"My supreme skill, Profound Celestial Finger, is extremely extraordinary, yet Ding Ling exchanged it for mere chess skills. I feel a bit shortchanged."
"I can teach you a Breathing Technique and a Sword Technique."
Ding Ling’s goal is to quickly become the world’s number one.
So he generously shared his past knowledge.
Especially the ones that many people already knew.
For instance, the Xiahou Clan’s Moon Shadow Swordsmanship was taught to many people after being passed to Ding Ling and others, so the Xiahou Clan decided to teach it to many close associates.
Now, there are quite a few who know this sword technique.
There are also some widely spread Breathing Techniques.
Ding Ling had no reason to hold back because so many people already knew them.
"What Breathing Technique? Sword Technique?"
Hei Baizi looked over and said urgently:
"Could it be the Breathing Technique that you people from the lower realm say can strengthen the body?"
"Indeed."
Hei Baizi started talking about the lower realm, showing that deep down he was extremely proud and looked down on those ’ascension’ players.
But this was quite normal.
Because, except for players who truly "ascended" through their own Martial Power, most were weak and could be easily crushed by Hei Baizi.
The weak have no rights.
It was understandable that Hei Baizi looked down on these people.
"I see."
Hei Baizi said:
"If you can show me the technique, perhaps if I like it, I’ll trade with you."
"Second brother."
Before Ding Ling could speak, Huang Zhonggong couldn’t help but frown and say:
"If you’re unwilling, just say so directly. Why make things difficult for others and take advantage of them!"
Hei Baizi immediately closed his mouth.
But from his appearance, it seemed he was unwilling.
Lin Pingzhi and Qu Feiyan both glanced over, feeling rather disdainful of this man who loved exploiting loopholes.
Ding Ling didn’t press the matter, only conversing with Huang Zhonggong and the others.
After a while.
Ding Ling followed Huang Zhonggong into a side room.
Huang Zhonggong taught Ding Ling the Seven-string Invisible Sword on the spot.
Ding Ling listened to his explanation once.
He closed his eyes slightly.
Recalled it briefly.
A book immediately condensed in the library.
In an instant.
[Seven-Stringed Invisible Sword Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
In the blink of an eye.
Ding Ling completely mastered and comprehended the Seven-string Invisible Sword.
And engraved this sword technique, no, this music-killing technique into his mastery.
This was surprisingly a technique for harming and defeating enemies using music.
Once mastered.

You can easily influence the inner strength in others’ dantian through playing or plucking music, causing their inner strength to run amok, as if being sliced by Sword Qi, making it unbearably painful!
Truly remarkable.
"How is it?"
Huang Zhonggong looked at Ding Ling expectantly.
Ding Ling nodded: "It’s done."
"Here.
Huang Zhonggong handed Ding Ling a bamboo flute:
"I crafted this bamboo flute by hand and haven’t used it yet, so I’m giving it to you. Try playing it."
"It’s impolite to refuse."
Ding Ling took the bamboo flute and immediately began playing The Smiling, Proud Wanderer.
As the tune played.

The air was filled with resonant clanging sounds. Initially, the few outside felt it was pleasing to the ear, but in the blink of an eye, each of them felt as if their internal organs and the dantian were being sliced by blades and swords, causing their expressions to change as they sat to meditate.
But no matter how they meditated, it was futile.
Until Huang Zhonggong’s loud shout.
The sound of the bamboo flute abruptly stopped.
Xiaang Wentian, Hei Baizi, and others exchanged looks, seeing the astonishment in each other’s eyes.
Just a flute melody!
It could make so many heroes present unable to withstand it; how terrifying is that?!
In the inner chamber.
Since Huang Zhonggong was close to Ding Ling, he bore the brunt, feeling a searing pain in his internal organs, and immediately shouted to stop.
When Ding Ling stopped.
He panted heavily, almost disbelievingly looking at Ding Ling:
"How, how is it possible?! You’ve cultivated the Seven-string Invisible Sword to the flawless realm of mastery?!"
"Indeed."
Ding Ling replied calmly.
"Unfathomable!"
Huang Zhonggong felt as if a giant hammer had struck his head, causing a buzzing sound as if it were about to explode.
After quite a while.
He seemed to calm down and looked at Ding Ling with completely changed eyes:

’In the world, there is indeed a rare genius like you. No wonder so many people praise you and say you are the All-Purpose King. I finally understand why you are the All-Purpose King. With such an astonishing learning ability, it’s difficult not to become the All-Purpose King.’
He sighed deeply:
"I have practiced the Seven-string Invisible Sword for decades but never reached the mastery level. I never expected you to achieve it. Remarkable, truly remarkable."
Only those who have practiced the Seven-string Invisible Sword can understand the difficulty of cultivating this music-killing technique.
What is most important.
There’s no guide.

No mentor’s guidance, it was like a blind person feeling an elephant, fumbling across the river, naturally taking many detours, and when they tried to take the right path, they found it was hard to undo the ingrained mistakes and reach that perfect pinnacle state again.
Seeing Ding Ling achieve the flawless realm he always dreamed of just by listening to his explanation once.
Huang Zhonggong was in awe, reaching the peak of admiration and envy.
He immediately began seeking Ding Ling’s advice on the cultivation method of the Seven-string Invisible Sword.
Ding Ling was caught off guard but made no secret, explaining everything one by one.
Upon hearing the key points,
Huang Zhonggong had an expression of sudden realization, then regretfully said:
"So that’s how it is, if only I had known earlier..."

Initially, he couldn’t figure out what Ding Ling was thinking, but later he realized.
He could only suppress his displeasure and assist Ding Ling.
Hoping that once Ding Ling achieves his goals, he would help rescue Sect Leader Ren.
"Please."
Ding Ling gestured.
The zombie man immediately sat down.
He began to play a fast-paced chess match with Ding Ling, exchanging moves quickly.
The zombie man’s chess skills were exceptionally high.

The zombie man was no match for him.
In less than an hour, Ding Ling’s fierce offensive had utterly routed and overwhelmed him.
He was dejected, disheartened, and unwilling:
"Let’s play another game.
I wasn’t prepared just now."
Ding Ling smiled slightly, neither agreeing nor disagreeing.

This time, Ding Ling played whimsically, setting up encirclements with ease, reaching a level of effortless mastery!
The zombie man lost even faster.

Then you can feel at ease.
Besides, if you’re willing, you can learn Ding Ling’s chess skills anytime, anywhere."

"My supreme skill, Profound Celestial Finger, is extremely extraordinary, yet Ding Ling exchanged it for mere chess skills.
I feel a bit shortchanged."
"I can teach you a Breathing Technique and a Sword Technique."
Ding Ling’s goal is to quickly become the world’s number one.
So he generously shared his past knowledge.
Especially the ones that many people already knew.
For instance, the Xiahou Clan’s Moon Shadow Swordsmanship was taught to many people after being passed to Ding Ling and others, so the Xiahou Clan decided to teach it to many close associates.
Now, there are quite a few who know this sword technique.

Sword Technique?"
Hei Baizi looked over and said urgently:

"Indeed."

But this was quite normal.
Because, except for players who truly "ascended" through their own Martial Power, most were weak and could be easily crushed by Hei Baizi.
The weak have no rights.
It was understandable that Hei Baizi looked down on these people.
"I see."
Hei Baizi said:
"If you can show me the technique, perhaps if I like it, I’ll trade with you."
"Second brother."

"If you’re unwilling, just say so directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 322: Innate Realm
paragraphs: "Who would’ve thought that taking that path back then would be such a mistake."
What a pity.
There’s no foreseeing life’s choices.
Huang Zhonggong sighed deeply, yet felt immense relief:
"It’s a blessing that the Seven-string Invisible Sword has found a successor like you, Ding Ling. I believe it will shine brilliantly in your hands!"
Ding Ling nodded and expressed his gratitude.
"This was an exchange we agreed upon; no need to be overly formal with me."
Huang Zhonggong grew more impressed with Ding Ling:
"I have no disciples or successors. Since I’m teaching you the Seven-string Invisible Sword today, if you’re willing, I can pass all my martial arts knowledge onto you."
How could Ding Ling refuse? He hurriedly bowed deeply in gratitude.
Huang Zhonggong gently supported Ding Ling, preventing him from making too formal a bow, and said with emotion:
"I am old and don’t know how many years I have left. To hear the divine song you play before my death and to discuss the path of zither skills with you, I am already very content.
Not to mention finding a successor for my Seven-string Invisible Sword, it’s the greatest comfort of my life!"
He was all smiles:

"My teachings come from an unnamed old master. The Seven-string Invisible Sword is one of his supreme skills. Unfortunately, despite my lifetime of learning, I could not cultivate the Seven-string Invisible Sword to a state of great perfection.
But you, having heard the heart technique once, have already reached great perfection.
Truly a genius, truly..."
Huang Zhonggong struggled to put his admiration into words for a long moment.
Evidently, he was at a loss for words to describe Ding Ling’s talent.
[Achievement medal acquired: You have gained Huang Zhonggong’s recognition]
[Note: Huang Zhonggong is upright, bold, and insightful, with a loyal character! Music and the path of zither skills are his sole loves in life.
You impressed him with your zither skills and outshone him in the Seven-string Invisible Sword, leaving him questioning life and deeply amazed!]
An achievement medal in hand.
Ding Ling knew his chances were solid.
Sure enough.
Subsequently, Huang Zhonggong imparted all his knowledge to Ding Ling without reservation.
It was clear.
Huang Zhonggong, much like Tong Yuan, would hold nothing back from those he recognized!
Following that.
Ding Ling learned all of Huang Zhonggong’s martial arts.
This included some lower-tier palm techniques, fist techniques, sword techniques, and inner power techniques.
As well as some higher-tier sword techniques and inner power techniques.
The lower-tier ones could only enhance Ding Ling’s foundation and not his power directly.
The high-tier sword technique was the "Seven Extremes Sword"
Also, a sound-based killing technique.
With a trembling sword edge, the sound killing technique could disrupt the opponent’s inner power, creating a chance to strike them down.
[Seven Extremes Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
Ding Ling practiced, and the sword technique was dreamy and illusionary, echoing with the sound, while Huang Zhonggong felt an unrest, prompting him to shout:
"That’s enough, that’s enough."
He was filled with admiration, as if gazing upon a mountain:
"Though much older than you, in cultivation terms, I must admit, I’m utterly surpassed by you."
He gazed brightly at Ding Ling:
"How is the Seven Extremes Inner Power I taught you? Can you cultivate it?"
Ding Ling nodded, then closed his eyes slightly, recollecting.
A book materialized on the library shelf.
[Seven Extremes Inner Power Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
In an instant!
Boom!
A torrent of primordial qi surged forth.
Ding Ling sat amidst the qi streams, breathing deeply, his strength rising noticeably with the naked eye.
Huang Zhonggong was dumbfounded, mumbling:
"Unbelievable, unbelievable, how can such a prodigy exist in this world!"
He could tell that Ding Ling already had outstanding inner power cultivation.
Would he really be able to cultivate the inner power that was taught to him?
This wouldn’t cause his meridians to clash, his inner strength to lose control, leaving him deranged, paralyzed, or dead?
He looked at Ding Ling with some concern.
It’s rare for someone to cultivate more than one type of inner power.
Typical cultivation.
Progresses steadily.
Following a lineage of cultivation techniques.
For example, inner power.
Progresses from basic inner power of the sect, to more potent inner power, and finally, to the strongest heart technique.

These inner powers generally have consistent attributes, and the meridian paths are interconnected, so transitioning between them doesn’t affect progress but enhances strength with a new, stronger heart technique.
But if one cultivates two entirely different inner powers.
It’s like water and fire meeting, like enemies clashing.
Absolutely a heavenly thunder sparking a raging fire, impossible to control!
Ding Ling’s inner power attribute is pure yang.
While the Seven Extremes’ inner power attribute is water!
One is fire, the other is water.
How can they merge?
If both were pure yang.
Huang Zhonggong wouldn’t be this apprehensive!
Yet one is water and the other fire, leaving him nervous and regretful: "If a prodigious talent like Ding Ling truly encounters a mishap, I would indeed be guilty beyond redemption."
Under Huang Zhonggong’s worried gaze.
Ding Ling’s inner power value surged to 300.
Without stopping there.
After reaching 300 points.
Ding Ling perceived his inner strength had reached the pinnacle of a first-class expert!
To advance further, he must break the shackles and open the Ren and Du Meridians!
Only then could he hope to achieve a greater path.
"With my Eight Meridians Connected, I can now skip this stage directly."
Ding Ling felt a stirring excitement and focused intensely.
As an endless tide of primordial qi poured in.
Ding Ling clearly sensed.
Although the inner power value did not increase beyond 300, the quality of the inner strength was undergoing transformation.
Previously, the inner power was vague, like air, invisible, only vaguely perceptible.
But now.
The streams of energy were wildly circulating through the Eight Extraordinary Meridians, constantly pouring into the Dantian.
The Dantian space was limited.
Before long, it was filled to capacity.
Then it began compressing to the extreme!
The invisible streams of energy gradually became visible.
As the streams became clearer, they twisted into threads, spiraling into a sphere, finally coalescing with a boom into a drop of water.
Ding Ling’s body shuddered.
He felt like he had broken through some barrier.
Entering a mysterious realm beyond comprehension.
He glanced at the character panel.
[Inner Power Value 301]
He broke past 300.
Indeed, he had transcended the first-class realm.
This feeling...
Ding Ling contemplated deeply.
It was as if he had leaped from a fish to a dragon, escaping the confining sea and soaring to the sky with a mighty roar!
Ding Ling opened his eyes.
Zing!
Two beams of light shot from his eyes, like swords ringing through the void.
Huang Zhonggong was stunned, his scalp tingling, and his pupils dilated in speechless awe.
Others who heard the commotion also rushed in.
Witnessing the scene.
Each of them was either in disbelief;

chapters.title: Chapter 323: Splashing Ink and Wearing Hemp Swordsmanship Full Level
paragraphs: Or shouting loudly;
Or turning pale in fright;
Or seemingly lost in thought;
Or in utmost admiration;
The myriad forms of life, endless and varied.
Lin Pingzhi and Qu Feiyan watched from the side with great pride, for this was their master (Brother Ding)!
"Hoo!"
Ding Ling rose to his feet, and bowed to Huang Zhonggong in gratitude.
Huang Zhonggong awoke from his daze and quickly helped Ding Ling up, saying both with gratification and shame:
"Alas, comparing myself to you, I feel that I’ve lived my life as a dog these past decades. You are truly an extraordinary prodigy, beyond the imagination of ordinary people like us."
He was stunned and bewildered!
His mind was buzzing!
He was utterly unable to remain calm or composed; had he been younger, he might have been struck into isolation by Ding Ling!
Too formidable!
Simply not human!
"Brother, what exactly happened?"
Hei Baizi slightly changed his expression, took two somewhat unnatural steps forward, and said:

"During our wait outside, why did we suddenly hear flute sounds, then suffer sharp pain in our dantian and meridians, as if being cut by knives and swords? Not long after, we heard clanging sounds. What exactly happened during this period?!"
"Let me tell you!"
With a face full of emotion, Huang Zhonggong stroked his beard and explained the sequence of events.
Hei Baizi, Dan Qingsheng, and Tubi Elder listened as if hearing a celestial tale, with faces full of doubt!
Xiaang Wentian felt relieved, but secretly thought:

"Ding Ling, this young brother is indeed born as the Martial God! Both the Pure Yang True Skill and Absorption Technique reached Great Perfection quickly. Unexpectedly, he learned the unimaginable Seven-string Invisible Sword with such speed and momentum. So strong. If Sect Leader Ren can enlist such a strong person, unifying Jianghu and intimidating the world would be a matter of time!"
His heart burned like fire.
The desire to recruit Ding Ling grew stronger.
"Truly worthy of Brother Ding."
Qu Feiyan gazed at Ding Ling with deep admiration, her almond-shaped eyes shimmering, seemingly unwilling to shift her gaze for life.
Lin Pingzhi had long regarded Ding Ling as a deity, and at present, needed no further words.
"Is he truly so extraordinary?"
Dan Qingsheng, Hei Baizi, and Tubi Elder were somewhat incredulous. Hei Baizi even questioned on the spot:
"Brother, you aren’t being deceived by Ding Ling, are you?! How can a person be so formidable!"
Dan Qingsheng and Tubi Elder unconsciously nodded.
This truly shattered their worldview.
Accepting it.
Very difficult!
Huang Zhonggong understood, said no more, and with the intention to fulfill Ding Ling, stroked his beard and smiled:
"If you don’t believe, feel free to teach your supreme skills to Ding Ling and see if it’s true."
Dan Qingsheng, youthful and impetuous, yet highly trusting of Huang Zhonggong, seeing his elder brother so highly praise Ding Ling, immediately offered:

"I have a set of Splashing Ink and Wearing Hemp Swordsmanship, self-created by integrating a hundred family sword techniques. If you can learn it after one reading, I’ll teach you all my supreme skills."
"It’s a deal."
Huang Zhonggong’s eyes subtly brightened, resolutely said.
"It’s a deal."
Dan Qingsheng nodded.
Huang Zhonggong thus ceded the inner room, letting Dan Qingsheng enter to teach the technique.
Before long.
Dan Qingsheng’s exclamations came from the inner room, while Xiaang Wentian, Hei Baizi, Tubi Elder, and others listened with bated breath, clearly hearing the clanging sounds of sword edges.
Needless to say.
It must be that Dan Qingsheng’s Splashing Ink and Wearing Hemp Swordsmanship had been learned by Ding Ling.
They couldn’t help but look at each other, momentarily unsure of what to say.
Inner room.
Ding Ling had indeed learned the Splashing Ink and Wearing Hemp Swordsmanship.
[Splashing Ink and Wearing Hemp Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
Clearly high tier sword technique.
No inferior to the Seven Extremes Swordsmanship.
And Ding Ling suspected Dan Qingsheng of raising his own reputation!
How could he have self-created such an extraordinary sword skill?
"Impressive."
Dan Qingsheng praised, clapped, slightly blushed:
"Even I haven’t reached the Great Perfection mastery level with Splashing Ink and Wearing Hemp Swordsmanship, yet you have. I am ashamed."
Just this sentence.
Exposed that his Splashing Ink and Wearing Hemp Swordsmanship was certainly not his creation.
Likely similar to Huang Zhonggong, merely consolidating his learned skills into the core of this sword technique, then claiming self-creation.
Because Ding Ling discovered this sword technique’s core criteria were extraordinary.
Yet Dan Qingsheng added numerous other sword moves into it, seeming somewhat chaotic, completely opposite to its core sword technique.
Very clearly.
Dan Qingsheng practiced Splashing Ink and Wearing Hemp Swordsmanship wrongly.
Ding Ling did not point this out.
Exposing another’s scars is tantamount to hitting someone on the face.
This is unethical.
Especially when the other party is a person teaching you techniques.
If they were a bad person, an enemy, Ding Ling wouldn’t adhere to ethics and etiquette, but Dan Qingsheng didn’t provoke him, so naturally, Ding Ling wouldn’t pointlessly uncover someone’s scars.
"All right."
Dan Qingsheng coughed dryly, seemingly to mask his embarrassment:
"Next, I’ll teach you my Inner Power Heart Method and other sword skills. How much you can learn depends on your comprehension."
"Thank you."
Ding Ling expressed his gratitude solemnly.
Dan Qingsheng waved his hand, then started demonstrating sword moves and explaining the core heart technique and mantra.
Basically, as soon as he finished speaking and demonstrating.
Ding Ling’s Divine Skill automatically reached full level.
Under Dan Qingsheng’s expression of existential doubt and shock, Ding Ling breezed through, mastering over ten sword skills at full level.
Leaving Ding Ling feeling slightly regretful.
Those sword skills were low tier and middle tier, only enhancing foundation, unable to improve Four-dimensional Attribute Points!
Granted, still quite precious.
And through these sword skills, Ding Ling confirmed Dan Qingsheng randomly added unrelated sword moves into Splashing Ink and Wearing Hemp Swordsmanship.
Of course. He must have thought it wonderfully praiseworthy!
But upon seeing Ding Ling demonstrably execute Splashing Ink and Wearing Hemp Swordsmanship.
He awkwardly seemed to want to find a hole to hide in.
Now Ding Ling effortlessly wielded over ten sword skills, each displaying the Sword Master’s elegance, further making Dan Qingsheng blush with embarrassment.
He no longer doubted Ding Ling’s talent and aptitude.
Instead, after offering praise.
Then taught his Inner Power Heart Method.
Only once.
[White Rainbow Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
Instantly!
Boom!
Raging Primordial Qi surged like tidal waves!
Ding Ling sat cross-legged.
With each breath!
Two white strands flowed from his nostrils.
His entire aura visibly soared at an exaggerated pace!
Dan Qingsheng’s mind raced, mouth agape, chin seemed ready to drop to the ground, utterly shocked, unable to contain himself!
Though prepared mentally.
Yet truly seeing his decades of painstakingly practiced Inner Power Heart Technique.

The myriad forms of life, endless and varied.

chapters.title: Chapter 324: Different World Rules
paragraphs: But Ding Ling effortlessly cultivated to the realm of Great Perfection in an instant.
Dan Qingsheng still couldn’t stay calm or composed.
To put it plainly.
It’s like someone toiling for a hundred years to earn five million, while someone else wins five million with a lottery ticket!
Can the heart stay balanced?
Can there be no sense of disparity?!
Even with mental preparation, this huge sense of disparity, under such a strong contrast, is still deadly!
Feeling as if struck by lightning is perfectly normal.
[Achievement Medal Earned: You have gained Dan Qingsheng’s deep recognition.]
[Note: Dan Qingsheng, being a smooth operator adept at riding with the tide, is equally self-confident and proud. He considers himself a top genius in painting and sword techniques!
However, your appearance has thoroughly and mercilessly shattered his pride! It made him truly realize what it means to be an unparalleled prodigy!]
Upon hearing the prompt.
Ding Ling knew it was secure.
Exhaling deeply, all the Primordial Qi got absorbed and refined within his Dantian.
He felt the drop of water in his Dantian becoming heavier and more rounded, as if it were about to split into a second drop at any moment.
Ding Ling slightly sensed his own Inner Strength.
Indeed, he had grown much stronger!
"Have I progressed to the Innate Realm of martial arts fiction?"
Ding Ling pondered:
"If that’s the case. Why does this First-class Inner Power Heart Method still work on me?"
According to the usual process.
Once reaching the Third-class Inner Strength level.
Third-class Inner Power immediately loses its effect.
At the Second-class Inner Strength level.
Second-class Inner Power does not lose effect immediately, but after reaching the First-class realm, it still becomes useless.
Because Huang Zhonggong had previously taught Ding Ling Second-class Inner Power.
Ding Ling had tried it.
It only increased his foundation.
"It seems that this First-class Inner Power might also lose its effect soon?"
Ding Ling contemplated:
"If the First-class Inner Power also becomes ineffective, where can I find Innate Level Inner Power?!"
Ding Ling estimated that it shouldn’t happen too quickly.
If it were to lose effect.
It would be the ordinary First-class Inner Power to lose effect first, followed by the more profound First-class Inner Power.
The reason is simple.
"Because these profound First-class Inner Powers can step into the Innate Level Heart Techniques. So strictly speaking, they are essentially Innate Level Inner Powers."
Ding Ling breathed a sigh of relief.
"It seems that in the future, I must collect Inner Powers that are high-tier within the high-tier."
The only Inner Powers that can elevate one to Innate Level cultivation.
Are truly useful to Ding Ling!
Only then can Ding Ling rapidly grow stronger.
Why, despite having such high-tier Techniques, have Huang Zhonggong and others been unable to step into the Innate Realm?
It can only be said that...

"In a world of diversities, even with the same master and same Techniques, some become First-class experts while others remain Third-class. Whether one can step into Innate depends on talent, bone structure, and the height of this world’s shackles!"
Ding Ling felt this very distinctly.
If not for his own breakthroughs.
The world’s constraints would have been enough to leave him stuck at the peak of the First-class, unable to step into the Innate Realm! Because his innate bones are too ordinary!
For others wanting to step into the Innate Realm, it’s not impossible, but extremely difficult!
"Therefore, am I already standing at the pinnacle of this world? Ready to break through the void at any moment?"
Ding Ling’s brow twitched, suddenly realizing that unknowingly, he had already reached the world’s summit!
"It seems that after completing the task, I will be able to leave this world. It’s just strange. Why doesn’t this world have Celestial Might?"
Ding Ling was somewhat puzzled.
But then he didn’t think much of it.
Every world is different.
Some worlds have the favor of fate and Celestial Might, while others naturally do not!
Not long after.
Dan Qingsheng walked out from the inner hall.
Facing the inquiring eyes of Hei Baizi and others.
Under Huang Zhonggong’s gaze, Dan Qingsheng didn’t dare to lie and told the truth, word for word.
Everyone was naturally shaken and astonished.
Afterwards.
Huang Zhonggong signaled Tubi Elder to impart a few things.
By now, Tubi Elder was convinced that Ding Ling’s talent was truly unrivaled in the world and, seeing Huang Zhonggong’s high regard for Ding Ling, was determined to help Ding Ling grow.
His thoughts turned, and realizing Ding Ling’s genius, he knew it was a golden opportunity; better to hold on now than later.
He was decisive.
Entering the inner hall, he imparted all the supreme skills one by one.
As expected.
Ding Ling achieved Full Level in all.
With only the Four-dimensional Attributes slightly increased due to mastering a high-tier calligraphy style.
The Inner Power Value also increased by +100.
The drop of water in his Dantian became increasingly heavy, solid, and resilient.
Ding Ling gently clenched his fist.
He could feel the surging Inner Power coursing through his palm, as if it could burst forth like a rushing waterfall at any moment.
"Now I am growing stronger and stronger. This feeling is truly exhilarating."
After the Eight Meridians Connected.
Ding Ling’s cultivation could be described as advancing by leaps and bounds.
With further cultivation of Inner Power.
Everything was smooth, with no obstacles.
When he walked out of the inner hall once more.
Everyone could clearly feel the change in Ding Ling’s aura!
Each one couldn’t help but change their countenance.
Feeling that the most extraordinary things they had experienced in their lives paled in comparison to what they witnessed today!
They were truly left astounded, witnessing the extraordinary!
"Hahaha..."
Huang Zhonggong laughed, stroking his beard, and said:
"Ding Ling, congratulations. Now your cultivation is not necessarily unprecedented, but certainly unparalleled. It’s likely that even Ren Woxing, who once dominated, is no longer a match for you!"
Hearing Huang Zhonggong elevating Ding Ling.
And belittling Ren Woxing.
Xiāng Wentian was visibly displeased, but he was deep-minded, knowing it’s crucial not to make a mess now, so he just watched quietly from the side.
Suffice it to say, he was also frustrated.
Originally, bringing Ding Ling over was to utilize him, to maneuver him in completing the task and rescuing someone.
Unexpectedly, Ding Ling was so brave and bold, taking immediate charge, gaining the high regard of Huang Zhonggong and others.
Logically, this was good.
But for some reason.
Xiāng Wentian always felt a vague unease.
"Second brother. What do you think?"
Huang Zhonggong looked at Hei Baizi.
Hei Baizi now found himself in a dilemma, feeling torn between choices.
He was frustrated and regretful.

Frustrated because Huang Zhonggong and the others didn’t think before acting, passing on supreme skills so freely! Even if Ding Ling’s Zither Skill and other talents are truly unrivaled, they shouldn’t commit to it so recklessly! Surely some days of consideration would be wise?

Regretful because of his previous petty and short-sighted behavior, comparing it to Huang Zhonggong and others left him feeling petty. If he now decided to collaborate, wouldn’t it make him seem foolish and selfish?
But having come this far.
Huang Zhonggong and his brothers all taught him. If he didn’t, wouldn’t it offend everyone even more?

chapters.title: Chapter 325: Profound Celestial Finger Technique—Condensing Water into Ice! True Power Value
paragraphs: Hei Baizi sighed inwardly, bit his teeth, and could only agree to pass on the technique.
He didn’t want to offend Ding Ling to death either.
Moreover, he was very curious about the Breathing Technique that could shatter the void and wanted to explore its secrets.
Now that it had come to this point, he went along with the tide and agreed, planning to ask Ding Ling for the Breathing Technique later. Ding Ling wouldn’t refuse, would he?
Thinking this way.
He then entered the inner room with Ding Ling to begin teaching the technique.
He first taught the ’Profound Celestial Finger,’ wanting to test Ding Ling’s depth.
Many times.
Many things are difficult to truly be convinced of without personal probing and experiencing.
He said it once without explaining, because when he asked if an explanation was needed, Ding Ling actually said no!
No one to guide.
No matter how exceptionally talented, could one learn it by hearing it just once?!
His zombie-like face fixedly looked at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.
As a book condensed out from the library.
[Profound Celestial Finger Technique Full Level]
[Power +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.4]
This is clearly an Absolute Peak Level finger technique among High Tier techniques.
Constitution actually added 0.4.
It speaks volumes.

Ding Ling opened his eyes, flicked his finger gently, and a chill shot out from his fingertip, astonishingly transforming into a silk-like stream that instantly froze the water in a teacup three meters away!
"Hiss!"
Hei Baizi saw this and couldn’t help but draw a breath of cold air, his gaze towards Ding Ling filled with shock and awe.
[Achievement Medal obtained: Intimidating Hei Baizi.]

[Annotation: Hei Baizi is self-pitying, arrogant, vain, selfish. His life’s proudest Supreme Skill is the Profound Celestial Finger Technique! Because once this technique is employed, few in the world can counter it.
He also believed that to master this Finger Technique, one must, like him, undergo decades of hard work.
However, you succeeded in cultivating it in a matter of breaths!
This is like an arrow piercing straight into his heart, causing both shock and profound awe towards you!
If time could flow backward, his attitude towards you would definitely change drastically! He certainly wouldn’t haggle with you!]
Adding the Achievement Medal ’gained Tubi Elder’s recognition’ not long ago.
Ding Ling already earned 4 Achievement Medals at West Lake Mei Manor.
Ding Ling glanced at the teacup not far away.
He pondered:
"This Profound Celestial Finger is indeed extraordinary. It can transform Inner Strength into Frost Finger Qi, a single strike can freeze everything! Of course, I’m not at that level yet.
But as an Innate Realm cultivator.
A single strike can easily freeze the water in a teacup three meters away from me.
Now, saying I’m invincible in the world. Might not be an exaggeration.
Even if Dongfang Bubai comes.
I won’t fear!"
Ding Ling’s confidence surged.
Extremely high physical attributes! Four Great Breathing Techniques Full Level!
Inner Strength advancing to Innate.
Various Ultimate Skills in his arsenal!
Plus the explosive effect produced by the fusion of Inner Strength and Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi, Ding Ling indeed had the capital to dominate the world!
Ding Ling’s heart was tumultuous and unsettled.
He forcibly restrained himself, looked at Hei Baizi, signaling to continue.
Regarding Hei Baizi.
Ding Ling naturally didn’t have much favorable impression.
But Hei Baizi indeed imparted Cultivation Technique to him, and after that, he was also quite respectful! Cautious!
Thus.
Considering the feelings of Huang Zhonggong and others.
Ding Ling naturally didn’t bother to haggle with Hei Baizi, only thought of completing this transaction and distancing himself from Hei Baizi as much as possible.
[Inner Power Value +100]
After Hei Baizi taught all his palm and sword techniques to Ding Ling, he further imparted his exclusive Inner Power technique.
Unexpectedly.
His palm and sword techniques were all Low Tier, Middle Tier Martial Arts, which only enhanced Ding Ling’s foundation and couldn’t increase the four-dimensional attributes.
But his exclusive Inner Power technique could also advance to the Innate Realm technique.
After Ding Ling learned it, Inner Power Value increased again.
Sitting cross-legged on the ground, he absorbed and refined all the surging Primordial Qi.
Crack!
The drop of water in Ding Ling’s Dantian surprisingly split into two drops.
Checking the Inner Power Value again, it had surprisingly changed too:
[True Power Value: 2 points]
"It actually turned into True Power Value and only a mere 2 points!"
Ding Ling pondered:
"Although Inner Strength is vast and terrifyingly numerous, compared to True Power, it’s not condensed enough. To put it simply..."
Inner Strength is like cotton.
True Power is like steel!
There is an essential difference!
Cotton is fluffy, so it seems to have a large value.
Steel is condensed, naturally making its value appear smaller.
"I see."
Ding Ling felt relieved.
At first, he was also shocked by the Inner Power Value +100.
After all, the four-dimensional attributes for physical body aspects are all increased by 0.1.
Now it seems.
Inner Strength, physical body, and True Power are completely different.
The values naturally cannot be compared or contrasted.
"True Power only has 2 points."
"But when unleashed, it’s extremely terrifying."
As the power surged once more.
Ding Ling could profoundly feel the fearsome aspect of True Power.
It can be said.
The amount of True Power a person has will determine whether he can crush other Innate Experts!
As for those below Innate?
There’s no comparison.
Once an Innate Expert’s True Power is unleashed, Inner Strength will shatter instantly.
"Bai Wushuang seems to use Inner Strength too. But her Inner Strength is extremely condensed, as if she’ll break through anytime, probably a Half-Step Innate Expert."
Ding Ling thought of Bai Wushuang, who seemed like Dongfang Bubai.
As his power progressed to the True Power two-point level.
Ding Ling could already clearly discern Bai Wushuang’s cultivation.
She was just one step away from Innate.
Theoretically, Bai Wushuang was just a First-class Peak expert.
Only her Inner Strength is more grandiose and fierce! Ordinary First-class Peak experts wouldn’t be her match!
Previously when the two fought.
Bai Wushuang clearly didn’t use full strength.
Ding Ling pondered:
"At the Huashan Peak, perhaps you will have no choice but to use full strength. By then, your Tai Chi Scripture will be mine."
Regarding the Tai Chi Scripture.
Ding Ling especially wanted to see it.
After all, it’s the handwritten work of the Martial Arts Realm’s Mount Tai Beidou Zhang Sanfeng!
Ding Ling stayed at West Lake Mei Manor for three days.
During the three days.
Ding Ling imparted skills like Zither Skill, calligraphy, painting skills, etc., to Huang Zhonggong and others.
Three days later.
Huang Zhonggong and others sighed repeatedly, sweating with shame:

"We taught Ding Ling for only a short moment, but Ding Ling you taught us for three days straight. Yet you learned everything completely. We are still in the clouds even now, compared to you, we are truly uncarvable rotten wood!"
Lin Pingzhi listened with self-satisfaction, his mentor’s erudition is celestial, those who dare question will face a humiliating slap without exception.
Qu Feiyan was also unable to contain her excitement, feeling proud.
After Ding Ling’s enlightenment these past days, and night and day guidance in cultivating Martial Arts, Breathing Technique, Inner Power, etc.
Qu Feiyan gradually emerged from the sorrow.
She was extremely clever and perceptive with impressive comprehension; any Martial Arts she grasped instantly.
She was playful earlier, unwilling to spend time learning.

He didn’t want to offend Ding Ling to death either.
Moreover, he was very curious about the Breathing Technique that could shatter the void and wanted to explore its secrets.
Now that it had come to this point, he went along with the tide and agreed, planning to ask Ding Ling for the Breathing Technique later.

Thinking this way.
He then entered the inner room with Ding Ling to begin teaching the technique.
He first taught the ’Profound Celestial Finger,’ wanting to test Ding Ling’s depth.
Many times.
Many things are difficult to truly be convinced of without personal probing and experiencing.
He said it once without explaining, because when he asked if an explanation was needed, Ding Ling actually said no!
No one to guide.
No matter how exceptionally talented, could one learn it by hearing it just once?!
His zombie-like face fixedly looked at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.

[Power +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]

This is clearly an Absolute Peak Level finger technique among High Tier techniques.
Constitution actually added 0.4.
It speaks volumes.

If time could flow backward, his attitude towards you would definitely change drastically!

Might not be an exaggeration.

I won’t fear!"
Ding Ling’s confidence surged.

Four Great Breathing Techniques Full Level!
Inner Strength advancing to Innate.
Various Ultimate Skills in his arsenal!
Plus the explosive effect produced by the fusion of Inner Strength and Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi, Ding Ling indeed had the capital to dominate the world!

Cautious!
Thus.
Considering the feelings of Huang Zhonggong and others.

Unexpectedly.

Crack!

chapters.title: Chapter 326: Deal Reached (10/10)
paragraphs: Qu Yang also wouldn’t criticize too much, just let her be.
This caused Qu Feiyan to waste a lot of time.
And now Qu Yang has already passed away.
Her only attachment is Ding Ling, being influenced by those around, seeing Ding Ling so obsessed with the Martial Dao, she couldn’t help but become interested too.
Unexpectedly, she learned from Ding Ling’s mouth that he might soon shatter the void and leave this world, which made her extremely anxious, panicked, and uneasy.
How could she dare waste time?
She practiced diligently day and night, asking Ding Ling whenever she didn’t understand something.

Ding Ling was well-versed in the supreme skills passed down from Qu Feiyan’s family, offering guidance from a strategic height, naturally able to hit the core points every time, and Qu Feiyan was also remarkably perceptive.
So during this period.
Qu Feiyan’s martial skills progressed extraordinarily fast.
Regarding this.
Ding Ling was silently impressed.
If Qu Feiyan doesn’t die, needless to say, the heroine of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer would likely be her!
Smart, wise, good-natured, gifted, perceptive—absolutely top-notch!
How could such a girl not excel?
That same day.
After Ding Ling taught Huang Zhonggong and a few others, Xiang Wentian finally couldn’t hold back, and that night he entered Ding Ling’s room, again bringing up the matter of Ren Woxing.
Initially, Xiang Wentian hadn’t planned to bring it up.

Later, knowing too many people were aware of Ren Woxing being imprisoned in West Lake Mei Manor, he realized it couldn’t be hidden from Ding Ling, and deliberately hiding it might even cause Ding Ling to become resentful, leading to hostility.
Not wanting to backfire, Xiang Wentian truthfully explained everything to Ding Ling.
And so it was now:
"If we don’t rescue him this time, we might never have the chance again. Besides, I asked you here because I hope you will rescue Sect Leader Ren!"
"But my master didn’t promise you that he would definitely rescue Ren Woxing."
Lin Pingzhi retorted.
Xiang Wentian’s expression changed, looking at Lin Pingzhi with displeasure. Were it not for Ding Ling’s presence, he certainly would have slapped Lin Pingzhi away; truly hitting where it hurts:
"But Ding Ling, you know as well. I’ve passed nearly all my supreme skills on to you. If you don’t rescue Sect Leader Ren, how would that be justified?"
"Xiang Left Envoy’s words are somewhat exaggerated."
Qu Feiyan interjected crisply from the side:
"Your supreme skills are as vast as the sea, and yet you’ve only given my Brother Ding two manuals and claim to have imparted all your skills. Don’t you find your words rather absurd?
If you’re this insincere, how can you expect my Brother Ding to help you?"
Having been retorted by Lin Pingzhi, then by Qu Feiyan.
Xiang Wentian now regretted not having help; one mouth can’t contest three. He could only look gloomily at Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling, what do you say?"
"Tomorrow morning I’ll talk to Huang Zhonggong and the others.
Ding Ling gave Xiang Wentian a deep look, making him a bit uneasy, then said:
"I will try my best to lead Ren Woxing out of the cage. As for what happens afterward, it’s up to you."
"Thank you."
Xiang Wentian rose solemnly, giving thanks.
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"It’s just an exchange of benefits. As Xiang Left Envoy said, you gave me a secret manual, I lead Ren Woxing out of the cage. From then on, we’re even."
Xiang Wentian opened his mouth, as if to say something, but for a moment couldn’t figure out where to start, so he could only sigh, cupped his hands, and took his leave.

He prided himself on his cleverness and wisdom, but in front of Ding Ling, he always felt like there was strength with nowhere to use it, like a sharp spear facing an ocean, only able to ’sigh with admiration’.
After leaving Ding Ling’s room, he thought:
"I hope after Sect Leader Ren comes out tomorrow, he can personally subdue Ding Ling. With my abilities, I really can’t manage to intimidate Ding Ling to work for Sect Leader Ren."
Ding Ling’s martial prowess, while not earth-shattering, was definitely rare at present.
Xiang Wentian admitted to himself that he wasn’t a match.
So he naturally could only rely on Ren Woxing.
In his view.

Ren Woxing’s Star Absorption Technique was truly bizarre and impressive; no matter how powerful Ding Ling was, once the Star Absorption Technique got close, and all his inner strength got sucked clean, how could he not be subdued?
The next morning.
Ding Ling indeed went to find Huang Zhonggong, bringing up the matter of Ren Woxing.
Huang Zhonggong’s expression slightly changed, instinctively refusing:
"No, I can’t let him leave here."
Having said this.
He looked at Ding Ling, smiling wryly:
"It seems you already know everything."
He sighed:
"From the moment so many people started visiting West Lake Mei Manor, I knew this couldn’t be hidden. Truly, you also came for Ren Woxing."
"No."
Ding Ling said solemnly:
"I actually came for the Manor Masters. As for Ren Woxing? What I care about is merely his Star Absorption Technique. I don’t really care what kind of person he is."
He pointed outside:
"I’m rescuing Ren Woxing due to an exchange of interests with Xiang Left Envoy; by bringing out Ren Woxing, I completely cut ties with Xiang Left Envoy."
"Xiang Left Envoy? Xiang Wentian!"
"That’s right."
"So if we don’t hand over Ren Woxing, Xiang Wentian and you will cause trouble at Mei Manor?"
"No."
Ding Ling said solemnly:
"I have great respect for the senior masters and would never do such a thing. I’m just thinking, Xiang Wentian and the others have been scheming to rescue Ren Woxing.
No matter how good the defense, it’s hard to prevent an enemy from exploiting a gap.
Why not take this opportunity to release Ren Woxing.
With me here, he wouldn’t dare act recklessly. Afterward, I’ll find a chance to personally go to Black Wood Cliff to discuss clearly with Dongfang Bubai.
Let him pardon your offenses.
I won’t let it be difficult for you."
"This..."
Huang Zhonggong hesitated.
He held Ding Ling in high regard.
And he was very clear about Ding Ling’s strength; in his opinion, Ding Ling’s cultivation was certainly unmatched, incomparable by anyone.
Coupled with the communication and interaction these past days with Ding Ling.
How could he not see that Ding Ling was a bold and courageous person?
Once he made a decision, it was hard to change.
To truly oppose Ding Ling?
Huang Zhonggong was absolutely unwilling to face this, thus, after considering for a while, he said:
"I can cooperate with you. But I have no way to explain to Sect Leader Dongfang."
"If the senior masters don’t mind, you could release Ren Woxing and wander the Jianghu with me."
"I’m too old to wish for such drifting."
Huang Zhonggong sighed:
"But if it’s with you, Ding Ling, then it might be a different story."
He seemed to think of something, said:
"You’ve been teaching me some supreme skills for several days, and I haven’t learned them. Wandering the Jianghu with you is a perfect way to continue learning from you."
"That is only natural."
Ding Ling said loudly:
"I shall teach without reserve."
"Haha..."
Huang Zhonggong laughed heartily twice, stood up, and said with a sigh:
"Let’s go. I will accompany you to see Ren Woxing."
More and more people knew Ren Woxing was at West Lake Mei Manor.
Increasing numbers wished to rescue Ren Woxing.
Huang Zhonggong had been guarding Ren Woxing for many years.
He had long been weary in his heart.
With Ding Ling and Xiang Wentian joining forces, considering Ding Ling’s promise, and the supreme skills Ding Ling still hadn’t learned, he might as well go along with it.

chapters.title: Chapter 327: Ren Woxing
paragraphs: Dan Qingsheng, Hei Baizi, Tubi Elder and the others waited outside.
Seeing Ding Ling and Huang Zhonggong coming out from inside, Dan Qingsheng glanced inquisitively.
Huang Zhonggong did not hide the truth from these brothers and spoke frankly.

Hei Baizi’s face changed dramatically, instinctively wanting to shout in protest, but when he saw Ding Ling’s deep gaze, he felt a natural fear, and the words that were about to come out swallowed back down.
From their interaction these days, Hei Baizi has already understood the difference between himself and Huang Zhonggong and the others.
Ding Ling treated Huang Zhonggong and others with warmth like a spring breeze, providing detailed explanations and discussing philosophies.
But towards him, the treatment was lukewarm and passive, explanations seemed like completing tasks, not making the effort to explain thoroughly.
Such distinct treatment.
Naturally, it was because his earlier attitude had angered Ding Ling. Had he not realized later, it couldn’t be said that he and Ding Ling could not walk together.

If he were to oppose Ding Ling now, with Ding Ling aside, Lin Pingzhi and Qu Feiyan would undoubtedly harbor resentment towards him. Just thinking about it made Hei Baizi anxious, so naturally, he extinguished the thought of obstruction.
He didn’t want to offend Ding Ling.
After all, Ding Ling’s cultivation now was at a level he could only look up to!
With a flick of a finger, perhaps he would be extinguished by Ding Ling. He now only wanted to cling tightly to Ding Ling’s powerful leg, how dare he oppose Ding Ling again.
Hei Baizi retreated.
Tubi Elder and Dan Qingsheng already had high recognition for Ding Ling and trusted Huang Zhonggong greatly, naturally following Huang Zhonggong’s lead.
The group immediately made a decision.
To head to the cell where Ren Woxing was held.

Xiaang Wentian was overjoyed, almost unable to contain his laughter, looking at Ding Ling with eyes full of surprise, admiration, and recognition. He knew, if it weren’t for Ding Ling’s intervention, based on his means and prestige, the chance of being swept out by the Four Friends of Mei Mansion would be even greater!
Clop clop!
The group twisted and turned, arriving at the center point on the far left of Mei Manor.
This was the core of the trapping array.

An ordinary person, even knowing the location of Ren Woxing’s detention, facing this trapping array, one careless move, getting locked in, forget about rescuing, whether they could get out themselves would be an issue.
Xiaang Wentian saw the crux of the matter, secretly relieved, yet speechless and helpless:

Dongfang Bubai dispatched a few First-class Experts to guard and detain Sect Leader Ren, which was one thing, but to set up such a complicated array! Forget just Xiaang Wentian, even ten Xiaang Wentians, without solving the array, couldn’t get Sect Leader Ren out!
Having realized this.
He valued Ding Ling even more, deciding that when Ren Woxing came out later, he would immediately explain the whole story to Ren Woxing.
As long as they could timely seize and control Ding Ling.
The path to being invincible and unifying Jianghu.
Might begin from here.
Clop clop!
Click click!

Constantly opening various gates, amidst ear-piercing cackles, entering one passage after another, finally after the last thick iron door opened, Ding Ling and his party finally saw an exquisite cage!
Seated at the bottom of West Lake.
Surrounded on all sides by dead ends.
Only one road leading here!
And even this road was laden with mechanisms, layer upon layer of iron doors!
Even if an average Innate Expert came, facing these mechanisms and iron doors, they could only stare helplessly.
Xiaang Wentian grew more alarmed the more he looked, increasingly glad he did not rashly intrude.
Thud thud!
Huang Zhonggong stepped forward and knocked on the iron door.
No response came.
Huang Zhonggong hesitated for a moment, glanced at Ding Ling, and spoke softly:
"Although Ren Woxing has been trapped in the cage beneath West Lake for over a decade, his energy remains as vigorous as ever! We must be cautious, lest we fall for his trick."
"Give me the key, I’ll open it."
Ding Ling reached out his hand.
Hei Baizi breathed a sigh of relief and promptly handed over the key.
Ding Ling took the key and, under the watchful eyes of Xiaang Wentian and the others, inserted the key into the lock.
Crack!
A crisp sound.
The thick iron door, sealed for years and never opened, unlocked.
Ka-cha-cha!
The iron door was pushed open by Ding Ling’s hand.
And almost the instant it was half open!
Boom!
Suddenly, an immense suction force emanated from the cage, accompanied by a startled shout, Hei Baizi, who was close by, was uncontrollably sucked in.
Huang Zhonggong was shocked, sprang forward, and grabbed Hei Baizi’s ankle.
Yet to no avail, as he too was sucked in.

Ding Ling sensed trouble, shouted aloud, deploying the Cloud-Piercing Step, inner strength activated and amplified, making him seem as though he were stepping on clouds, swiftly arriving before Hei Baizi, casually pushing to send the two flying back, then facing the overwhelming suction alone.
The suction rolled.
Like a twisting tornado storm.
Yet Ding Ling stood immovable as Mount Tai, regardless of how the tornado storm exerted its force, it couldn’t move him a fraction.
With a surprised ’huh’ sound, Ding Ling finally saw the true face of the one who made the move.

The man was dressed in rags, unkempt and dirty, his face pale as snow with not a hint of color, his eyebrows sharp as knives, face dignified and overbearing, though old, still faintly displaying the grace and handsomeness of his former years.
He sat on a stone bed, his eyes like lightning, meeting Ding Ling’s gaze, seemingly sparking some invisible fire.
"Who are you?"
Unable to suck Ding Ling in, he placed his hand on his knee, slightly tilting his head to look at the tall, graceful Ding Ling:
"The four scoundrels of West Lake Mei Manor absolutely couldn’t have someone as strong as you! In Jianghu, I’ve never seen such a remarkable figure as you. Are you a rising star?!"
He lamented:
"I hadn’t expected that my mere detention at the bottom of West Lake for over a decade would give rise to someone so outstanding as you in Jianghu."
For a time.
He couldn’t help but feel somewhat disheartened.
But soon.
Reviving his spirits, his heart quickly turned, thinking:

"Can’t suck in this young man from afar, but being closer might work. If I could absorb this young man’s entire power for myself, I could definitely reach even greater heights, stepping into the absolute peak!"
Thinking thus.
He looked at Ding Ling warmly:
"You opened the prison door, intending to let me out? Or what do you want?"
"Naturally, to let you out."
Ren Woxing was greatly astonished, moved, and changed color:
"Really?!"
Some disbelief lingered.
Xiaang Wentian couldn’t hold back anymore, stepped out from the side, entered the cell, and first made a deep bow to Ren Woxing, then said:
"Sect Leader! It’s true!"
"Xiaang Wentian!"
Ren Woxing instantly recognized Xiaang Wentian, overjoyed:
"It’s you rescuing me?!"
"Frankly speaking, it’s embarrassing."
Xiaang Wentian felt a bit flush:
"Entering here is all thanks to Brother Ding Ling, I dare not claim credit."
"Ding Ling?"
Ren Woxing pointed at Ding Ling:
"Is it him?"
"Exactly."
Xiaang Wentian nodded, his face full of awe and admiration, saying:
"Without Ding Ling’s help, I definitely wouldn’t have reached here."

sentences.text: Dan Qingsheng, Hei Baizi, Tubi Elder and the others waited outside.
Seeing Ding Ling and Huang Zhonggong coming out from inside, Dan Qingsheng glanced inquisitively.
Huang Zhonggong did not hide the truth from these brothers and spoke frankly.

Hei Baizi’s face changed dramatically, instinctively wanting to shout in protest, but when he saw Ding Ling’s deep gaze, he felt a natural fear, and the words that were about to come out swallowed back down.
From their interaction these days, Hei Baizi has already understood the difference between himself and Huang Zhonggong and the others.
Ding Ling treated Huang Zhonggong and others with warmth like a spring breeze, providing detailed explanations and discussing philosophies.

Such distinct treatment.
Naturally, it was because his earlier attitude had angered Ding Ling.
Had he not realized later, it couldn’t be said that he and Ding Ling could not walk together.
If he were to oppose Ding Ling now, with Ding Ling aside, Lin Pingzhi and Qu Feiyan would undoubtedly harbor resentment towards him.
Just thinking about it made Hei Baizi anxious, so naturally, he extinguished the thought of obstruction.
He didn’t want to offend Ding Ling.
After all, Ding Ling’s cultivation now was at a level he could only look up to!
With a flick of a finger, perhaps he would be extinguished by Ding Ling.
He now only wanted to cling tightly to Ding Ling’s powerful leg, how dare he oppose Ding Ling again.
Hei Baizi retreated.
Tubi Elder and Dan Qingsheng already had high recognition for Ding Ling and trusted Huang Zhonggong greatly, naturally following Huang Zhonggong’s lead.

Dongfang Bubai dispatched a few First-class Experts to guard and detain Sect Leader Ren, which was one thing, but to set up such a complicated array!

The path to being invincible and unifying Jianghu.
Might begin from here.
Clop clop!
Click click!

chapters.title: Chapter 328: Star Absorption Technique at Full Level
paragraphs: "Naturally, the Sect Leader won’t be seen."
"What exactly is going on?"
Ren Woxing was bursting with curiosity:
"How could such a formidable figure like Ding Ling suddenly appear in this world? Or is it that there are plenty of young talents like Ding Ling emerging in the Jianghu now?!"
"No."
Xiaang Wentian shook his head:
"Just having one Ding Ling is already beyond everyone’s expectations. How could there be more?! In this world, there’s only one Ding Ling!"
"Phew."
Ren Woxing let out a long breath, and his tensed heart completely relaxed.
He had thought that the Jianghu had drastically changed, and was no longer the Jianghu of the past.
It turned out that only Ding Ling was unique!
Thinking about this.
Ren Woxing’s mind shifted again, pondering:
"Such talent must be used by me! If not, then I must ruin him! If he can’t be used by me, then he’s my enemy. Against enemies, there is no reason to be lenient."
"Sect Leader. Whatever the matter, let’s discuss it outside. Speaking in this prison is inconvenient."
Xiaang Wentian reminded.
"Yes, yes."
Ren Woxing interrupted his thoughts, snapped back, and quickly said:
"First, unlock my handcuffs and leg shackles."
Xiaang Wentian asked Ding Ling for the key and personally unlocked Ren Woxing.
After regaining freedom.
Ren Woxing raised his head and let out a long roar, happiness filled his heart to the extreme:
"I’ve finally gained my freedom."

He glanced at Ding Ling, then at the Four Friends of Mei Manor behind Ding Ling. Seeing Ding Ling maintain an indifferent gaze fixed on him, he felt somewhat displeased. Further, seeing the three among the Four Friends who, despite having some fear, could still calmly look at him, he became even angrier, thinking:

"I’ve been imprisoned here for over ten years. Hei Baizi, this scoundrel, always trying to steal my Star Absorption Technique, deserves death! The other three have trapped and locked me for over ten years, accomplices of Dongfang Bubai!
If they submit later, that’s fine.
If they dare defy me.
I’ll kill them on the spot! To ease the hatred in my heart!"
Thinking like this.
Ren Woxing also indicated without a sound that he wanted to leave this underwater prison first.
Staying here.
Ren Woxing felt insecure.
Better to go outside first.
Xiaang Wentian looked at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling nodded.
Xiaang Wentian then personally led Ren Woxing out first, and Ding Ling and the others watched without obstructing.
Huang Zhonggong was deeply worried, sighing repeatedly.
Hei Baizi, however, was frightened by Ren Woxing’s glance, decided firmly to stick close to Ding Ling, otherwise he would definitely die miserably.
The door had just opened wide.
Ding Ling was nearby, but the Star Absorption Technique couldn’t affect Ding Ling, yet easily drew Hei Baizi in!
This made Hei Baizi genuinely fear Ren Woxing in his heart!
Meanwhile, his gratitude, recognition, and admiration for Ding Ling surged immensely!
At this point, even if Ding Ling chased him off, he wouldn’t dare leave, he’s determined to cling to Ding Ling for life!
Tap, tap!
Ren Woxing’s footsteps slowly faded away.
Midway, Ren Woxing didn’t turn back to look at Ding Ling and the others, seemingly impatient to re-experience the light of day.
Ding Ling understood this feeling.
Anyone imprisoned in such a dark, gloomy place for over a decade would, upon regaining freedom, immediately want to see the blue sky, clear waters, and flourishing world outside.
Xiaang Wentian closely followed behind Ren Woxing.
Though puzzled why Ding Ling and the others didn’t quickly follow, his mind was fully focused on Ren Woxing, unable to spare effort for Ding Ling and the others.
After Xiaang Wentian and Ren Woxing departed.
Ding Ling went straight to the bedhead.
Picked up the oil lamp for light.
Using his fingers as a sword, with a casual wave.
The Splashing Ink and Wearing Hemp Swordsmanship was displayed, with swordlight gleaming, the mats and grasses covering the bed were swept away, falling to the ground.
By the light of the lamp, Ding Ling clearly saw the lines of characters etched on the slab.

Qu Feiyan closely followed Ding Ling, got close, saw clearly, and couldn’t help being surprised, her gaze shifted, then she pulled Lin Pingzhi, standing at the doorway of the cell, blocking Hei Baizi and the others’ view.

Hei Baizi and the others now have a very complex mood, their gaze constantly chased Ren Woxing, until he could no longer be seen, each one either in silent contemplation, distressed, or looking at Ding Ling.
Among them.
Only Huang Zhonggong seemed to notice Ding Ling.
But he didn’t ask, instead cooperated very well with Qu Feiyan and Lin Pingzhi, pulling Hei Baizi and the others out.
Hei Baizi was wholeheartedly clinging, hurriedly said:
"Where’s Ding Ling? Leaving together with Ding Ling."
Ding Ling scanned the text rapidly.
In just the time it takes for two breaths, he finished reading the Star Absorption Technique.
Soon.
[Star Absorption Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
Rushing primordial qi surged forth, instantly submerging Ding Ling.
With his current strength far surpassing the past, after stepping into the Innate Realm, the efficiency of refining primordial qi sharply increased.
In just a moment, all the primordial qi was refined.
With careful perception.
One could see the second drop of water in the dantian becoming much thicker and heavier. It seemed not far from the second drop of water splitting into a third.
It was merely a surprise and unexpected realization for Ding Ling:
"Doesn’t practicing the Star Absorption Technique require dispersing the skill? Why did I instantly reach full level?"
Recalling that no one in the Three Kingdoms World could successfully practice the two major External Refining Breathing Techniques, while he had successfully practiced three methods now.
Ding Ling was relieved.
Divine Skill Automatic Full Level Cheats cannot be explained by common sense!
Things impossible for ordinary people!
In front of his Automatic Full Level Cheats, all things are possible!

"But although I have successfully practiced the Star Absorption Technique and can use it, it seems my inner power, no, it should be true power, still remains Pure Yang True Power of Pure Yang True Skill."
Clearly.
As it stands.
Inside Ding Ling’s dantian and eight meridians, only one Inner Power Heart Technique could operate.
Perhaps in the future when he fully unblocks every meridian in his body, his physique and dantian might be able to operate two techniques, which is not possible now.
"Would using the Star Absorption Technique cause any side effects?"
Ding Ling thought about the situations described in books and seen on TV.
He felt perfect mastery over various attributes’ inner power would be extremely difficult.

"At the Innate Realm, I only need to acquire high-tier Inner Power Heart Techniques continuously, and once at full level, they can split into drops of true power water, thus continually strengthening!"
"There’s no need to abandon the essential to pursue the trivial, absorbing others’ Inner Power Value!"
Comparing true power.
Inner power is truly weak!
Moreover, after absorbing it.
Ding Ling couldn’t refine others’ inner power.
He lacked the refining method.
To put it simply.
The primordial qi refined into inner power and true power behaves like one’s own arm, easily controlled.
But the refined inner power and true power of others is like someone else’s arm!
How could Ding Ling perfectly use someone else’s arm?!

chapters.title: Chapter 329: Ding Ling vs. Ren Woxing
paragraphs: Let’s not talk about that for now.
Wanting to fuse someone else’s ’arm’ onto your own body, without a special technique, Ding Ling would become a ’freak’, thereby losing control, going astray and dying a violent death.
Therefore.
Absorbing others’ inner strength through the Star Absorption Technique is inadvisable.
Unless it’s like the North Nether Divine Skill which can perfectly refine someone else’s inner strength completely.
But the Star Absorption Technique does not have this function.
Ding Ling also lacks such a technique like the North Nether Divine Skill, so he must abandon the use of the Star Absorption Technique to draw inner strength.
"Truly a tasteless dish."
Ding Ling shook his head but didn’t destroy the Star Absorption Technique.
Anyone who wants to practice this Star Absorption Technique can go ahead!

He considered that the fundamental purpose of using the Star Absorption Technique to enhance his inner strength and thus his ’True Power Value’ had been achieved, so there was no need to stay in this cell any longer.

"According to TV shows and descriptions, it seems Ren Woxing has developed a merging technique, said to resolve side effects. But creating an inner power heart technique is incredibly difficult, as if defying the heavens?
This merging technique might solve immediate troubles. But it must also have side effects!"
The more inner power heart techniques Ding Ling learned,
The deeper his understanding became.
In terms of talent,
He was quite ordinary.
But his foundation was profound, extraordinary, definitely not comparable to Ren Woxing. Even so, Ding Ling didn’t have the ability to create a first-class divine skill either!

So Ding Ling believed the merging technique could never be as superior and remarkable as the North Nether Divine Skill, given that, why would Ding Ling absorb others’ inner strength, leading to impure Pure Yang True Qi and even risk losing control!
He wouldn’t do something as foolish as ’losing a watermelon to pick up a sesame seed’.

"Having Pure Yang True Qi to protect me is already enough. What I need to do now is find more first-class high-tier inner power heart techniques to continuously increase my True Power Value, thus enhancing my cultivation."
Ding Ling’s mind was clear.
After leaving the cell,
Seeing Qu Feiyan and Lin Pingzhi’s actions made him feel gratified. These two, particularly Qu Feiyan, were extremely intelligent. With her helping to fill the gaps, Ding Ling could relax a lot more.
As for the Star Absorption Technique, with such significant flaws, there’s no need to keep it hidden.
Moreover,
This technique is known to Ren Woxing too.
And Huang Zhonggong and others are aware that Ding Ling was observing before the bed. If Ding Ling hid it, wouldn’t it cause them to harbor suspicions?
Hei Baizi was indifferent.

Huang Zhonggong and others, Ding Ling did not want any misunderstanding with them. Thus, after walking over, he explained the matter to Huang Zhonggong and emphasized the flaws of the Star Absorption Technique.
Even so.
After hearing this, Hei Baizi’s eyes lit up, eager to give it a try.
He cupped his hands and eagerly said:
"Hero Ding, I wonder if I could go take a look?"
"If you wish to go, then go." Ding Ling said indifferently.
Anyway, he wouldn’t allow Qu Feiyan or Lin Pingzhi to practice such techniques.

If they were to practice, it would be with top-tier true skills like the Pure Yang True Skill. Practicing a technique like the Star Absorption Technique with terrifying side effects is akin to playing with life and future.
Though the technique of merging and the Muscle-Tendon Changing Classic can adjust and harmonize,
Ding Ling still wouldn’t attempt it.
He could continuously shatter the void, and now he was already a peak-level master in this world. He just needed to complete tasks to venture into other worlds.
He believed that such experiences would only become more frequent in the future.
Therefore, some inappropriate techniques, Ding Ling at most would level them up for self-power enhancement but would never use them as his primary techniques.
"Thank you, Hero Ding!"
Hei Baizi was delighted and went over excitedly.
Qu Feiyan pouted.
Though curious, hearing Ding Ling describing the Star Absorption Technique as so dreadful, she lost interest in checking it out.
Her mind was fully focused on Ding Ling; she wouldn’t listen to or care about others’ words, but she would remember Ding Ling’s words firmly, never daring to forget.
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling led the way.
Qu Feiyan, Lin Pingzhi, Huang Zhonggong and others followed closely behind.
Leaving the underwater prison.
Exiting the array circle.
Came to the outside world.
Feeling the clear sky and pleasant weather, their moods brightened significantly.

Ding Ling secretly mused: I was only in that eternally dark underwater for a while and felt a sense of oppression. Ren Woxing was there alone for over a decade and didn’t collapse. His resolute will was evident in a glance.
Definitely a fierce person!
Just as Ding Ling came to this conclusion, a long laugh came from afar, and soon, Ding Ling saw Ren Woxing swooping over like a Peng spreading its wings, laughing heartily:
"Joyful, joyful!"
Whoosh!
In an instant, he arrived not far in front of Ding Ling. He abruptly stood still, hands behind his back, exuding the grandeur of a grandmaster!
It was apparent.
He had dressed up.
His clothes had been changed into an azure robe, his hair combed back and tied up, revealing a face that was pale yet bore a trace of overbearing aura!
Though old, he was spirited and energetic, his eyes glowing fiercely like two blazing suns.
He appeared more majestic and upright than when he was in the prison, now standing in front of Ding Ling, suddenly striking towards Ding Ling’s chest.
Qu Feiyan had been wary of Ren Woxing and exclaimed, ’Brother Ding! Be careful!’
Ding Ling smiled slightly and also struck out his palm fiercely.
As this palm was unleashed, it was as if a Yin Yang Grinding Disc was spinning in Ding Ling’s palm. It was precisely the ’Great Yin Yang Hand Seal’!
With the strike,
Boom!
It collided fiercely with Ren Woxing’s palm power.
Ding Ling remained unmoved, his clothes fluttering in the gust of wind blowing against him.
Conversely, Ren Woxing staggered back five or six steps.
With each step back, a footprint would sink deep into the ground.
After five or six steps back,
Five or six footprints, each about an inch deep, were imprinted in front of him!
His expression was changing unpredictably.
Seemingly incredulous, but mostly fervent.
He stared at Ding Ling intently and said loudly:
"Ding Ling. I didn’t expect your palm power to be so strong!"
Ding Ling neither confirmed nor denied, merely saying:
"Sect Leader Ren, attacking me suddenly without reason, what do you intend to do?"
"I just wanted to test your skills,"
Ren Woxing said in a loud voice:

"The fact proves, you Ding Ling are completely qualified to be the Bright Right Envoy of my Sun and Moon Divine Sect! How about it? Do you want to join my Sun and Moon Divine Sect? I promise you a lifetime of glory and riches, inexhaustible, endless!"
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"Thank you for your generosity, Sect Leader Ren. I don’t think I’m suitable to be any Bright Right Envoy, so I’ll pass up this job. You can find someone more fitting for the position."
At this time Xiang Wentian also rushed over, hearing Ding Ling’s words, his expression changed slightly, and he stood awkwardly to the side, not speaking.
"Don’t be ungrateful!"
Ren Woxing was astonished and angry when he heard Ding Ling dare to refuse such a good offer:
"The unification of Jianghu by the Sun and Moon Divine Sect is just around the corner! If you were the Bright Right Envoy, you would have countless followers! Yet you refuse?!"

sentences.text: Let’s not talk about that for now.
Wanting to fuse someone else’s ’arm’ onto your own body, without a special technique, Ding Ling would become a ’freak’, thereby losing control, going astray and dying a violent death.
Therefore.
Absorbing others’ inner strength through the Star Absorption Technique is inadvisable.
Unless it’s like the North Nether Divine Skill which can perfectly refine someone else’s inner strength completely.
But the Star Absorption Technique does not have this function.
Ding Ling also lacks such a technique like the North Nether Divine Skill, so he must abandon the use of the Star Absorption Technique to draw inner strength.
"Truly a tasteless dish."
Ding Ling shook his head but didn’t destroy the Star Absorption Technique.
Anyone who wants to practice this Star Absorption Technique can go ahead!

He considered that the fundamental purpose of using the Star Absorption Technique to enhance his inner strength and thus his ’True Power Value’ had been achieved, so there was no need to stay in this cell any longer.
"According to TV shows and descriptions, it seems Ren Woxing has developed a merging technique, said to resolve side effects.
But creating an inner power heart technique is incredibly difficult, as if defying the heavens?
This merging technique might solve immediate troubles.
But it must also have side effects!"
The more inner power heart techniques Ding Ling learned,
The deeper his understanding became.
In terms of talent,
He was quite ordinary.

Even so, Ding Ling didn’t have the ability to create a first-class divine skill either!

He wouldn’t do something as foolish as ’losing a watermelon to pick up a sesame seed’.
"Having Pure Yang True Qi to protect me is already enough.
What I need to do now is find more first-class high-tier inner power heart techniques to continuously increase my True Power Value, thus enhancing my cultivation."
Ding Ling’s mind was clear.

Seeing Qu Feiyan and Lin Pingzhi’s actions made him feel gratified.
These two, particularly Qu Feiyan, were extremely intelligent.

This technique is known to Ren Woxing too.

Ding Ling still wouldn’t attempt it.
He could continuously shatter the void, and now he was already a peak-level master in this world.
He just needed to complete tasks to venture into other worlds.
He believed that such experiences would only become more frequent in the future.
Therefore, some inappropriate techniques, Ding Ling at most would level them up for self-power enhancement but would never use them as his primary techniques.
"Thank you, Hero Ding!"
Hei Baizi was delighted and went over excitedly.
