chapters.title: Chapter 330: Critical Strike
paragraphs: "Why can’t we refuse?"
Qu Feiyan, unable to bear the sight and sound of it, said crisply from the side:

"Let’s not even talk about whether you, Ren Woxing, are still the Sect Leader of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect. Even if you were, my Brother Ding’s Divine Skill is unparalleled and he is honorable and open. Why would he associate with someone as bloody and filthy as you? What qualification do you have to criticize and command my Brother Ding?"
"And who are you, little girl?!"
Being rebutted by a young girl, Ren Woxing’s face showed even more embarrassment. He casually asked, not waiting for Qu Feiyan to respond, and suddenly made a move, drawing in a breath.
Star Absorption Technique!
Whoosh!
The Xun Wind arose out of thin air, and Qu Feiyan, caught off guard, was sucked away. Seeing this, Ding Ling was furious! The Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi merged with True Qi, boom!

Speed exploded, ghost-like, and in a breath, he was in front of Qu Feiyan, catching her. Following the momentum of the Star Absorption Technique’s energy, they smoothly arrived in front of Ren Woxing. Extending his hand, a palm strike was sent forward.
Boom!
It landed directly on Ren Woxing’s palm.
This palm strike contained the power of the Breathing Technique’s Vigorous Qi and the True Qi fusion. As soon as they touched, a cracking sound erupted.

Ren Woxing felt as if struck by lightning, letting out a muffled groan, and his entire body was uncontrollably flung away. In mid-air, he rapidly controlled his body, spinning over a dozen times before finally dissipating the force. Upon landing, he staggered back dozens of steps before barely managing to stand.
"Cough, cough."
He was about to rebuke Ding Ling, but felt the Blood Qi in his chest surge uncontrollably, forcing him to cough. A mouthful of old blood uncontrollably surged from his throat and overflowed his lips.
He had sustained a significant injury!
"Such strong Palm Power!"
Ren Woxing was extremely shocked and warily stared at Ding Ling:
"You’ve been holding back before!"
"Hmph."
Ding Ling put down the still-frightened Qu Feiyan and coldly glanced at Ren Woxing:
"Is Sect Leader Ren truly determined to make an enemy of me?"
Were it not for considering his interest alliance with Xiang Wentian, Ding Ling would have smacked Ren Woxing to death with a palm strike!
"No, no, no."
Before Ren Woxing could speak, Xiang Wentian couldn’t help himself and leaped out, standing between Ding Ling and Ren Woxing, loudly saying:

"We have no intention of becoming enemies with you, Ding Ling. We only wish to recruit you into the Sun and Moon Divine Sect, to become the sect’s Bright Right Envoy. This is a tremendous goodwill, a heartfelt gesture, a benevolent intention. How could we possibly become your enemy and present malice to you? Wouldn’t that be repaying kindness with enmity, causing pain to our friends and joy to our enemies?
Such things, neither I nor Sect Leader Ren would ever do! We hope you can understand, Ding Ling."
"This is the last time."
Ding Ling waved his hand:
"Xiang Left Envoy, you and I are already even. Take Sect Leader Ren and leave this Mei Manor. You are not welcome here."
"Indeed."
Huang Zhonggong immediately chimed in:
"We ask you two to leave quickly."
He was overjoyed in his heart.
He had thought that apart from Dongfang Bubai, no one could restrain Ren Woxing.
Unexpectedly, Ding Ling easily defeated Ren Woxing.
This was a huge surprise and blessing for Huang Zhonggong and the others!
Their courage surged instantly, dispelling their despondency, and they no longer feared Ren Woxing, daring to speak and act.
"It’s you, you old undead."
Ren Woxing, in a rage:
"I haven’t even begun to settle our accounts. This matter is a private one between us..."
He paused as he said this, suddenly looking towards Ding Ling:
"I hope you won’t interfere."
"What if I must interfere?"
Ding Ling coldly stated.
"You!"
Ren Woxing was so angered that he felt a blockage at his chest, filled with fury, frustration, and pain!
Having just escaped from prison.
He thought it was like the wide sea where fish could leap freely or the vast sky where birds could fly high.
Unexpectedly;
As soon as he came out, he was met with a direct heavy blow! A blow that he couldn’t resist or counterattack at all!
Through the recent exchange.
How could Ren Woxing not realize he was completely restrained and crushed by Ding Ling.

If Ding Ling were to get serious, he certainly wouldn’t survive. Thinking of this, he felt both jealousy and unwillingness, casting a resentful glance at Ding Ling before letting out an angry snort and turning to leave with a wave of his sleeve.
’If only this old man had such talent as Ding Ling. Why afraid of some Dongfang Bubai?!’
’Damn it! Why does Ding Ling have such profound skills at such a young age! Heaven is unfair!’
Ren Woxing thought of himself, bitterly training the Star Absorption Technique for over ten years in prison, even solving the hidden hazards of the technique!
Yet as soon as he re-emerged, he was crushed by a young man.

Frustrated and anxious, having already been injured from the clash with Ding Ling, his heart swelled with urgency. Another mouthful of old blood uncontrollably surged up his throat and overflowed his lips.
Xiang Wentian watched in fear, deeply worried.
He truly hadn’t expected Ding Ling to be so strong! Even the Star Absorption Technique couldn’t draw him!
"He’s terrifying, that guy! How did he grow like this."
He sighed:
"It seems that conventional means won’t work to recruit Ding Ling. I wonder if the Saintess can manage."
Thinking of this.
He hurriedly whispered to Ren Woxing.
Ren Woxing’s eyes lit up as he listened, nodding repeatedly.
[Achievement Medal: Intimidate Ren Woxing.]

[Note: Ren Woxing’s life is characterized by extreme pride and arrogance. Having just escaped from prison, intending to fulfill his ambitions, he unexpectedly suffered significant humiliation at your hands!
He envies and is jealous of you, yet he also fears you. Because of you, he has developed a somewhat pessimistic outlook on the future!]
Yet another Achievement Medal.
The only regret for Ding Ling is.
It seems there are very few E-level Medals in this world.
Why?
In the Three Kingdoms World, a Super-Elite could contribute an E-level Medal, so why can’t a First-class martial artist in this world? Could it be necessary to be an Innate Expert?!
Ding Ling pondered.
Once the matters at West Lake Mei Manor concluded.
He needed to continue his journey to Huashan.
Before leaving.
Ding Ling, under the pretext of sparring and giving guidance, sparred one by one with Huang Zhonggong and the others.
After a period of time.
[1: Defeat over 20 Plane World experts: 10/20.]
Previously, it was 6.
Now it is 10.
Adding Xiang Wentian, Huang Zhonggong, Tubi Elder, and Dan Qingsheng made the difference.
Xiang Wentian was at a First-class Peak Level.
Dan Qingsheng was at a First-class Initial Tier Level.
To some extent, Peak Level could absolutely crush Basic.
’Hei Baizi, Ren Woxing weren’t included.’
’It seems Hei Baizi really dispersed his skills and planned to cultivate the Star Absorption Technique?’
Ding Ling cast a strange glance at Hei Baizi and then shifted his gaze.
Ren Woxing wasn’t included.
It was well understood.
He definitely neither willingly accepted nor confessed!
Attempting to advance task progress with someone like this was extremely difficult, as could be imagined.
[3: You must make your name as the World’s Number One resound across the entire Plane World. 1%/100%]
Task 3’s progress was only 1%.
It seemed only a small part of the world believed he could be the World’s Number One.
Ding Ling felt at ease.
Once he defeated Dongfang Bubai.
Presumably, this task’s progress would soar.

chapters.title: Chapter 331: Hei Baizi’s Fate! The Lingjiu Palace Ruins
paragraphs: That day.
Ding Ling led Huang Zhonggong, Tubi Elder, Dan Qingsheng, Lin Pingzhi, Qu Feiyan, and One-Character Electric Sword Ding Jian out of Mei Manor.
Hei Baizi stayed in Mei Manor to cultivate the Star Absorption Technique.
Huang Zhonggong sighed repeatedly at this.
But it was Hei Baizi’s own choice. After realizing more words were useless, they could only warn him to be wary of Ren Woxing’s revenge.

Hei Baizi, having obtained the Divine Skill, was full of newfound confidence and excitement, paying no heed to Huang Zhonggong’s warnings, only believing that once he successfully cultivated the Star Absorption Technique, he would dominate Jianghu even if he couldn’t surpass Ren Woxing, gaining fame worldwide.
Seeing how obsessed Hei Baizi was with the Star Absorption Technique.

Dan Qingsheng and the others exchanged glances, all feeling wary, unanimously believing it was right not to cultivate the Star Absorption Technique, to avoid ending up like Hei Baizi in a dilemma, which would be too difficult.

It’s known that the first step of the Star Absorption Technique, dispersing one’s martial skills, is fraught with danger and not for the average person. Hei Baizi had just begun dispersing his skills, but already couldn’t easily leave West Lake Mei Manor, needing to sit in meditation here!
If he were to follow Ding Ling around, any distraction might lead to disrupted meridians and mental collapse, resulting in death!
This is why Hei Baizi was unwilling to leave Mei Manor.
Otherwise, he would surely have chosen to latch onto Ding Ling!
On the surface, he appeared calm and confident, but inside he was deeply troubled, somewhat regretting his hasty cultivation of the Star Absorption Technique.
Still, the Star Absorption Technique was the Divine Skill he had long dreamed of, and having suddenly obtained it so easily, he couldn’t resist cultivating it.
But seriously cultivating it.
He found the difficulty unimaginably high.
Ding Ling was leaving Mei Manor, and he couldn’t follow, which was the most painful thing for him, with no support; what would he do in the future?
"Clip-clop!"
Ding Ling’s group rode away on horseback.

Hei Baizi personally escorted them to the gate, standing there until he could no longer see their figures before turning back into Mei Manor, only to unexpectedly encounter a figure flashing out as he entered, who turned out to be Ren Woxing!
Hei Baizi was greatly shocked and was just about to shout.
Whoosh!
A gust of Xun Wind suddenly arose!
Hei Baizi was entirely absorbed by Ren Woxing, his inner strength drained completely by him:
"You actually cultivated my Star Absorption Technique?"
Ren Woxing looked at Hei Baizi with a strange expression, sneering:
"What a pity. Your talent is too mediocre! In a short time, you won’t grasp the method at all! The Star Absorption Technique, meeting you, is like casting pearls before swine! Die!"
In Hei Baizi’s terrified eyes.
Ren Woxing used his palm with full force, bam! With a loud bang, it shattered Hei Baizi’s entire chest.
"Ugh ugh..."
Hei Baizi reached out, seemingly wanting to grab Ren Woxing, but was casually kicked by him, flying tens of meters away, landing heavily, eyes wide open, unable to die in peace.
"Sect Leader."
Xiaang Wentian emerged from one side, glanced at Hei Baizi’s body, and sighed:
"Just killing Hei Baizi like this, won’t it anger Ding Ling?"
"Heh heh."
Ren Woxing sneered:

"Hei Baizi is selfish and has tried many times to get my Star Absorption Technique, even saying to let him have it and he would let me go. With such a nature, how could someone like Ding Ling not see through it?
Hei Baizi was obviously a discarded pawn."
"I don’t think so."
Xiaang Wentian pondered:

"Ding Ling is not a heartless person. With Huang Zhonggong and the others around, if Hei Baizi wanted to follow Ding Ling, he wouldn’t refuse. It’s very likely that he wanted to stay to cultivate the Star Absorption Technique."
"What you say makes sense."
Ren Woxing nodded thoughtfully:
"What a pity. Among the Four Great Manor Masters, only such a foolish person was left. If the others had stayed, I would definitely make them pay, avenging past disgrace!"
Being severely injured by someone like Ding Ling, a rising star.
Ren Woxing felt extremely humiliated!
This was the reason he, in anger, didn’t waste words with Hei Baizi and directly killed him with a strike.
He just wanted to establish authority!
Even in front of Xiaang Wentian, he didn’t want to lose this authority!
"Has Yingying set out?"
Ren Woxing looked at Xiaang Wentian.
Xiaang Wentian nodded:
"The Saintess has already set out from Luoyang. I expect we will hear from her soon."
"I hope Ding Ling doesn’t fail to appreciate this! This is the greatest gesture I can offer!"
Ren Woxing looked in the direction where Ding Ling had departed, filled with jealousy, unwillingness, and urgency.
Jealous of Ding Ling’s talent, martial arts, and skills.
Unwilling to accept being defeated by Ding Ling.
Anxious because time waits for no one as he ages, wanting to unify Jianghu, he must find capable people like Ding Ling to help him have the confidence to defeat Dongfang Bubai!
Ding Ling’s goal was clear.
To first go to Huashan and learn the Dugu Nine Swords.
As for how to learn it?
When he meets Feng Qingyang, he can find a way. If he can’t even meet him, thinking too much is useless.
To ascertain if Feng Qingyang is at Huashan.
Ding Ling repeatedly logged in and out for investigations.
Confirmed without error.
Only then continued on his journey.
Of course, while logging on and off, he would also use the Achievement Medal to convert his power to the real world.
Presently, in the real world.
He too had become a master with Eight Meridians Connected, and inner strength reaching the Innate realm!
One could say.
Ding Ling’s martial prowess and cultivation level in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World were identical to that in reality!
Without the blessing of Celestial Might or favor of destiny, it was just so.

However, this was the most ideal and normal state, and Ding Ling was quite content with this. Without favor from destiny, he could still become the world’s number one, complete his quest, and shatter the void to leave.
And during the logging in and out period.

Ding Ling, through hacking and various investigations, discovered quite a few players with excellent opportunities, some even discovering extremely exquisite Martial Arts Skills in the ruins of the Lingjiu Palace in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.
To this, Ding Ling could only sigh.
That Lingjiu Palace was too far from his current position. Even if he could fly, it would take a long time, so he could only observe.
However, considering that the Lingjiu Palace ruins dated back so long, it’s incredible that any legacy remains!
But then again, realizing this is a ’mythical game’ world, anything impossible becomes possible.
Ding Ling came to terms with it.
’However, since The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World has the Lingjiu Palace ruins, surely the worlds of Yitian, Divine Eagle, etc. will as well, because they share a lineage!’
Ding Ling didn’t know if he would travel to these worlds in the future.
If he did travel.
He would definitely check out the Lingjiu Palace ruins!
That day.
While Ding Ling and his group were resting in a small town, a woman with a face as beautiful as an immortal rode her horse, somewhat dazedly looking at Ding Ling and his group.

chapters.title: Chapter 332: Consort Yhu, the Enchantress
paragraphs: The woman’s clothing, attire, and demeanor were utterly different from those of her era.
Yet her temperament was gentle and graceful, with a beauty so captivating that it was rarely seen under the heavens.
Such a woman, riding a horse and appearing here, instantly captured everyone’s attention.
"Who is this woman? She looks somewhat familiar?"
Some players were discussing:
"Feels like I’ve seen her somewhere before."
"Now that you mention it, it does seem so. But in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, aside from a few beauties like Ren Yingying, who else could be this beautiful?!"
Players are everywhere, part of every world.
Even the Three Kingdoms world and others have been covered by players’ footprints.
But with the opening of the Martial World, players were once again spreading across all corners of it.
The number of worlds is indeed enough.
Otherwise, if everyone gathered in one world, the sheer number of players would definitely overcrowd this small town, rather than just a sparse few as it is now.

They seemed to recognize Ding Ling too and were initially excited, but seeing that Ding Ling had no intention of acknowledging them, their enthusiasm waned, and they gave up on approaching him for a greeting, instead sitting aside, quietly discussing matters involving Ding Ling, Qu Feiyan, and others.
They thought Ding Ling couldn’t hear them.
But what they didn’t know was that Ding Ling had already reached the realm of the Innate, with ears so keen that even the slightest rustle within dozens of meters couldn’t escape him!
"I remember now!"
A player suddenly exclaimed in a low voice:
"She is Consort Yhu!"
Consort Yhu?
Ding Ling glanced sideways at the woman on horseback.
Coincidentally, the woman was also looking over with a bewildered expression, and the two locked eyes.
Ding Ling’s eyes were deep, his face calm as water, without a hint of covetousness or admiration.

Seeing this, the taut strings of the woman’s heart relaxed a bit. Noticing that Ding Ling had family around him, she thought Ding Ling might be a good person, hesitated for a moment, then prepared to ride closer to talk to him.
Just then, swift as lightning.
She had barely nudged the horse’s flank.
From afar, a group of people suddenly came galloping, and from a great distance, an arrow whizzed through the air, whoosh!
The sharp arrow seemed capable of piercing through emptiness and the cosmos.
It flew straight toward the woman’s brow.
The woman, enraged and surprised, reached behind her, swiftly drew her sword, clang!
The sword’s light was brilliant, a marvel of the world.
With one slash!
Crack!
It shattered the arrow.
The woman gave a deep, lingering look at Ding Ling and his group, then decisively turned her horse to leave, seemingly unwilling to engage in battle or conflict with that group.
"Where are you going, witch!"
"Stop right there!"
A group of dashing, robust men, their attire vibrant, galloped fiercely, clattering!
Their horse hooves stirred up rolling clouds of dust and dirt, covering Ding Ling and the others.
"Ptooey, ptooey!"

Qu Feiyan was eating noodles at a roadside stall when she unexpectedly tasted dirt. Her face contorted with displeasure, ptooey-ed a few times, then instinctively looked up at Ding Ling. Seeing him also covered in dust, she quickly pulled out a handkerchief from her bosom and reached over to wipe Ding Ling’s face.
Ding Ling, feeling warm, took Qu Feiyan’s handkerchief and wiped himself.
Having finished, he conveniently wiped Qu Feiyan’s face.
When Qu Feiyan blushed, he realized the awkwardness, hurriedly cleared his throat, and pretended not to know as he looked at the receding group of riders:
"The attire of these people looks familiar somehow."
"Master,"
Lin Pingzhi softly reminded:
"They’re from the Mount Songh Sect!"
"Mount Songh Sect?"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow:

"Didn’t the Mount Songh Sect issue a kill order on us not long ago? Now that we’ve encountered them, there’s no reason not to eliminate them first. Mount up, let’s first take care of these Mount Songh Sect people!"
Dan Qingsheng and others, their eyes gleaming, laughed:
"I didn’t expect that just upon entering the Jianghu world, we would face stormy battles. But I like it!"
Jianghu people.
There are still many with blood running hot.
Dan Qingsheng, One-Character Electric Sword Ding Jian, and others are a group with principles, outlook, and courage.
On the way, they had heard Lin Pingzhi and Qu Feiyan talk about the Mount Songh Sect’s deeds.
They held the Mount Songh Sect in great contempt.
Thinking this so-called famous and upright sect was worse than the Demon Sect.
Now seeing these robust men chasing after a woman, while they were eating noodles by the roadside and got covered in dirt, they were already feeling annoyed.
Now, hearing Ding Ling’s words, naturally, their hearts soared with joy, and they all immediately mounted their horses, spurred on, and chased after the distant Mount Songh Sect members.
The players watched.
There was envy, admiration, and surprise:

"This is the fiery Jianghu I long for. But alas, up to now, all I’ve gotten is a Third-class Inner Power Heart Method. After so much practice, not a trace of Inner Strength appears! How can one be fiery? How to kill enemies? How to roam the Jianghu!!"

"Exactly. This Myth game is too damn real! The Three Kingdoms is like this, and so is The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World. The difficulty of cultivation is too high. Sometimes I really just want to lie down and do nothing!"

"True. If not for the game world’s realism and high attraction, given this cultivation difficulty, I doubt many people would keep playing! And not to think that in other games, cultivation skyrockets with progress, while in this world, damn it, cultivation is counted in years!!"
"Yes, that’s why among our player base, Ding Ling created a myth, a miracle! An incredible, unbreakable fantasy!"
Ding Ling’s Ferghana Horse was extremely fast.
Huang Zhonggong and the others had been at West Lake Mei Manor for many years, and exchanging private property to purchase a sturdy horse wasn’t difficult.
Therefore.
The speed of their group was much faster than that of the Mount Songh Sect.
In a moment.
They caught up.

Ding Ling bent his bow on horseback, fitting an arrow as he simultaneously operated Breathing Technique and Pure Yang True Skill; Vigorous Qi and True Qi fused with the activation of Tornado Arrow and Double Extremes Arrow, causing the arrow tips to hum continuously.
Twang!
Ding Ling released the string. Amid the sound of the bowstring twanging, whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
Three arrows surged forth like fast boats breaking waves, more like lightning splitting through the void, shooting forward with such speed that small tornado whirlwinds arose in the emptiness!
Three arrows.
Shot out three small tornado tunnels!
Where they headed, the explosive sounds shook heaven and earth.
Huang Zhonggong and his companions witnessed and inhaled sharply, full of admiration.
The Mount Songh Sect members riding ahead seemed to hear the commotion, turned their heads to look, and upon seeing, their faces changed, involuntarily shouting in raised voices:
"Watch out! Someone’s attacking!"
The words were unfinished!
Boom!
Boom boom!

The three arrows, with an unstoppable speed faster than sound, pierced through several hundred meters of emptiness, reaching the backs of the Mount Songh members in mere blinks, then amidst their horrified cries, boom boom boom! The three arrows hit the last three people, accompanied by three anguished, sharp cries tearing through the void!
It was clear to see that these three were pierced through their chests and abdomens, not to mention.

chapters.title: Chapter 333: The Power of the Sound-Killing Sword Technique Unleashed
paragraphs: The person was carried by the arrow and flew straight off the horse’s back, tossed over ten meters, before heavily rolling onto the ground, thud thud thud!
Then, the horse’s hooves stomped over, instantly turning into a lump of flesh!
"Who is it?!"

Everyone from the Mount Song sect was furious, pulling back their horses and turning to face Ding Ling. The leader, a robust man standing nine feet tall, wielding a treasure sword, stared at Ding Ling and shouted loudly:
"Who is coming? Why are you killing our Mount Song sect people for no reason!"
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
The response was three more arrows!
The arrows spun up gusts of whirlwind, sparks dancing with lightning, causing even the void to ripple!
Such phenomenal archery skill!
Rare in the world!
The leader, utterly astonished, had never seen or heard of anything like it, but he quickly thought of someone, and couldn’t help but shout:
"It’s Ding Ling!"
Clang clang clang!

All the Mount Song sect members felt a chill in their hearts, drew their swords, formed ranks, and prepared cautiously, some even took the opportunity to ride away, seemingly unwilling to partake in this conflict.
In an instant.
The atmosphere was tense, faces changed dramatically, like seeing ghosts or gods.
Qu Feiyan saw this and was delighted, thinking:
"It seems Brother Ding’s reputation has spread throughout the Mount Song sect! Judging by their terrified appearances, they evidently fear Brother Ding deeply!"
Indeed, that was the truth.
To inspire and boost morale.
The leader shouted loudly:

"Ding Ling and his few people, they even brought a few elders and weaklings! We are different, we are all in our prime! Charge with me! Success or death! If you run with your back to Ding Ling, we will all be shot to death!"
"Follow me!"
The leader was the first to wield his sword, mount his horse, and charge at Ding Ling.
The rest looked at each other, then followed suit.
Of course, there were also cowards who deliberately lagged behind and quietly fled, hard to tell if they were players or natives.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Among the Mount Song sect, some skilled archers bent bows and aimed arrows, shooting back at Ding Ling!
But how could they be a match for Ding Ling?
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
As each arrow shot forward, the Mount Song people were completely unable to block or evade, could only muster their full inner strength, using sword technique to clash head-on with the arrows.
But without exception, they were all shot to break their swords, then, shattered arrows tore apart, rapidly plummeting towards them.
Thud thud thud!
Some were hit in the forehead by arrowheads, others had their eyes, cheeks pierced by shattered arrows.
In an instant.
Screams echoed all around, shaking the surroundings!
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Over a few hundred meters stretch, Ding Ling constantly bending bows and shooting arrows, during short moments, killed no less than several dozen Mount Song experts!
Huang Zhonggong, Ding Jian, and others watched admiringly.
Close combat was imminent.
Huang Zhonggong and the others steeled themselves, picked up their weapons, staring intensely ahead.
The distance between the sides was closing rapidly.
Ding Ling could even clearly see the pores on the lead man’s face.

He put away the bow and arrow, reached behind him, amidst the clang, the Giant Que Sword was unsheathed, before the enemy arrived, Ding Ling shook the Giant Que Sword forward, unleashing Seven Extremes Swordsmanship, forming waves of a piercing sound surge straight ahead.
"Ah!"
The leader was the first to take the hit by this sound wave, only felt splitting headache, frustration wanting to vomit, originally full of killing intent gaze suddenly became blurry, dazed!
Amidst screeches and shouts of other Mount Song members.
Thud!
A crisp sound rang in the ears.
In the next instant!
The leader only felt the world spinning sky and earth.
"What happened?!"
In his confusion, he seemed to see a headless corpse still rushing forward, the corpse looked quite familiar, next moment, like struck by lightning, his eyes suddenly clarified:
"That’s me!"
"I’m dead!"

In a moment of clarity before death, he saw Ding Ling leading a team of ’elderly and weak’ charging into their troop, cutting through like a hot knife through butter, scenes of blood and carnage rise, limbs and broken bodies flying high, in brief moments, they killed through their ranks.
Facing Ding Ling and his people.
The Mount Song sect’s troop seemed like a mud pile, paper-made, shatters with a touch, breaks with a poke!
"So, so powerful!
The leader in shock carried a bit of bitterness and regret:
"I, Zhang Jingchao, truly am out of luck, whom else, if not, had to encounter Ding Ling, this embodiment of disaster!"
His mind increasingly blank, until completely silent.
[Obtained Achievement Medal: Intimidate Zhang Jingchao.]

[Note: As one of Mount Song sect’s Thirteen Grand Protectors, Zhang Jingchao. Physically robust, incredibly courageous, a true first-class expert! Because of backing from Mount Song, he acted without restraint! Due to no one being able to match him for long, he became increasingly domineering, arrogant, and unruly.Until encountering you, utterly understanding what it means by someone beyond someone, sky beyond sky, what it means by ant trying to shake tree, egg attacking a rock! He was conceited, but facing you, had absolutely no power to fight back! If given another chance, he would definitely turn and flee without a word, even if faced with the possibility of being shot, better than you directly beheading!]
Ding Ling heard the notification, slightly dazed.
Did he just kill Mount Song sect’s Thirteen Grand Protector?
Was it a first-class expert?!
He glanced at the character panel.
[1: Defeat more than 20 plane strongmen: 11/20.]
Sure enough, progress jumped from 10 to 11.
But Ding Ling felt nothing, as if he had just killed a small fry.
"Seems like the first-class experts haven’t gotten weaker, rather I’ve grown much stronger!"
At this moment, Ding Ling truly realized how strong he was!
Earlier when sparring with Huang Zhonggong and others, he held back, dared not go all out.
Now, going all out.
Truly invincible! This group of Mount Song’s elite, was wiped out by him like dried leaves swept away, except for the few who escaped early, all annihilated!
"Too strong!"
Dan Qingsheng, Tubi Elder, Huang Zhonggong, Ding Jian looked at Ding Ling with completely changed eyes.
With reverence, awe, amazement!
Only then did they realize, Ding Ling was just sparring with them earlier, if going all out, no need to say, they would have surely all been dead and gone!
Lin Pingzhi, Qu Feiyan saw this, couldn’t help but be delighted, everyone feeling pride! A sense of shared glory!
"Dismount and see if there are any spoils. Especially secret manuals."
Ding Ling said a couple of words.
Qu Feiyan, Lin Pingzhi were among the first to leap off their horses, heading to search.
Knowing Ding Ling needed martial arts secret manuals.
They became more active than anyone.

Huang Zhonggong and others twitched at the corners of their eyes, Ding Ling had already become terrifyingly strong, his learning vast and extensive to the extreme, even casually mastering a supreme skill could easily crush them.
However, even so, Ding Ling was still not satisfied!

chapters.title: Chapter 334: Ice True Skill Full Level
paragraphs: While they stood in reverence, they couldn’t help but secretly admonish themselves:
"Even someone as extraordinarily talented as Ding Ling knows to keep striving. What excuse do we have to slack off?"
One-Character Electric Sword Ding Jian saw Ding Ling’s relentless dedication to martial arts.
After much hesitation.
He decided to impart his martial arts knowledge to Ding Ling.
Because he had been observing closely during this period.
Ding Ling’s guidance to Huang Zhonggong and Dan Qingsheng in martial arts was precise, causing their skills to improve markedly.
Ding Jian was both envious and embarrassed, having no reason to ask Ding Ling for guidance, nor could he accept Ding Ling’s help without cause.
Yet now, seeing Ding Ling’s dedication to the secret manual.
He seized the opportunity to bring up the matter.
Ding Ling naturally had no objections.
Soon after.
Ding Jian imparted his most treasured sword technique to Ding Ling.
He merely performed it once.
Ding Ling closed his eyes slightly.
[One-Character Electric Sword Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
In an instant.
Ding Ling fully grasped all the esoteric truths of this high-tier sword technique.

He opened his eyes, using his finger as a sword, and began to demonstrate. In the void, the sword’s light flashed with electricity, an astonishing and captivating display, the sword’s brilliance dazzled the heavens and charmed the heart!

Ding Jian’s heart and spirit trembled; despite knowing Ding Ling’s extraordinary abilities, frequently hearing from Dan Qingsheng and others about him—his ears could practically grow calluses—still, seeing the sword technique he had practiced for years without mastery being perfected by Ding Ling almost instantaneously, made him feel as if struck in the heart, as if hit by a critical blow!
He felt dejected and dispirited, for the first time sensing the gap between himself and a true genius.
Huang Zhonggong seemed to sense his mood and came over to console him:
"You can’t compare to Ding Ling. Compare yourself to ordinary people—compared to them, wouldn’t you immediately regain your confidence and sense of superiority?"
Ding Jian was at a loss for words. For what Huang Zhonggong said made perfect sense!
He could only suppress his complex emotions and continue imparting all he had learned to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling quickly mastered the other low and middle-tier sword skills of Ding Jian.
Ding Jian looked at Ding Ling as if he were a deity.
Then, imparted the inner power heart method to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling also immediately reached full level.
[Inner Power Value +60]
Compared to the inner power heart methods of Huang Zhonggong and the others, Ding Jian’s was first-class but still lacking.
Even so.
It still added 60 points to the inner power value.
In an instant, primordial qi gathered from all directions, engulfing Ding Ling.
Ding Ling stood still, inhaling and exhaling rapidly, exercising the Pure Yang True Skill, converting inner power to true power.
He could clearly sense.
The second drop of true water in his dantian became increasingly solid and heavy, as if it might split into a third drop at any moment!
Ding Ling glanced at his status panel:
Strength: [Bone Structure 2 (ordinary humans 1 point), Intelligence 3, Strength 38.4, Agility 39.1, Constitution 38.8, Defense 36.7, Charm 11. True Power Value: 2 points]
Previously, Ding Ling’s panel: Strength 37.8, Agility 38.4, Constitution 37.7.
With each full level of sword technique.
The attributes rose to their current levels.
Lately, Ding Ling had felt increasingly strongly:
"The four-dimensional attributes are nearing their peak, but how much more can this world accommodate?"
Ding Ling thought no more.
After solemnly thanking Ding Jian, he promised to guide and instruct Ding Jian in the coming period.
Ding Jian’s motive was precisely this, so he couldn’t help but show a delighted expression.
Soon afterwards.
Lin Pingzhi and Qu Feiyan collected several secret manuals and some great medicine and brought them to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling encouraged them a bit, then took the secret manuals and started reading.
Among them were Mount Songh Sect’s sword technique and inner power heart method.
Ding Ling was surprised.
He pondered:

"How could these people bring out Mount Songh Sect’s mountain guardian secret manuals? It’s not possible unless they are outsiders of Mount Songh Sect. These manuals were likely rewards from Zuo Lengchan, and perhaps the reward period wasn’t long enough for them to practice?"
The specific truth was unknown.
But considering Zuo Lengchan’s actions in TV dramas and novels—straddling black and white, ambitious—it wasn’t entirely incomprehensible for him to do such a thing.
Ding Ling set aside his thoughts and began perusing the secret manuals.
After finishing the sword technique.
[Seventeen Paths of Mount Song Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
This was evidently a high-tier sword technique.

Ding Ling used his fingers as a sword, practicing in the void. The display was imposing and splendid, a magnificent spectacle as if thousands of troops were charging forth, majestic and grand to the utmost!
Ding Ling nodded in appreciation.
This Mount Song Swordsmanship indeed was impressive, no less formidable than the Hundred Transformations and Thousand Illusions Hengshan Cloud Mist Thirteen Techniques of Mount Heng Sect.
Qu Feiyan and the others, watching Ding Ling learn the manuals effortlessly, felt both envious and somewhat numb, having become accustomed to it over time.
Ding Ling then reviewed the inner power heart method.
It was a Cold Ice True Skill.
After reading.
[Cold Ice True Skill Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +100]
Ding Ling sat amidst the surge of primordial qi, breathing steadily for quite a while.
Incorporating all the primordial qi at his disposal.
The second drop of true water in his dantian had condensed to its utmost form, with the third drop of true water’s outline clearly visible.
Evidently.
Just a bit more inner power value absorption.
The third drop of true water would inevitably fissure out.
Ding Ling furrowed his brows slightly, thinking:
"This secret manual obviously surpasses the one given by Dan Qingsheng, but still only provides +100 inner power value. It seems the upper limit for first-class secret manuals is 100 points."
The Star Absorption Technique and Pure Yang True Skill were both exceedingly powerful, evidently top-tier among first-class manuals, yet also provided +100.
Clearly, the upper limit was set and wouldn’t change.

"If Cold Ice True Skill were truly Mount Songh Sect’s mountain guardian secret manual, no matter how ambitious, it’s unlikely Zuo Lengchan would use it to recruit experts from both truthful and roguish paths?!"
"Could it be that Zhang Jingchao stole this manual? Or was there a copy made and given to him?"
Ding Ling couldn’t fathom.
But obtaining this manual was a fortunate event.
He couldn’t be bothered to think further.
Instead, he was secretly delighted, never expecting such great gain from a single pursuit of Mount Songh Sect members.
The secrets aside.
The great medicine was of considerable quantity.
Ding Ling immediately took some to chew and eat.
Using the Pure Yang True Skill to absorb the medicinal power.
Before long.
After consuming a dozen or so great medicines.
[Inner Power Value +40]
Crack!
The third drop of true water in the dantian finally fissured out!
[True Power Value: 3 points]
Reaching 3 points in true power value.
Ding Ling’s strength advanced another tier.
Ding Ling casually pointed forward.
Profound Celestial Finger!
Whoosh!
A white beam shot out five meters away, freezing the thorns five meters beyond instantly.
In the scorching heat.
By the roadside appeared some ’ice sculptures’!
This scene, with such contrasting imagery, was highly striking.

chapters.title: Chapter 335: Consort Yhu Riding the Black Steed
paragraphs: Qu Feiyan, Lin Pingzhi, Huang Zhonggong, and others were all amazed, shaken and moved.
Ding Ling was also quite satisfied.
With such profound Inner Strength cultivation, combined with the Profound Celestial Finger, a sudden surprise attack could not be resisted by anyone.
Clip-clop, clip-clop!
A series of hoofbeats suddenly sounded at this moment.
Ding Ling and his group turned towards the sound.
They saw someone riding swiftly towards them from the end of the road.
It took only a moment.
Ding Ling saw clearly who it was.
The "Consort Yhu" spoken of by players.
That absolutely beautiful woman who seemed out of place with this era!
He was puzzled as to why this woman gave him such a feeling.
Turns out she wasn’t from The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World!
That made sense now.
But Consort Yhu had already Ascended.
Could Diao Chan and the others be far from Ascension?
Thinking of Diao Chan and the others, Ding Ling couldn’t help but feel a warmth in his heart, with some concern arising.
Clip-clop, clip-clop!
The sound of hoofbeats grew louder.
Soon.
The woman rode up close to them, with a blade in hand, leapt off her horse, her almond eyes like autumn water sweeping over Ding Ling and his group, suddenly asking:
"Did you kill those people from Mount Songh Sect?"
"Yes."
Qu Feiyan glanced at Ding Ling, seeing he seemed deep in thought, she stepped forward, crisply saying:
"Sister, we saw you being chased by those villains, and we had some grievances with them, so we chased and dealt with them."
"Thank you."
The woman was very grateful to Qu Feiyan and her group, saying:

"I just Ascended here not long ago, and encountered Zhang Jingchao and Sha Tianjiang of Mount Songh Sect. They were extremely warm and attentive to me, initially I didn’t understand why, until one day I realized I had been drugged.
When they came towards me with bizarre expressions.
I knew what they intended.
Then, with my Divine Sense still clear, I resisted with full effort, injuring Sha Tianjiang.
Taking advantage of Mount Songh Sect’s unawareness, I summoned the Black Steed.
The Black Steed, capable of Spirit communication, carried me all the way south.
I don’t know the way, utterly lost not knowing east, south, west, or north, and in this world where I am all alone, for a moment, I don’t know where to go."
She paused here, looking at Ding Ling and the others with relief:
"Glad to meet you. Otherwise, I really wouldn’t know what to do."
"Sister, you also came from shattering the Void through Ascension?!"
Qu Feiyan was surprised.
"Also?"
The woman caught on to this word, somewhat excitedly saying:
"Besides me, who else have you met from Void Shatterer Ascension?"
"Ah."
Qu Feiyan pointed behind her:
"My Brother Ding is also a Void Shatterer Ascender."
"Brother Ding?"
The woman looked towards Ding Ling, carefully discerning, soon with disappointment:
"He’s not the one I’m looking for. And he doesn’t seem to be from my world either."
Ding Ling had come to his senses some time ago, seeing the woman thus, cleared his throat and asked:
"May I ask, what is your name?"
"My name is Consort Yhu."
The woman hesitated for a moment, yet still said:
"When those from Mount Songh Sect heard my name is Consort Yhu, they all looked rather surprised. Is there something strange about this name?"
Dan Qingsheng, Qu Feiyan, and others were first stunned, then looked at each other, each wondering:

"Really? Could this Consort Yhu be the Consort Yhu from over a thousand years ago?! If true, that would be truly shocking. Not to mention Mount Songh Sect, even monks from Shaolin Temple wouldn’t remain calm upon seeing her!"
Seeing it was indeed Consort Yhu, Ding Ling knew her image must be widely circulated in the online world, otherwise, some players wouldn’t feel familiar upon seeing her.
Familiarity must come from someone having drawn Consort Yhu’s picture, then unexpectedly seen by them.

With the opening of the six great worlds, more and more ancient beauties are uploaded to the online world, plus there are many streamers, internet celebrities, stars, etc., in this fast-food culture era, people often chase the moment’s hotspot.
Hence, Consort Yhu might explode in popularity for a time, then likely be replaced by other figures.
Some might remember her, but most may only have an impression, considering they’ve never seen her in person, just a picture, how deep can that impression be?
"How did you Ascend?"
Ding Ling asked.

His online-offline transactions are brief, involving matters concerning himself, the Three Kingdoms, and The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, so he hasn’t really paid attention to the events of the Late Qin Dynasty.
"Xiang Yu brought me to ascend together."
Consort Yhu didn’t hide from Ding Ling and others, saying somewhat absent-mindedly:

"Xiang Yu gathered the power of Jiuzhou to help me break through the Super-Elite Realm threshold, then acquiring the Ascension qualification. I followed him to ascend. Before ascending, Xiang Yu gave me the Black Steed, saying if we were separated, the Black Steed could find him, but despite my long search, I haven’t found Xiang Yu."
Her feelings of loss were evident:
"Don’t know where he went? How am I supposed to find him?"
She looked at Ding Ling, eyes full of hope:
"Do you know?"
Ding Ling was speechless, only thinking:
"Didn’t the Game World say other Ascenders can only bring a weapon, an outfit? How can Consort Yhu ride a Black Steed?!
Could it be that this Black Steed also reached the Super-Elite Realm?!"
Ding Ling gazed at the Black Steed, inspecting it closely.
With this look, he was astonished.
Only because he found this Black Steed’s eyes were bright and full of spirit, lively as if it could speak!
Consort Yhu said it was capable of Spirit communication; she certainly wasn’t lying.
Thinking of this, Ding Ling asked again:
"Only this Black Steed Ascended with you?"
"Yes."
Consort Yhu also presented a perplexed face:
"We each rode an extraordinary horse, but other horses didn’t qualify for the Celestial Ladder, only the Black Steed was an exception."
Upon hearing this.
Ding Ling had a realization, just secretly amazed that a horse actually reached the Super-Elite Realm, wondering how the Overlord Xiang Yu trained it!
"We haven’t seen Xiang Yu. If he’s indeed in this world, perhaps I can inform you of his precise location."
As Ding Ling spoke this, he was thinking he just needed to go online and offline for a moment, search in the online world, and naturally it would be clear.
Unless Xiang Yu is secluded in deep mountains and forests, avoiding human contact.
Otherwise, he couldn’t possibly escape the players’ "eye lock"!
"Really?"
Consort Yhu wiped away her loss and dejection, looking delightedly at Ding Ling:
"If you really can help me find Xiang Yu, he and I will surely repay you."
Ding Ling smiled slightly, noncommittal, only thought: If a reward truly comes, then exchange Martial Arts with them, learning your skills will surely let me advance further by leaps and bounds.
Consort Yhu joined Ding Ling’s party exactly on this day, at this moment.

Ding Ling was also quite satisfied.
With such profound Inner Strength cultivation, combined with the Profound Celestial Finger, a sudden surprise attack could not be resisted by anyone.
Clip-clop, clip-clop!
A series of hoofbeats suddenly sounded at this moment.
Ding Ling and his group turned towards the sound.
They saw someone riding swiftly towards them from the end of the road.
It took only a moment.
Ding Ling saw clearly who it was.
The "Consort Yhu" spoken of by players.
That absolutely beautiful woman who seemed out of place with this era!
He was puzzled as to why this woman gave him such a feeling.
Turns out she wasn’t from The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World!
That made sense now.
But Consort Yhu had already Ascended.
Could Diao Chan and the others be far from Ascension?
Thinking of Diao Chan and the others, Ding Ling couldn’t help but feel a warmth in his heart, with some concern arising.
Clip-clop, clip-clop!
The sound of hoofbeats grew louder.
Soon.
The woman rode up close to them, with a blade in hand, leapt off her horse, her almond eyes like autumn water sweeping over Ding Ling and his group, suddenly asking:
"Did you kill those people from Mount Songh Sect?"
"Yes."
Qu Feiyan glanced at Ding Ling, seeing he seemed deep in thought, she stepped forward, crisply saying:
"Sister, we saw you being chased by those villains, and we had some grievances with them, so we chased and dealt with them."
"Thank you."
The woman was very grateful to Qu Feiyan and her group, saying:
"I just Ascended here not long ago, and encountered Zhang Jingchao and Sha Tianjiang of Mount Songh Sect.
They were extremely warm and attentive to me, initially I didn’t understand why, until one day I realized I had been drugged.
When they came towards me with bizarre expressions.
I knew what they intended.
Then, with my Divine Sense still clear, I resisted with full effort, injuring Sha Tianjiang.
Taking advantage of Mount Songh Sect’s unawareness, I summoned the Black Steed.
The Black Steed, capable of Spirit communication, carried me all the way south.
I don’t know the way, utterly lost not knowing east, south, west, or north, and in this world where I am all alone, for a moment, I don’t know where to go."
She paused here, looking at Ding Ling and the others with relief:
"Glad to meet you.
Otherwise, I really wouldn’t know what to do."
"Sister, you also came from shattering the Void through Ascension?!"
Qu Feiyan was surprised.
"Also?"
The woman caught on to this word, somewhat excitedly saying:
"Besides me, who else have you met from Void Shatterer Ascension?"
"Ah."
Qu Feiyan pointed behind her:
"My Brother Ding is also a Void Shatterer Ascender."
"Brother Ding?"
The woman looked towards Ding Ling, carefully discerning, soon with disappointment:
"He’s not the one I’m looking for.
And he doesn’t seem to be from my world either."
Ding Ling had come to his senses some time ago, seeing the woman thus, cleared his throat and asked:
"May I ask, what is your name?"
"My name is Consort Yhu."

"When those from Mount Songh Sect heard my name is Consort Yhu, they all looked rather surprised.
Is there something strange about this name?"

"Really?

If true, that would be truly shocking.
Not to mention Mount Songh Sect, even monks from Shaolin Temple wouldn’t remain calm upon seeing her!"

chapters.title: Chapter 336: Consort Yhu in Tears
paragraphs: Because of Qu Feiyan.
Consort Yhu integrated into the team at an astonishing speed.
Qu Feiyan was lively, clever, wise, and decisive, communicating with Consort Yhu with no barriers.
Consort Yhu also liked Qu Feiyan, and before long, the two began to call each other sisters.
Heading all the way north.
Because their communication was seamless.
Ding Ling also learned a lot about the late Qin Dynasty from the side and got a better understanding of Xiang Yu as a person.
Of course.
In Consort Yhu’s words, Xiang Yu was a hero who stood between heaven and earth, with extraordinary grace, heroic spirit, and gentle affection!
Overall, it was positive and perfect.
Cannot entirely trust it, can only take it as a reference.
But it could also be seen from this that Consort Yhu was deeply in love with Xiang Yu.
Qu Feiyan listened with somewhat misty eyes as Consort Yhu talked about her story of meeting, knowing, understanding, falling in love, and loving Xiang Yu.
The story was moving.
Watching Consort Yhu’s stunningly beautiful eyebrows and eyes.
Qu Feiyan couldn’t help but glance at Ding Ling, seeing him staring blankly ahead, not knowing what he was thinking, and felt a sense of loss in her heart.
"You, you."
Seeing this, Consort Yhu rubbed Qu Feiyan’s head and whispered gently in her ear:
"When you grow up a bit, maybe your Brother Ding will fall in love with you."
Qu Feiyan blushed and felt warm, but was overjoyed inside:
"Really?"
"You’re so cute and smart. How can anyone not cherish or like you?"
Consort Yhu softly said, her voice gentle and delicate, like a mountain spring flowing through people’s hearts, making Qu Feiyan feel a little intoxicated without realizing it:
"I’m just worried, afraid..."
"No need to worry. I’ll help you."
"Thank you, sister."
Ding Ling managed to go offline once.
Confirming that Xiang Yu wasn’t in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, but rather in The Deer and the Cauldron World, he couldn’t help but be surprised, but soon he came to an understanding, thinking:
"It seems even if there’s a joint ascension, it’s likely to ascend into different worlds! Ah~"
He sighed deeply.
He thought of Da and Xiao Qiao, Zhen Jiang, Du Qingcheng, and others; if they ascended together only to scatter everywhere, wouldn’t it be terrible?
"As long as I’m strong enough, someday I’ll be able to achieve immortality with them."
Ding Ling took a deep breath.
He didn’t dwell on it further.
As there was no use in overthinking.
He did want to take the chance to return to the Three Kingdoms World to see Diao Chan and the others, but this opportunity only came once; wasting it might mean never being able to cross down again.
At the very least.
That’s how it looked for now.
Unless one day he becomes stronger than this game world! But who knows when that will be?
"Fortunately, there’s the online world to check on Diao Chan and the others’ activities."
Ding Ling specifically searched online.
Discovering that Diao Chan and the others were still in the Three Kingdoms diligently closing themselves off in cultivation.
He was relieved.
He guessed what was on Diao Chan’s and the others’ minds; there was a ninety percent chance they wanted to ascend to the Upper Realm together.
But they didn’t know that even if they ascended together, it was highly likely they would end up in different worlds.

"The resources of the Three Kingdoms World were supplied to the Prince’s Mansion. Diao Chan and the others would have continuous cultivation resources, so there was no immediate need to worry about them. If necessary, once I gather stronger cultivation technique, I’ll make a trip to the Three Kingdoms!"
Ding Ling silently made up his mind.
But the upper limit of the Three Kingdoms World was fixed.
After Diao Chan and the others reached the pinnacle of their cultivation, to make further progress, they would surely have to head to the Upper Realm.
So ideally, before their ascension, Ding Ling should choose a very strong Inner Power Heart Method to teach them.
"Fortunately, Zhen Jiang, Zhao Bingxuan, and the others’ cultivation levels are not high; even with Jiuzhou’s supply of resources, reaching Super-Elite would take years."
"So I still have a few years to decide."
Ding Ling came to realize.
Diao Chan and the others were extremely good to him, and in the eyes of countless people in the Three Kingdoms World, they were already considered his Queens.
They thought and acted that way themselves.
Ding Ling noticed and accepted them, naturally developing the idea of nurturing them to immortality together.
"It would be so lonely to live eternally alone."
Ding Ling took a long breath.
Logging back into the game world again.
Found Consort Yhu and told her the truth.
Consort Yhu was stunned, her face filled with confusion, looking at Ding Ling, not at all showing the wise ’knowledgeable elder sister’ image she had while interacting with Qu Feiyan?
Clearly.
Xiang Yu’s place in her heart was so high that any clue of him was enough to unsettle her!
And it was like this right now.
Her heart was full of turmoil, her mind a chaotic mess, only thinking, ’I’ll never see Xiang Yu again, I’ll never see him again!’
In an instant, thinking of the painful parts, she couldn’t help but shed tears.
Qu Feiyan panicked at the sight, quickly getting up to console her.
Ding Ling was a bit taken aback; he sighed, thought for a moment, and said:
"Actually, you still have a chance to meet."
"Really?!"
Qu Feiyan was overjoyed and turned to ask:
"Brother Ding, can my sister really meet Xiang Yu again?"
"When have I ever lied to you?"
Ding Ling smiled.
"That’s right."
Qu Feiyan smiled, gently shaking Consort Yhu’s arm, softly speaking:
"Sister, don’t be sad. You’ll definitely meet Xiang Yu again."
"Then how can I meet him?"
Consort Yhu wiped her eyes, looking tearfully at Ding Ling, truly a beauty with tears, evoking pity at first sight.
Ding Ling felt his heart skip a beat, unnaturally lifting his gaze to the sky, saying:
"As long as I break the void again. The Celestial Ladder connects all worlds. If Xiang Yu can’t find you in other worlds, he will naturally climb the Celestial Ladder again to search for you."
"I see."
Consort Yhu understood but quickly identified a hole in the logic:
"But if it’s another ascension, and we still ascend to different worlds?"
"Then keep striving to grow stronger; eventually, you’ll meet in other worlds."
Ding Ling said:
"Do you not believe in Xiang Yu’s talent and bones? Don’t you believe he will break the void and ascend to a stronger world?"
"I believe him."
"There you go."
Ding Ling nodded in agreement:
"So you must strive hard."
"Mm."

A determined light flashed in Consort Yhu’s eyes; she never really liked Martial Dao, but because of Xiang Yu, she embarked on this path. Now, because of her pursuit of Xiang Yu, she would undoubtedly continue steadfastly on this path until she meets Xiang Yu again, perhaps then she will pause her steps.
Qu Feiyan couldn’t help but wonder about the future if she were to be separated from Ding Ling?
Thinking about the extreme, her eyes reddened slightly.
Afraid others might notice her unusual state, she hurriedly turned away to sort out her emotions, calming herself before turning back around, her face bright with calling ’Brother Ding’ and ’Sister’!
After Consort Yhu decided to become stronger, she exchanged her martial arts with Ding Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 337: A Windfall from the Sky
paragraphs: Consort Yhu learned from Qu Feiyan about the awe-inspiring and formidable aspects of Ding Ling.
Now that there’s a master nearby, naturally she doesn’t need to seek out a renowned sect to learn martial arts.
Moreover, the negative impression brought by such renowned sects like the Mount Songh Sect had given her a psychological shadow, making her wary of trusting such renowned sects.
She only trusts Qu Feiyan, Ding Ling, and their group.
And she is embarrassed to ask Ding Ling to teach her Inner Power Heart Method for nothing, so she can only exchange it with the knowledge she acquired over her lifetime.
All her Supreme Skills were taught to her by Xiang Yu.
She believes that Xiang Yu would understand and support her if he knew of her experiences.
Her Supreme Skills include the Overlord Saber Technique and Overlord Breathing Technique.
Ding Ling listened to her recount the Overlord Breathing Technique, and there appeared an unsettling book on the shelf, yet it’s temporarily unsuitable for cultivation.
After hearing about the Overlord Saber Technique once.
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.
[Overlord Saber Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
This is evidently an absolute top-notch saber technique!
In terms of sharpness and overbearing aura, it surpasses many sword skills!

Ding Ling drew his sword, using it as a saber, and in an instant, amid the dazzling light, saber qi erupted, with booming sounds, thud, thud, thud! Saber qi shot out, transforming into a saber slashing down on a tree!
Bam, bam, bam! Surprisingly, in an instant, a large tree five to six meters away was slashed to pieces!
Consort Yhu was dumbfounded, shocked, and incredulous.

Earlier, Qu Feiyan had told her about Ding Ling’s encyclopedic knowledge of martial arts, and she somewhat didn’t believe it, as even her most admired Overlord Xiang Yu was far from being so fierce and formidable.
How could Ding Ling be so powerful?
But now, she truly witnessed it.
Only then did she understand why Qu Feiyan admired Ding Ling so much.
He was indeed extraordinary.

Even Xiang Yu, who taught her the Overlord Saber Technique, spent a year or two cultivating it to mastery, yet Ding Ling reached Great Perfection Innate Ability instantly; such aptitude and talent could be said to overshadow his contemporaries, unparalleled and rare!
Consort Yhu greatly admired him and was even more grateful to encounter people like Ding Ling’s group.
"Next, I will impart to you the Cold Ice True Skill."
Ding Ling decided to teach Consort Yhu the Cold Ice True Skill.
This Inner Power Heart Method from the Mount Songh Sect is undoubtedly a top-notch technique.
Unexpectedly obtained by Ding Ling, he thought since many people in the Mount Songh Sect must also possess it, there was no need to hide it; instead, he’d share it with everyone.
Consort Yhu, having joined the group, exchanged her martial arts knowledge with Ding Ling.
For Inner Power Heart Method, Ding Ling naturally chose the Cold Ice True Skill to teach.
Consort Yhu, with her outstanding abilities and keen intelligence, learned the Inner Power Heart Method instantly and grasped it immediately.
Ding Ling secretly admired her, thinking:

"No wonder Consort Yhu is not fond of martial arts. But with Xiang Yu’s ardent support, she could become a Super-Elite master at such a young age! She turns out to be a talent-driven contestant! Heaven bestows her with talent!"
Now Consort Yhu is motivated to learn martial arts.
The future is predictable, and it will surely be bright.
Heading north all along.
On the road, Ding Ling as the ’Master,’ continuously guided Qu Feiyan, Lin Pingzhi, Consort Yhu, Huang Zhonggong, and others in martial arts, skills, Inner Power Heart Methods, and so forth.
Some possessed deep roots, and after Ding Ling’s guidance, they blossomed, progressing brilliantly.
Some had remarkable talent, advancing at lightning speed.
Even Lin Pingzhi, who seemed a bit sluggish in talent, excelled remarkably in the Breathing Technique, progressing daily, and the future certainly appears bright.
On this day.
The group reached a pier, intending to take a boat to cross the river.
Suddenly, the sound of drums was heard.
Everyone followed the sound to see.
Across the Great River with raging waves, several small boats rapidly approached.

On the leading fast boat, there was someone beating a drum, a handsome man eight feet tall, showing delight upon seeing Ding Ling’s group, tossing aside the drumstick with a long laugh, and loudly saying:
"Is that Hero Ding ahead?"
"Brother Ding, they’re calling for you."
Qu Feiyan gazed toward the figures on the fast boat with curious eyes.
As the leading man stepped out.
From each fast boat emerged robust men, awe-inspiring and heroic, human incarnations of flood dragons, wilderness heroes.
Each holding a box in their hands, staring at Ding Ling with piercing eyes.
Ding Ling was also confused, not recognizing the people in front; who are they, though puzzled in his heart, he said aloud:
"That’s right. I’m unworthy of being called a hero, but Ding Ling is indeed me!"
His voice was bright and clear, cutting through waves, unable to be overshadowed by the roaring waves.
Compared to the laughter of the leading man, it was more distinct by tenfold.

The man, hearing this voice, was startled, realizing Ding Ling’s profound Inner Strength must have reached the Transformation Realm, and not someone he could trifle with; he immediately skipped several steps and proceeded directly to the outcome:
"It truly is Hero Ding. Then there’s no mistake."
When their fast boat approached.
With a clap of hands from the leading man.
The strong men on the boats quickly jumped ashore, placing each box on the ground; before long, the ground piled up as if a small mountain of boxes.
After placing the boxes.
All the men retreated to the boats.
The leading man cupped his fists towards Ding Ling with a hearty laugh, saying:
"Hero Ding, fortunate to see you in person indeed makes you a Divine Being, a hero. This is just a little gift from me, hoping you’ll accept it.
After speaking.
He picked up the drumstick again, struck the drum twice, and left singing loud and clear.
Upon the rolling Yangtze River.
The man’s song was grand and powerful.
This only enhanced the atmosphere of chivalry with traces of Jianghu!
From start to finish, Ding Ling didn’t even have time to ask who they were before they left in haste, evidently unwilling to reveal their true identity.
One side, Lin Pingzhi opened a box, gasping in surprise, shouted:
"Master, look quickly, these are all ginseng, reishi, poria, deer antler, bird’s nest, and other top-notch Great Medicines, good herbs, and supplements!"
Ding Ling focused and looked attentively.
Indeed.
Many of these Great Medicines had gone through aging.
Such medicines Fuwei Escort Agency currently does not possess.
At least Ding Ling hadn’t eaten them before!
These people generously offered them, and there are so many.
Ding Ling was also secretly surprised and highly shaken; this situation, so familiar!
Where exactly had something gone wrong?
Heaven dropped a treasure?!

Ding Ling stepped forward, inspecting carefully, mastering Qingnang Scripture and Medicine King Breathing Technique at full level, these Great Medicines, supplements, if they contained any toxins or were consumable.
He was more informed than anyone.
Upon examining them all.
Ding Ling drew a breath.
These Great Medicines all turned out to be top-grade good herbs!
Not tampered with in any way, evidently well-maintained by the owner.
"Are they edible?"
Qu Feiyan turned her gaze.
"Yes."
Ding Ling picked several three-to-four-hundred-year-aged Great Medicines and began eating directly.
Crunch, crunch!
Soon finishing off one plant.

[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
[Defense +0.1]

sentences.text: Consort Yhu learned from Qu Feiyan about the awe-inspiring and formidable aspects of Ding Ling.
Now that there’s a master nearby, naturally she doesn’t need to seek out a renowned sect to learn martial arts.
Moreover, the negative impression brought by such renowned sects like the Mount Songh Sect had given her a psychological shadow, making her wary of trusting such renowned sects.
She only trusts Qu Feiyan, Ding Ling, and their group.
And she is embarrassed to ask Ding Ling to teach her Inner Power Heart Method for nothing, so she can only exchange it with the knowledge she acquired over her lifetime.
All her Supreme Skills were taught to her by Xiang Yu.
She believes that Xiang Yu would understand and support her if he knew of her experiences.
Her Supreme Skills include the Overlord Saber Technique and Overlord Breathing Technique.
Ding Ling listened to her recount the Overlord Breathing Technique, and there appeared an unsettling book on the shelf, yet it’s temporarily unsuitable for cultivation.
After hearing about the Overlord Saber Technique once.
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.
[Overlord Saber Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
This is evidently an absolute top-notch saber technique!
In terms of sharpness and overbearing aura, it surpasses many sword skills!
Ding Ling drew his sword, using it as a saber, and in an instant, amid the dazzling light, saber qi erupted, with booming sounds, thud, thud, thud!
Saber qi shot out, transforming into a saber slashing down on a tree!
Bam, bam, bam!
Surprisingly, in an instant, a large tree five to six meters away was slashed to pieces!
Consort Yhu was dumbfounded, shocked, and incredulous.

Earlier, Qu Feiyan had told her about Ding Ling’s encyclopedic knowledge of martial arts, and she somewhat didn’t believe it, as even her most admired Overlord Xiang Yu was far from being so fierce and formidable.
How could Ding Ling be so powerful?
But now, she truly witnessed it.
Only then did she understand why Qu Feiyan admired Ding Ling so much.
He was indeed extraordinary.

Even Xiang Yu, who taught her the Overlord Saber Technique, spent a year or two cultivating it to mastery, yet Ding Ling reached Great Perfection Innate Ability instantly; such aptitude and talent could be said to overshadow his contemporaries, unparalleled and rare!
Consort Yhu greatly admired him and was even more grateful to encounter people like Ding Ling’s group.
"Next, I will impart to you the Cold Ice True Skill."

Consort Yhu, having joined the group, exchanged her martial arts knowledge with Ding Ling.
For Inner Power Heart Method, Ding Ling naturally chose the Cold Ice True Skill to teach.
Consort Yhu, with her outstanding abilities and keen intelligence, learned the Inner Power Heart Method instantly and grasped it immediately.
Ding Ling secretly admired her, thinking:
"No wonder Consort Yhu is not fond of martial arts.
But with Xiang Yu’s ardent support, she could become a Super-Elite master at such a young age!
She turns out to be a talent-driven contestant!
Heaven bestows her with talent!"
Now Consort Yhu is motivated to learn martial arts.
The future is predictable, and it will surely be bright.
Heading north all along.
On the road, Ding Ling as the ’Master,’ continuously guided Qu Feiyan, Lin Pingzhi, Consort Yhu, Huang Zhonggong, and others in martial arts, skills, Inner Power Heart Methods, and so forth.
Some possessed deep roots, and after Ding Ling’s guidance, they blossomed, progressing brilliantly.
Some had remarkable talent, advancing at lightning speed.
Even Lin Pingzhi, who seemed a bit sluggish in talent, excelled remarkably in the Breathing Technique, progressing daily, and the future certainly appears bright.
On this day.
The group reached a pier, intending to take a boat to cross the river.
Suddenly, the sound of drums was heard.
Everyone followed the sound to see.
Across the Great River with raging waves, several small boats rapidly approached.

On the leading fast boat, there was someone beating a drum, a handsome man eight feet tall, showing delight upon seeing Ding Ling’s group, tossing aside the drumstick with a long laugh, and loudly saying:

Qu Feiyan gazed toward the figures on the fast boat with curious eyes.
As the leading man stepped out.

With a clap of hands from the leading man.

chapters.title: Chapter 338: Power and Agility Reach Maximum Values
paragraphs: As the Four Great Breathing Techniques operated simultaneously,
the Great Medicine that had just been swallowed was immediately refined!
The growth of the four-dimensional attributes was extremely balanced.
Ding Ling secretly admired this.
This is definitely a Treasure Medicine!
Remarkably, treasures of three to four hundred years were coming in droves!
There were also quite a few five to six hundred years old treasure medicines!
It’s known that even the Fuwei Escort Agency, such a large escort agency, doesn’t have six hundred-year-old treasure medicines!
Ding Ling had only used a mere two plants of the three hundred-year-old ones!
Yet here they were in piles.
"How generous!"
Ding Ling praised.
However, for the other party to send such a heavy gift, they obviously had something to request.
Regardless of what they seek.
Let’s eat first and talk later.
When it comes to enhancing strength, Ding Ling always resolves it immediately.
So.
He continued eating.
He ate a total of fifty plants of three to four hundred-year-old treasure medicines.
The growth of the four-dimensional attributes was as follows:
[Strength +1.2]
[Agility +0.6]
[Constitution +0.9]
[Defense +3.3]
Initially, the growth of the four-dimensional attributes was very balanced, all at +0.1 each.
Until Agility reached 40 points. Then it stopped increasing.
Then Constitution, Strength, and Defense also successively reached 40 points. No further growth.
Thus, according to Ding Ling’s current status:
Strength: [Basic Bone 2 (ordinary person 1 point), Intelligence 3, Strength 40, Agility 40, Constitution 40, Defense 40, Charisma 11.]
Before, Ding Ling’s attributes were: Strength 38.4, Agility 39.1, Constitution 38.8, Defense 36.7
As he learned the Overlord Saber Technique, he continued consuming Great Medicine.
Now all are at 40 points!
At this stage, chewing Great Medicine is already useless for Ding Ling.
"At the beginning, three to four hundred-year-old Great Medicine had a significant effect on the growth of the four-dimensional attributes. But the more you eat, the stronger the resistance.
The growth thus becomes slower and less."
"It also took me a total of 50 plants to make all my four-dimensional attributes hit the peak."
Reaching 40 points.
Ding Ling’s strength soared, his speed increased, his defense became stronger, and his endurance improved by leaps and bounds.
Now, Ding Ling stands out.

In terms of physical fitness, there are few in the world who can match him. Even if someone is born with divine power and can match his strength, it’s impossible to match him in all four-dimensional attributes.
Ding Ling has grown from an ordinary person to his current strength!
With the enhancement of Breathing Technique, the Vigorous Qi unleashed is absolutely terrifying!
"Very good."
Ding Ling is very satisfied.
As his physical fitness has reached the world’s top peak value.
Ding Ling’s Breathing Technique’s Qi is increasingly domineering and terrifying. If it merges with True Qi, the effect can be imagined!
"Next comes the cultivation of Inner Power."
Ding Ling continued to chew and eat.
He doesn’t waste what does not cost money.
As long as the strength is strong enough.
All the demonic creatures can be easily suppressed, why should Ding Ling fear not being able to repay favors?
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
The spiritual mechanism and primordial qi within each Great Medicine get entirely refined by Ding Ling utilizing the Pure Yang True Skill.
His inner strength was soaring.
Before long.
He consumed 70 pieces of hundred-year-old Great Medicine.
[Inner Power Value +60]
Upon reaching this point.
Ding Ling noticed that chewing hundred-year-old Great Medicine had become almost ineffective in improving Inner Strength, so he gave up on hundred-year-old ones for two-hundred-year ones.
He consumed 100 pieces.
[Inner Power Value +230]
The 200-year-old Great Medicine was swept clean.
Then he ate other Great Medicine.
Finally.
[Inner Power Value +410]
In total, the Inner Power Value increased by 700 points!
Unsurprisingly.
Two more points of True Water split out.
As it stands now:
[True Power Value: 5 points]
"It seems like 300 Inner Power Value points can split out 1 point of True Water."
Ding Ling mused.
"After reaching the 5-point True Water Realm, I feel I’m not far from the peak value either."
Previously with one or two points of True Water, he never felt where the world’s inner power limit was.
But with five points of True Water present.
Ding Ling finally sensed the omnipresent shackles and confines of this world’s power.
As expected.
Six points of True Water should be the limit.
By then, Ding Ling would truly be the ultimate martial artist in this world!
"Very good."
Ding Ling let out a long shout, his voice splitting the skies, causing the rolling waves ahead to tumble.
Qu Feiyan, Consort Yhu, Huang Zhonggong, and others all changed their expressions.
Each looked at Ding Ling with adoration, admiration, amazement, or embarrassment at their own inferiority.
"Let’s continue on our journey."
Ding Ling saw that Dan Qingsheng had found a boatman.
He began to lead the horses onto the boat.
As for the treasures sent by those men.
Ding Ling naturally did not need empty boxes that were used up.
The remaining treasures were all placed into the Storage Bag one by one.
If the Storage Bag couldn’t hold them, some were put onto the ship.
Ding Ling planned to prepare some medicinal baths for Qu Feiyan, Lin Pingzhi, and others after crossing the river, to enhance their strength.
Plenty of hundred-year-old Great Medicine still remained.
As the hundred-year-old Great Medicine was already of no use to him, it was naturally left for Qu Feiyan and others to use.
Perhaps not long after.
He would reach the world’s upper limit value.
Truly reaching that step.
Any medicine Ding Ling gained would be useless for him!
By then Lin Pingzhi, Qu Feiyan, and others would naturally be prioritized.
Using it on anyone is still using it.
Of course, priority should be given to one’s own people.
The Yangtze River journey is long.
There will always be a time to dock.
After docking.
Ding Ling started preparing medicinal baths for a few people.
While they were in the medicinal bath.
Ding Ling didn’t forget to guide Huang Zhonggong and a few others.
This was what Ding Ling promised Huang Zhonggong and Ding Jian before, he couldn’t take advantage of Ding Jian and the others and do nothing.
For his own people or people he recognized.
Ding Ling cannot do such a thing.
To villains and the like, Ding Ling can naturally go back on his word.
But for virtuous and ethical friends, his own people, Ding Ling must keep his word!
Everything was developing steadily and orderly.
Qu Feiyan and others’ strengths were steadily rising.

Consort Yhu, blessed with extraordinary talent, made remarkably rapid initial progress in cultivating Inner Power, aided by medicinal baths, the progress was swift, drawing envy from Dan Qingsheng and others.
One day.
They arrived at a riverside city.
Suddenly there was another burst of drumbeats ahead.
Looking closely.
A vast crowd approached.
Each person holding a jar or two of wine.
Before they even came close.
A burly man in a blue robe at the front loudly shouted:
"Is the great Hero Ding Ling ahead?"
Qu Feiyan was speechless.
Consort Yhu also couldn’t help but glance over.

Huang Zhonggong and several others had not ventured into the Jianghu for over a decade. After briefly joining Ding Ling, they encountered many affairs, including this offering gifts, which they met repeatedly, amazed and curious.
But they quickly came to an understanding.
Each thought:

"Ding Ling is extraordinarily gifted, with martial skills unsurpassed in the world, looking around, it’s hard to find a rival. It’s quite normal for others to flatter him, shower him with praises, and try to please him in every way."
After coming to terms, when they looked at those offering gifts again, they seemed like they were observing rich heroes who were good at currying favor!
