chapters.title: Chapter 339: Zu Qianqiu of the Yellow River Ancestor
paragraphs: "That’s right. I am Ding Ling!"
Ding Ling felt something peculiar in his heart.
At that moment.
He suddenly remembered why he felt this strange sense of familiarity.

Isn’t this the scene where Linghu Chong encountered Ren Yingying in Luoyang, and then the members of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect wanted to curry favor with Ren Yingying, so they each stepped forward to give gifts to Linghu Chong?
How did this happen to me today?
At this moment, Ding Ling thought about Ren Yingying, Linghu Chong, Ren Woxing, Xiaang Wentian, and others.
He pondered:

"I haven’t met Ren Yingying yet, so I don’t know what kind of person she is. But I have interacted with Ren Woxing, Xiaang Wentian, and Linghu Chong. Looking at the current scene, it’s most likely that Xiaang Wentian came up with a bad idea, and Ren Woxing adopted it and wrote to Ren Yingying to make this grand affair happen.
Just that no matter what Ren Woxing does, he’s probably made a miscalculation.
I’m not going to follow him to become any Bright Right Envoy of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect."
Ren Woxing’s perseverance and resilience are truly unrivaled!
There’s no reason he would easily give up on someone or something!
Clearly.
He’s set his sights on Ding Ling. Before he gets Ding Ling’s support, he likely won’t let go.
After realizing this, Ding Ling made a plan in his heart:
"I’ve enjoyed the benefits and taken quite a bit, but there’s no way I can give them back. At most, I can repay them the favor when a suitable opportunity arises in the future."
Thinking this, Ding Ling felt relieved, but he didn’t really want to accept the gifts that these men were giving afterward.
Not understanding was fine.
Understanding that it was arranged by Xiaang Wentian and Ren Woxing made Ding Ling uncomfortable.
Were it not for the small friendship with Xiaang Wentian, just based on Ren Woxing’s tactics and personality, Ding Ling would most likely have beaten him to death.
But unexpectedly, once these men confirmed that Ding Ling was indeed himself, they quickly put down the wine jars, turned, and ran away.
The leading man in the green shirt shouted while running:
"Hero Ding, please don’t make things difficult for us. This was ordered emphatically by our Gang Leader. If the gifts aren’t delivered properly, our lives are at risk.
Just pity us and help us out by accepting the gifts!"
As the man in the green shirt finished speaking, he had already followed the crowd into an alley in the city and was not seen again.
Qu Feiyan, Lin Pingzhi, and others exchanged glances, then collectively looked at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling said helplessly:
"Then let’s accept them."
Accepting one is still accepting.
Accepting two is also accepting.
Ding Ling chose to go with the flow.
He wanted to see what Ren Woxing was up to.
But there was quite a lot of wine.
Fortunately, Ding Ling had a Storage Pouch; he had previously emptied some Great Medicine and tonic during his journey, and now putting the wine inside was just right.
Of course.
Although there was a lot of wine, the Storage Bag couldn’t hold all of it. After all, the bag contained quite a few other miscellaneous items.
Even so.
Huang Zhonggong and others couldn’t help but exclaim more than once:
"Truly an Immortal Treasure. If one had this treasure at hand, wandering the Jianghu for one or two months wouldn’t fear thirst or hunger."
They admired and were astonished.
Consort Yhu felt the same.
Frequently glancing at Ding Ling.
As Qu Feiyan, in admiration, narrated Ding Ling’s affairs, both great and small, in detail, Consort Yhu grew a bit of respect for Ding Ling.
She felt Ding Ling was someone who didn’t pale compared to the Overlord, and might even be stronger.
From martial arts and other aspects, to Exotic Techniques, and Magical Treasures, the Overlord couldn’t compare.
This was very objective.
Even though Consort Yhu deemed the Overlord as the World’s Number One, unmatched, she couldn’t erase this objective truth.
"Come. Drink."
Ding Ling opened a jar of ’Top-Grade Imperial Wine,’ sharing drinks with Huang Zhonggong and others.
Gululu!
With his profound skills and extraordinary physique, he drank heartily, gululu, a jar of wine down his gullet, his face not red, nor gasping, merely burping, he laughed aloud:
"Good wine, good wine!"
He didn’t usually drink much.
But he had tasted quite a few good wines.
Unlike the beer of the real world, true good wine was aromatic, slightly sweet, intoxicating!
A sip swallowed.
Could intoxicate a person, even someone who doesn’t understand or like wine, someone who hasn’t drunk before, when they take a sip of this good wine, they’d find it delicious.
And this Top-Grade Imperial Wine.
Is the best of wines, a top-notch wine, quite rare.
After consuming.
Ding Ling’s skills seemed slightly enhanced.
Though not evident, given his high level, it was so.
One can imagine for others.

Huang Zhonggong, Qu Feiyan, Consort Yhu, Lin Pingzhi, and others, after drinking, were intoxicated; some with naturally weak Inner Strength, having half a jar, just felt their belly burning like fire, unconsciously sitting cross-legged on the ground, starting to absorb and refine the potent medicinal properties of the wine for their use.
This jar after jar of wine contained many excellent medicinal herbs.
With Huang Zhonggong and others achieving a First-class Realm, they quickly sobered, awed, yet somewhat bashful for having consumed such fine wine.
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"Wandering Jianghu, as a team, there’s no need for such formality. Besides, I alone can’t drink so much, nor take all of it away."
The Storage Bag was already full.
Ding Ling couldn’t possibly stay here drinking alone.
Could only casually set a few jars on the side of a horse’s belly, others followed suit, still, there was plenty.
"Hahaha..."
A long shout, coming from afar, getting closer:
"Such exquisite wine, how could it not include me, Zu Qianqiu?"

A worn-out scholar with lusterless yellow skin, tattered clothes, a broken fan in his right hand, a bag in his left, charged forward like the wind, suddenly halted before Ding Ling and the others, yet stood steadily.
From this, it’s clear this scholar named Zu Qianqiu must be a First-class Expert.
He bowed to Ding Ling, smiling:
"Might you be Hero Ding Ling?"
"I am Ding Ling."
Ding Ling nodded, feeling quite familiar with the name Zu Qianqiu:
"Are you Zu Qianqiu, who is equally famed alongside Yellow River Ancestor?"
"No less, that’s me."
Zu Qianqiu’s eyes lit up slightly, appearing a bit surprised and delighted:
"Hero Ding Ling actually knows my name, Zu Qianqiu."
Anyone who’s read the novels or watched the series should be aware.
Ding Ling thought this, without revealing, just smiling slightly:
"With the Yellow River Ancestor renown far and wide, what’s strange about hearing your names?"
"Haha..."
Zu Qianqiu felt immensely pleased, laughing thrice, abruptly stopping, eyes bright as he looked at Ding Ling:
"Others knowing my name isn’t worth cheer or pride, but Hero Ding Ling knows my name, for that alone, we must drink well together."
He looked at the jars of exquisite wine on the ground, swallowing hard, seemed irresistibly tempted, his eyes glowing green.

sentences.text: "That’s right.
I am Ding Ling!"
Ding Ling felt something peculiar in his heart.
At that moment.
He suddenly remembered why he felt this strange sense of familiarity.

Isn’t this the scene where Linghu Chong encountered Ren Yingying in Luoyang, and then the members of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect wanted to curry favor with Ren Yingying, so they each stepped forward to give gifts to Linghu Chong?
How did this happen to me today?
At this moment, Ding Ling thought about Ren Yingying, Linghu Chong, Ren Woxing, Xiaang Wentian, and others.
He pondered:
"I haven’t met Ren Yingying yet, so I don’t know what kind of person she is.
But I have interacted with Ren Woxing, Xiaang Wentian, and Linghu Chong.
Looking at the current scene, it’s most likely that Xiaang Wentian came up with a bad idea, and Ren Woxing adopted it and wrote to Ren Yingying to make this grand affair happen.
Just that no matter what Ren Woxing does, he’s probably made a miscalculation.
I’m not going to follow him to become any Bright Right Envoy of the Sun and Moon Divine Sect."
Ren Woxing’s perseverance and resilience are truly unrivaled!
There’s no reason he would easily give up on someone or something!
Clearly.
He’s set his sights on Ding Ling.
Before he gets Ding Ling’s support, he likely won’t let go.
After realizing this, Ding Ling made a plan in his heart:
"I’ve enjoyed the benefits and taken quite a bit, but there’s no way I can give them back.
At most, I can repay them the favor when a suitable opportunity arises in the future."
Thinking this, Ding Ling felt relieved, but he didn’t really want to accept the gifts that these men were giving afterward.
Not understanding was fine.
Understanding that it was arranged by Xiaang Wentian and Ren Woxing made Ding Ling uncomfortable.
Were it not for the small friendship with Xiaang Wentian, just based on Ren Woxing’s tactics and personality, Ding Ling would most likely have beaten him to death.
But unexpectedly, once these men confirmed that Ding Ling was indeed himself, they quickly put down the wine jars, turned, and ran away.
The leading man in the green shirt shouted while running:
"Hero Ding, please don’t make things difficult for us.
This was ordered emphatically by our Gang Leader.
If the gifts aren’t delivered properly, our lives are at risk.
Just pity us and help us out by accepting the gifts!"
As the man in the green shirt finished speaking, he had already followed the crowd into an alley in the city and was not seen again.
Qu Feiyan, Lin Pingzhi, and others exchanged glances, then collectively looked at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling said helplessly:
"Then let’s accept them."
Accepting one is still accepting.
Accepting two is also accepting.
Ding Ling chose to go with the flow.
He wanted to see what Ren Woxing was up to.
But there was quite a lot of wine.
Fortunately, Ding Ling had a Storage Pouch; he had previously emptied some Great Medicine and tonic during his journey, and now putting the wine inside was just right.
Of course.
Although there was a lot of wine, the Storage Bag couldn’t hold all of it.
After all, the bag contained quite a few other miscellaneous items.
Even so.
Huang Zhonggong and others couldn’t help but exclaim more than once:
"Truly an Immortal Treasure.
If one had this treasure at hand, wandering the Jianghu for one or two months wouldn’t fear thirst or hunger."
They admired and were astonished.
Consort Yhu felt the same.
Frequently glancing at Ding Ling.
As Qu Feiyan, in admiration, narrated Ding Ling’s affairs, both great and small, in detail, Consort Yhu grew a bit of respect for Ding Ling.
She felt Ding Ling was someone who didn’t pale compared to the Overlord, and might even be stronger.
From martial arts and other aspects, to Exotic Techniques, and Magical Treasures, the Overlord couldn’t compare.
This was very objective.
Even though Consort Yhu deemed the Overlord as the World’s Number One, unmatched, she couldn’t erase this objective truth.
"Come.
Drink."
Ding Ling opened a jar of ’Top-Grade Imperial Wine,’ sharing drinks with Huang Zhonggong and others.
Gululu!
With his profound skills and extraordinary physique, he drank heartily, gululu, a jar of wine down his gullet, his face not red, nor gasping, merely burping, he laughed aloud:
"Good wine, good wine!"
He didn’t usually drink much.
But he had tasted quite a few good wines.
Unlike the beer of the real world, true good wine was aromatic, slightly sweet, intoxicating!
A sip swallowed.
Could intoxicate a person, even someone who doesn’t understand or like wine, someone who hasn’t drunk before, when they take a sip of this good wine, they’d find it delicious.
And this Top-Grade Imperial Wine.
Is the best of wines, a top-notch wine, quite rare.
After consuming.
Ding Ling’s skills seemed slightly enhanced.
Though not evident, given his high level, it was so.
One can imagine for others.

chapters.title: Chapter 340: Eight Life-extending Pills
paragraphs: "I wonder if I, Zu Qianqiu, have the honor to drink this fine wine with Hero Ding?"
"Please do."
Ding Ling casually gestured:
"If Zu Qianqiu fancies any jar of fine wine, feel free to take it away."
Anyway, it can’t be finished, can’t be taken.
It’s just right to use ’Ren Woxing’s’ stuff for a favor.
Having lain down, Ding Ling had also seen through things.
Soldiers against generals, water with earth.
Whatever happens, once you’re there, naturally you’ll understand it.
Unexpectedly.

After taking a sip from a jar of fine wine, Zu Qianqiu surprisingly acted seriously. He ceremoniously took out cup after cup, carefully placing them on the level ground. After arranging them, he looked at Ding Ling and smiled:
"Drinking must be accompanied by appropriate utensils! Hero Ding, if you don’t mind, sit down with me for a few drinks? Let me introduce my drinking set to you!"
Ding Ling looked at Zu Qianqiu, then stared at his cups for a couple of glances.
As expected.
Under the light.
Faintly visible inside the cups were scattered some powder.

Within Ding Ling’s Dantian were already five drops of True Water, his ears and eyes far surpassing the average first-class expert. Now, as long as it wasn’t hidden in the dark and not beyond ten meters, everything was crystal clear to his eyes, hard to conceal.
The powder is very small, cleverly blended with the inner wall of the cups, difficult for ordinary first-class experts to detect.
But given what Ding Ling was, he naturally saw through it at a glance.
Thinking of how dramas usually have similar plots.
Ding Ling immediately refused, saying:
"If there’s life-saving medicine hidden in the cups. It’s better not to use it on me."
Zu Qianqiu’s face slightly changed.
His expression became somewhat unnatural.
Ding Ling chuckled:
"I don’t care from whom your medicine came, or what you intend. But if someone else uses it for saving lives, it’s best returned."
Zu Qianqiu’s medicine.
Most likely came from the old man’s Eight Life-extending Pills.
These Eight Life-extending Pills were painstakingly made by the old man, solely to save his daughter’s life.
Ding Ling naturally wouldn’t commit such a vile act knowing this.
If I indeed ate it.
Wouldn’t it harm someone else’s daughter?
His Dantian had already condensed five drops of True Water, anytime possibly condensing the sixth, reaching the ultimate limit of this world, rendering more Great Medicines useless.
Therefore, he didn’t care for such Eight Life-extending Pills.
"Hero Ding, you, you..."
Zu Qianqiu’s face turned slightly red, all his bravado dissipated completely, replaced by awkwardness and embarrassment.
"Farewell then."
The wine that can be carried is taken away.
Those that can’t be carried can only be left here.
Because everyone’s drinking capacity is limited, even if one wants to drink, they can’t drink so much.
Ding Ling thus gave these wines to Zu Qianqiu and then rode away.
"Oh."
Zu Qianqiu watched the departing backs of Ding Ling and his companions, looked at the dozen or so jars of wine on the ground, and couldn’t help but daze on the spot.
He had thought of various outcomes of meeting Ding Ling.
Just didn’t expect it to end in such an embarrassing manner.
"Zu Qianqiu!"

Suddenly, a loud shout came from afar, the owner of the voice was still hundreds of meters away in the previous second, but the next second, he rolled through the void like a ball, landing not far in front of Zu Qianqiu.
After the ball landed heavily, it rolled three times on the ground, suddenly a head popped out, along with two hands and feet, then it was clear the ball was actually a person.
This person was also strange.
One couldn’t see a neck, as if a head was embedded in a body, short and stout, at this moment his big eyes were glaring like copper bells, his face was flushed red with anger:
"Where’s my medicine?!"
He roared.
"Here it is. Here it is."
Zu Qianqiu raised the cup and said:
"Don’t worry, not a bit is touched. I’ll return it to you soon."
"You simply bully too much!"
The man roared:
"If the old man at my house faces any mishap, I will seek your life!"
Zu Qianqiu indifferently pursed his lips, but mumbled two sentences under his breath.
The man grew increasingly furious:
"What are you mumbling about!"
"I was saying Hero Ding really is a true hero, a true brave one! Knowing my cup was smeared with top-grade medicine, he still remained unmoved!"
He pointed at the fine wine beside him:
"He even gifted me so much good wine, truly leaving me humbled and ashamed!"
"Hero Ding Ding Ling?!"
The man was stupefied:
"Which Hero Ding Ling?"
"Which else could it be?"
Zu Qianqiu rolled his eyes at the man:
"Naturally it’s the World’s Number One, Ding Ling, whose name is widely spread across both black and white paths recently!"
"It’s him!"
The man was surprised, looking around:
"Where is he?"
"Ugh.
Speaking of this, Zu Qianqiu’s face became hot:

"I intended to fulfill him, helping him advance his skills further. Unexpectedly, he saw through my actions. Not only did he refuse my medicine, but he also gifted me this excellent wine, medicinal wine. How could I repay such kindness?!"
"Hmph!"
The man looked contemptuously and angrily at Zu Qianqiu:
"Using old man’s Eight Life-extending Pills to gift Hero Ding. Such a thing only you, you bastard, could do! Quick, return my Eight Life-extending Pills."
"Return, return."
Zu Qianqiu scraped some powder off the inner walls of the cups, rolled them into pellets, and soon there were eight pills which he handed to the old man:
"Hero Ding doesn’t care for them, nor do I."
"Bah."
The old man scoffed:
"You don’t even bother to reflect on yourself, yet you wish to compare yourself with Hero Ding?!"
"Hehe."
Zu Qianqiu coldly laughed, fanning the broken fan in his hand, looking down at the old man, he said:
"If I compare with you, indeed I’m a handsome, graceful man! I might not qualify, but you certainly don’t qualify!"
"Haha..."
After collecting the Eight Life-extending Pills, the old man was angered by Zu Qianqiu’s words, laughed in irritation, then with a loud shout, he slapped at Zu Qianqiu:
"Blast it, the old man has disliked you for a long time. Take this palm!"
All along the way.
Various heroes and champions kept sending gifts.
Ding Ling was somewhat numb to it.
Not to mention Qu Feiyan and the others.

Only Huang Zhonggong and the others, who had been staying at Mei Manor for over a decade, suddenly entering Jianghu, witnessed all sorts of extraordinary scenes along the way, feeling greatly broadened in horizons, not regretting the journey.
Moreover, they were shocked by how many grassroots heroes were trying to curry favor with Ding Ling.
Through the lens, one could catch a glimpse.
Ding Ling’s current fame flourished visibly.
Indeed, that was the case.
Ding Ling didn’t know who was secretly spreading his esteemed reputation.
His task 3 progress bar would rise rapidly.
[3: Your World’s Number One name must resonate throughout the Plane World. 13%/100%.]
From 1% to 13%.
Clearly.
There was certainly someone aiding secretly.
Because Ding Ling defeating Ren Woxing was known to only a few.
Ding Ling didn’t actively promote it.
Who could know?

chapters.title: Chapter 341: Blue Phoenix
paragraphs: "Could it be Ren Woxing’s doing?!"
Ding Ling thought to himself:
"If Ren Woxing actively proclaims my fame as the World’s Number One, he must have really invested a lot!"
He not only invested heavily in resources,
but also in reputation!
To Ren Woxing,
he is the World’s Number One! Unrivaled and unmatched!
Yet now he is willing to lower his stature to ’flatter’ me, Ding Ling!
This is equivalent to cutting his flesh.
Drinking his blood!
Ding Ling was moved and thought:

"Ren Woxing is ruthless, never stopping until he achieves his goal. It seems he really has his sights set on me! But he surely couldn’t have expected that I would make such great progress in such a short time!"
After swallowing these ’gifts’,
Ding Ling’s physical attributes reached the maximum value of this world.
True Water also condensed into five points.
His strength underwent a massive transformation, far surpassing the level he had at Mei Manor by more than a grade!
When facing off again,
Ding Ling could now strike one palm to send Ren Woxing flying a hundred meters!
"As long as you’re strong enough, no demon, ghost, or conspiracy is to be feared!"
Ding Ling raised his brows, calm and unburdened!
As they traveled on,
by the time Ding Ling and his companions had exhausted the Great Medicine, wine, and other supplies, they were almost at Luoyang City.
"Luoyang City."
Ding Ling thought of the heroic city from the Three Kingdoms.
He was curious if this world’s Luoyang City differed from that of the Three Kingdoms World.
He glanced at Qu Feiyan and the others.
On this journey,
the tonic medicines, restorative wines, and more were consumed one after another.
Combined with Ding Ling’s high-level guidance, which consistently hit the core issues and provided incisive analysis, accurate and precise!
This caused the cultivation and martial arts skills of individuals like Consort Yhu, Qu Feiyan, Lin Pingzhi, and Ding Jian to rise dramatically!
Figures like Qu Feiyan and Consort Yhu, who were exceptionally intelligent and gifted, had taken significant leaps forward, reaching a qualitative difference compared to the past!
This is the result of a ’Full Level main account leading small accounts’!
If it were other experts guiding them, even with numerous Great Medicines and wines, such results might not have been achieved.
Yet with Ding Ling’s various Divine Skills at full level, his instructions were focused and insightful, always striking home!
The cultivation of Consort Yhu and the others soared rapidly.
For the knowledgeable, things aren’t difficult.
For the less knowledgeable, things are extraordinarily challenging.
Often, when one has mastered certain Kung Fu, it seems easy, but when not mastered, it feels insurmountable.
With Ding Ling’s guidance, for Consort Yhu, Ding Jian, and others, it felt as if they had activated cheats, or as if their comprehension attributes were maxed out.
They rarely encountered any significant obstacles!
"Tread, tread!"
The horses galloped.
It wasn’t long before
Ding Ling and his group glimpsed the majestic giant city towering on the ground.
"Luoyang City, we have arrived!"
From afar, the bustling scene of carriages and horse-drawn carts, people bustling endlessly at the city gates, was visible.
"Let’s enter to rest for a bit before continuing our journey."
Upon reaching Luoyang,
they were close to Huashan.
Jingle, jingle!
Unexpectedly, at this moment, accompanied by the crisp ringing of a bell, a group of young women with black hair and bare feet emerged from a position to the rear.
The leading woman’s charms were captivating, her grace akin to the Nine Heavens Fox Immortal descending to the Mortal World, at first sight, leaving a stunning impression.
Ding Ling and his companions couldn’t help but pause in astonishment.
Seeing this woman, he involuntarily thought of Du Qingcheng.
Du Qingcheng also possessed that charming fox-like allure and beauty!
The difference being, Du Qingcheng exuded a dignified elegance, classical grace amidst her charm,
whereas the woman before them was pure allure, beauty, and innocence.
Like a spirit of the mountains, resembling a Nine Skies Fairy Fox traversing the forest.
In terms of beauty,
this woman was not inferior to Du Qingcheng and was a rare peerless beauty.
"So beautiful."
Qu Feiyan watched, full of admiration and fascination, unable to refrain from exclaiming.
"Hee hee hee."
The woman hesitated at the sound, then her face brightened with a charming smile, giggling as she scanned Qu Feiyan, saying with a smile:
"This little sister has such sweet words. I like you a lot."

Qu Feiyan snapped back, feeling slightly warm on her face, bashful, involuntarily glancing at Ding Ling, and seeing that Ding Ling seemed indifferent to the situation, she couldn’t help but feel a little relieved.
"You must be Ding Ling, Hero Ding."
The woman ignored Huang Zhonggong and the others, walking directly up to Ding Ling, raising her head to look at him with a charming smile:
"I am Blue Phoenix. I came specifically to find you this time."
She took a breath, smiling as she said:
"You all are really fast. I’ve been trailing behind you for days, barely catching up at the gates of Luoyang City. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have been able to fulfill my duties."
"The Sect Leader of the Five Poison Sect, Blue Phoenix?"
Dan Qingsheng was surprised, his expression changing as he spoke.
"It’s the Five Immortals Sect."
Blue Phoenix cast a glance at Dan Qingsheng:
"’Be careful next time.’
Dan Qingsheng’s face turned pale, and he sheepishly fell silent.
He seemed terribly afraid of Blue Phoenix.
"What brings Sect Leader Blue to seek me out?"
Ding Ling dismounted to face Blue Phoenix directly.
He had already guessed some things.
Sure enough.
As Blue Phoenix clapped her hands,
a slim young woman cautiously approached Ding Ling with a jar of wine.
Blue Phoenix reached out, took the jar, and presented it to Ding Ling with a smile:

"This is the Five Immortals Rejuvenating Wine. It’s brewed by our Five Immortals Sect’s ancestral Secret Technique. If you drink this wine, not only will you gain a decade’s worth of Kung Fu out of nowhere, but you’ll also be free from all illnesses, impervious to all poisons!"
She paused, then said:
"So what do you think? Do you dare to drink it?"
"Why wouldn’t I dare?"
Ding Ling’s heart raced at the mention of being impervious to poisons.
His greatest fear was being poisoned!
Now, with someone offering such potent Rejuvenating Wine, it would eliminate the possibility of him being easily poisoned or overwhelmed by toxins in the future.
How could Ding Ling pass this up?
Without further ado,

he accepted the wine jar, opened the seal, peeked inside, and used the Medicine King Breathing Technique to ensure there were no toxins. Only then did he tilt the jar, raising it to his lips, pouring the wine into his mouth like a swift stream.
Ding Ling drank heartily.
In less than a quarter-hour, the entire jar of wine was consumed.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
This Five Immortals Rejuvenating Wine indeed had extremely potent medicinal effects!
Once ingested,
the overwhelming medicinal power was continuously refined!
With Pure Yang True Skill operating rapidly, Ding Ling’s inner strength surged rapidly!
In just a short moment, his Inner Power Value increased by 100.
Not only that,
Ding Ling could also clearly sense a mysterious resistance permeating his limbs, bones, and organs at that moment.
This was a poison resistance!
"Indeed, this is exquisite wine."
Ding Ling took a deep breath, expressing his admiration.
He could clearly feel that the fifth drop of True Water in his Dantian seemed ready to split into a sixth drop at any moment.
Once that sixth drop split out,
perhaps he would have reached the pinnacle and extreme max value of this world!
The increase in inner strength was impressive, but the most important thing was that Blue Phoenix told no lies; after drinking, he indeed became impervious to all poisons.

Ding Ling thought to himself:
"If Ren Woxing actively proclaims my fame as the World’s Number One, he must have really invested a lot!"
He not only invested heavily in resources,
but also in reputation!
To Ren Woxing,
he is the World’s Number One!
Unrivaled and unmatched!
Yet now he is willing to lower his stature to ’flatter’ me, Ding Ling!
This is equivalent to cutting his flesh.
Drinking his blood!
Ding Ling was moved and thought:
"Ren Woxing is ruthless, never stopping until he achieves his goal.
It seems he really has his sights set on me!
But he surely couldn’t have expected that I would make such great progress in such a short time!"
After swallowing these ’gifts’,
Ding Ling’s physical attributes reached the maximum value of this world.
True Water also condensed into five points.
His strength underwent a massive transformation, far surpassing the level he had at Mei Manor by more than a grade!
When facing off again,
Ding Ling could now strike one palm to send Ren Woxing flying a hundred meters!
"As long as you’re strong enough, no demon, ghost, or conspiracy is to be feared!"
Ding Ling raised his brows, calm and unburdened!
As they traveled on,
by the time Ding Ling and his companions had exhausted the Great Medicine, wine, and other supplies, they were almost at Luoyang City.
"Luoyang City."
Ding Ling thought of the heroic city from the Three Kingdoms.
He was curious if this world’s Luoyang City differed from that of the Three Kingdoms World.
He glanced at Qu Feiyan and the others.
On this journey,
the tonic medicines, restorative wines, and more were consumed one after another.
Combined with Ding Ling’s high-level guidance, which consistently hit the core issues and provided incisive analysis, accurate and precise!
This caused the cultivation and martial arts skills of individuals like Consort Yhu, Qu Feiyan, Lin Pingzhi, and Ding Jian to rise dramatically!
Figures like Qu Feiyan and Consort Yhu, who were exceptionally intelligent and gifted, had taken significant leaps forward, reaching a qualitative difference compared to the past!
This is the result of a ’Full Level main account leading small accounts’!
If it were other experts guiding them, even with numerous Great Medicines and wines, such results might not have been achieved.
Yet with Ding Ling’s various Divine Skills at full level, his instructions were focused and insightful, always striking home!
The cultivation of Consort Yhu and the others soared rapidly.
For the knowledgeable, things aren’t difficult.
For the less knowledgeable, things are extraordinarily challenging.
Often, when one has mastered certain Kung Fu, it seems easy, but when not mastered, it feels insurmountable.
With Ding Ling’s guidance, for Consort Yhu, Ding Jian, and others, it felt as if they had activated cheats, or as if their comprehension attributes were maxed out.
They rarely encountered any significant obstacles!
"Tread, tread!"
The horses galloped.
It wasn’t long before
Ding Ling and his group glimpsed the majestic giant city towering on the ground.
"Luoyang City, we have arrived!"
From afar, the bustling scene of carriages and horse-drawn carts, people bustling endlessly at the city gates, was visible.
"Let’s enter to rest for a bit before continuing our journey."
Upon reaching Luoyang,
they were close to Huashan.
Jingle, jingle!
Unexpectedly, at this moment, accompanied by the crisp ringing of a bell, a group of young women with black hair and bare feet emerged from a position to the rear.
The leading woman’s charms were captivating, her grace akin to the Nine Heavens Fox Immortal descending to the Mortal World, at first sight, leaving a stunning impression.
Ding Ling and his companions couldn’t help but pause in astonishment.
Seeing this woman, he involuntarily thought of Du Qingcheng.
Du Qingcheng also possessed that charming fox-like allure and beauty!
The difference being, Du Qingcheng exuded a dignified elegance, classical grace amidst her charm,
whereas the woman before them was pure allure, beauty, and innocence.
Like a spirit of the mountains, resembling a Nine Skies Fairy Fox traversing the forest.
In terms of beauty,
this woman was not inferior to Du Qingcheng and was a rare peerless beauty.
"So beautiful."
Qu Feiyan watched, full of admiration and fascination, unable to refrain from exclaiming.
"Hee hee hee."
The woman hesitated at the sound, then her face brightened with a charming smile, giggling as she scanned Qu Feiyan, saying with a smile:
"This little sister has such sweet words.
I like you a lot."

Qu Feiyan snapped back, feeling slightly warm on her face, bashful, involuntarily glancing at Ding Ling, and seeing that Ding Ling seemed indifferent to the situation, she couldn’t help but feel a little relieved.
"You must be Ding Ling, Hero Ding."
The woman ignored Huang Zhonggong and the others, walking directly up to Ding Ling, raising her head to look at him with a charming smile:
"I am Blue Phoenix.
I came specifically to find you this time."

chapters.title: Chapter 342: A Delightful Conversation
paragraphs: Let’s not talk about being immune to all poisons.
At the very least, it must be achieved that ordinary toxins find it difficult to invade the internal organs!
With the Medicine King Breathing Technique, Qingnang Scripture, and other aids, Ding Ling’s ability to preserve his life has greatly increased!
Going outside now, there’s no need to worry about being poisoned by those skilled in using toxins.
"What courage!"
Blue Phoenix was also stunned on the spot by Ding Ling’s bold move, but soon, she laughed charmingly and said:

"Knowing I’m Blue Phoenix of the Five Immortals Sect, yet you still dare to drink the wine I gave you! No wonder you are the legendary World’s Number One Hero Ding Ling! Setting aside your martial arts skills—just your courage is hard to match."
The name of Blue Phoenix, Sect Leader of the Five Poison Sect, is enough to deter enemies.
Ordinary people wouldn’t dare to eat her food or drink her wine.
Just approaching her would fill them with terror.
Ding Ling, however, could remain unfazed and handle it with ease!
How could this not make Blue Phoenix admire and praise him internally, thinking:
"No wonder the Saintess values this man! Such a man is rare!"
"I still haven’t thanked Sect Leader Blue for the Five Immortals Rejuvenating Wine you gifted!"
Ding Ling smiled slightly and said:
"I’m just very curious. We are strangers to each other, so why would Sect Leader Blue present me with such a valuable wine? Is there something you want, or are you just following someone’s orders?"
"Hero Ding is straightforward and wise, so I won’t hide it from you."
Blue Phoenix glanced around, suddenly approached Ding Ling, and whispered:
"Someone has issued orders to heroes in both the underworld and orthodox circles. We approached you with lavish gifts to please her."
Ding Ling had an inkling of the answer, but deliberately asked:
"Who is she?"
"I can’t say."
Blue Phoenix seemed to be a very straightforward and honest person, her emotions readily visible on her face, allowing Ding Ling to clearly judge from her expressions and eyes whether she was lying.
Obviously.
Blue Phoenix was such a straightforward and simple person, not hiding her true self, as pure and clean as a blooming white lotus in the world.
Despite her alluring beauty like a demon, it did not affect her internal essence in the slightest.
Ding Ling also appreciated the rejuvenating wine she gifted. After communicating with her and understanding her nature, he couldn’t help but feel a bit of admiration.
For a moment.
The two chatted happily.
Blue Phoenix occasionally covered her mouth and chuckled, displaying the charm of a beautiful woman.
She was also carefree about being in public, interacting closely and playfully with Ding Ling.
Seeing this scene.
They seemed like a flirtatious couple deeply in love.
Qu Feiyan watched from the side, feeling somewhat sour, pouting in silent anger.
Consort Yhu stepped forward to comfort her in a low voice.
Only then did Qu Feiyan feel a bit better, but at that moment, she couldn’t help but feel uncomfortable about Blue Phoenix, losing her previous enthusiasm and warmth.
After finishing her chat with Ding Ling, Blue Phoenix suddenly flew over to Qu Feiyan’s side and whispered:
"Dear sister, I won’t compete with you for your Brother Ding. Rest assured."
Before the blushing Qu Feiyan could speak,
Blue Phoenix laughed and leapt away, barefoot, flying into the distance.
Ting-a-ling!
A gust of wind blew by.
The bells at Blue Phoenix’s waist rang out a crisp sound.
She came with the crisp ringing.
And left with the ringing.
Ding Ling glanced at the fading figure of Blue Phoenix, sighing silently. After parting this time, it might be very difficult to meet again in this lifetime.
"Hyah!"
Ding Ling didn’t think too much, leaping onto a horse and riding towards the gate of Luoyang City.
Qu Feiyan looked dazedly at the place where Blue Phoenix disappeared, her mind in turmoil, seemingly a bit entranced for a moment.
"What’s wrong?"
Consort Yhu rode over to Qu Feiyan and asked.
"Did I do something wrong?"
Qu Feiyan felt a bit sad, tugging at her clothes and saying:
"Blue Phoenix is so good to Brother Ding. I shouldn’t be jealous."
"Jealousy is just human nature."
Consort Yhu said with a smile:

"Even siblings get jealous when they see their mother favoring another sibling. Moreover, you admire and idolize your Brother Ding so much; he is your only close family in this world. Seeing someone close to him, worrying they might take him away, is as natural as siblings fearing another might take away maternal love.
With time, it will pass."
She paused, glanced at Ding Ling’s back, and said to Qu Feiyan:

"Moreover, you are still considerate of your Brother Ding. He couldn’t possibly blame you. If you really feel upset about it, next time you meet Blue Phoenix, you can also invite her to a meal with some rejuvenating wine. Wouldn’t that pay back the favor?"
"Sister makes a lot of sense."
Qu Feiyan’s eyes lit up slightly, but soon she felt dejected:
"Brother Ding helps and guides me so much, but I can’t help him at all. I feel so useless."
"How can you say that? Doing the laundry and cooking along the way, how could your Brother Ding eat and sleep well without you?"
An individual overly concerned about another individual.
Will fall into a mindset of gaining and losing.
Very clearly.
Even the smartest person will have imbalanced thoughts when falling into such a mindset, affecting their judgment.
Ding Ling didn’t deliberately eavesdrop on the conversation of the young women.
So he didn’t know what Consort Yhu and Qu Feiyan just said.
After entering Luoyang City.
He discovered a servant hurriedly running towards him, raising his hand and shouting:
"Hero Ding, over here, over here!"
Ding Ling puzzled.
The servant said:

"Someone has already booked a top-notch feast for you at Yanfu Pavilion, just waiting for you to come over. You must not decline, or else I can’t explain it. I’ve been standing guard outside the city gates for two days and nights to receive Hero Ding. See?"
The servant pointed at his eyes:
"Dark circles! Aren’t they obvious?"
"Oh?"
Ding Ling thought to himself:
"Could it be Ren Woxing’s scheme again?"
He sighed internally, realizing such generous hospitality was overwhelming. All the way northward, he had been warmly welcomed by the local heroes along the way.
Ding Ling’s cultivation was almost reaching its peak.
Lin Pingzhi, Qu Feiyan, and others naturally made breakthrough after breakthrough, becoming incomparable to their past selves.
Since someone was showing hospitality,
Unable to decline such kindness, Ding Ling naturally went along.
The servant was extremely grateful, proactively taking Ding Ling’s horse.
With many twists and turns.
After passing through several wide and long streets, they arrived at Yanfu Pavilion.
It was a tavern located in the east of the city.
Not lavishly magnificent.
But not remote either.
Just a middle-tier establishment.
Ding Ling was puzzled.
All along the way.
Ren Woxing always went all out.
Why did it fall short at this Luoyang tavern at the end?
Or perhaps the shopkeeper of Yanfu Pavilion had limited resources, only able to entertain here.
Though confused,
since he was already there, and having experienced the journey.

chapters.title: Chapter 343: Killing Intent! Zuo Lengchan
paragraphs: Ding Ling followed the servant into the restaurant.
Qu Feiyan and the others followed closely behind.
Inside the restaurant, people came and went, amidst shouts, the waiter, sweating profusely, carried dishes around quickly from place to place.
Clearly.
The business here was flourishing.
The servant led Ding Ling’s group to a private room on the second floor.
On the first floor, many guests frequently glanced at Ding Ling’s group, pointing and whispering, without knowing what they were saying.
Ding Ling’s ears moved slightly.
He heard them talking about Consort Yhu, and himself.
He couldn’t help but be aware.
Talking about Consort Yhu, naturally because of her beauty, unrivaled in the world.
Talking about himself, naturally due to his recent fame, which some people have noted, comparing his appearance and stature with the rumored ’Ding Ling’.
Some people, after comparing, seem to be sure that Ding Ling is indeed the world’s number one Ding Ling, and couldn’t help but exclaim.
"Unexpected that the name of the world’s number one has already reached Luoyang."
Ding Ling reflected, pondering:
"Even some natives of Luoyang seem to know me. Ren Woxing’s ability to stir trouble is really significant. Or maybe, Ren Yingying is a master strategist, comparable to Zhuge Liang among women?"
Whatever the truth is.
Perhaps once meeting Ren Yingying, everything will become clear.
But despite reaching Luoyang.
Ren Yingying still hasn’t appeared?
Ding Ling was puzzled.
But he didn’t pursue it further.
Whether she appears or not hardly affects his determination to go to Huashan to learn the Dugu Nine Swords.
Inner strength is important.
But martial skill is equally vital!
As the pinnacle sword technique in martial arts, Ding Ling could not miss witnessing the Dugu Nine Swords.
Coming to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World and not learning the Dugu Nine Swords, where would he learn it?
Ding Ling didn’t want to miss the opportunity.
Clip-clop!
Just as Ding Ling’s group settled in the private room.
The waiter quickly brought platters of delicacies.
Chicken, duck, fish, seafood, deer antler, bird’s nest—and everything one could wish for.
Truly a sumptuous feast.
As Ding Ling signaled that they could start eating, Huang Zhonggong laughed heartily, saying:
"Traveling with Ding Ling all the way, I’ve been truly fortunate to enjoy delicious meals. I seem to have gained quite a bit of weight over this period."
"Indeed."
Dan Qingsheng stretched out his chopsticks, picked up a chicken leg, and was about to put it in his mouth when Ding Ling suddenly said:
’Wait!’
"What?
The chicken leg was almost at his lips.
As Ding Ling spoke, Dan Qingsheng restrained his saliva, pulled the chicken leg back from his mouth, and looked at Ding Ling with confusion:
"What’s the matter?"
"Hmm."
Ding Ling’s eyes scanned the table full of dishes; under his Innate Expert gaze, every dish seemed to emit a faint glow.
This is the glow of poison.

With the True Water in Ding Ling’s Dantian nearing six drops! Under the operation of Pure Yang True Skill, Medicine King Breathing Technique, Qingnang Scripture, Inner Scripture, and others, everything was utterly clear in his eyes.
"Poison!"
Ding Ling uttered two words.
Everyone’s expressions changed drastically and they stood up abruptly, instinctively clutching the weapons at their waists.
"Hahaha..."
A wild laugh erupted from outside the private room:
"You truly deserve the name of the world’s number one Ding Ling! Exceptional eyesight. Too bad, too bad, no matter how strong you are, now you can only drink my footwashing water and fall!"
With those words.
It seemed to trigger a chain reaction.
Plunk!
Plunk!
Consort Yhu, Qu Feiyan, Huang Zhonggong, Lin Pingzhi, and others unexpectedly fell to the ground one after another, looking pale at Ding Ling. Qu Feiyan even opened her mouth to say:
"Brother Ding, there’s poison in the air. Run quickly, don’t mind us!"
"Hehe. Want to run? It’s too late!"
Crackling!
Thunderous sounds sliced through the air, and subsequently, the private room where Ding Ling was located was locked by iron bars descending from the sky.
In an instant.
The private room turned into a cage.
And at that moment.
A figure appeared outside the door, revealing a person who was tall, over eight feet, composed in demeanor, with an overbearing aura, a middle-aged man.
His aura was flamboyant and unrestrained, resembling a whirlwind sweeping through.
He coldly stared at Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling. Finally seeing you! You truly kept me waiting!"
Ding Ling sneered at the man, coldly:
"Who do you think you are?"
Ding Ling hadn’t imagined that even though he was so cautious, he still fell into a trap.
It can only be said.
The power of habit is terrifying.
From south to north, he was always praised and flattered, becoming accustomed and numb to it.

Coming to Luoyang, gifted with the Five Immortals Rejuvenating Wine by Blue Phoenix, and then entering Luoyang City, being told by the servant that someone invited him and specifically waited, seemed natural and normal.
Now upon reflection.
Once such a habitual thought process is established, it becomes overwhelming.
The person scheming in the shadows.
Probably seized this habitual thought process to give Ding Ling a severe blow.
Thus, it is evident.
The one scheming and poisoning must be a venomous snake or wolf, who wouldn’t act unless certain, and once they do, it must be with a deadly plan!
"Hahaha..."
The man laughed aloud:

"You don’t know me, but I know you completely. As they say, knowing oneself and the enemy leads to victory in every battle! Now that I have the upper hand, you are trapped like a turtle in a jar. You ask who I am? Haha."
He mocked:
"You’re not even worth mentioning compared to an onion."
He waved his sleeve, swish swish swish!
Rows of archers suddenly appeared behind the man.
"This time, I want to shoot you down like a sieve, and make you watch your friends and family become sieves too. Let you experience the pain of losing loved ones one by one!"
He gritted his teeth.
He waved his hand.
The archers swiftly picked up arrows and placed them on their bows, aiming at Ding Ling and his group.
Seeing this, Ding Ling sensed trouble.
But at that moment, he guessed who the intruder was.
Qu Feiyan, clever and sharp, thought of it too, shouting:
"You’re Zuo Lengchan!"
"Indeed."
The man’s mouth curled slightly:

"I am none other than Zuo Lengchan, the Sect Leader of the Mount Songh Sect. Ding Ling, today let me grant you a clear death. You killed my junior brothers. This blood feud is imprinted in my heart, one I dare not forget for a moment. By the grace of heaven, I’ve finally caught you today. Hahaha... Seems like heaven favors me as well."
He stepped back two steps.
Glaring coldly at Ding Ling:
"First kill Ding Ling’s friends and family, let him taste the pain."
"Fire!"
He waved his hand.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
The archers released their bowstrings.
In the next moment.
Arrows rained down like a waterfall towards Qu Feiyan, Consort Yhu, Lin Pingzhi and others.
Qu Feiyan and the others looked pale, wanting to move but realized they were weak and limp, unable to move a single finger.
Each felt either desperate or unwilling...
Qu Feiyan’s bright eyes only gazed at Ding Ling, thinking:
"Is this life coming to an end? I wonder if in the next life, I can meet Brother Ding again."

sentences.text: Ding Ling followed the servant into the restaurant.
Qu Feiyan and the others followed closely behind.
Inside the restaurant, people came and went, amidst shouts, the waiter, sweating profusely, carried dishes around quickly from place to place.
Clearly.
The business here was flourishing.
The servant led Ding Ling’s group to a private room on the second floor.
On the first floor, many guests frequently glanced at Ding Ling’s group, pointing and whispering, without knowing what they were saying.
Ding Ling’s ears moved slightly.
He heard them talking about Consort Yhu, and himself.
He couldn’t help but be aware.
Talking about Consort Yhu, naturally because of her beauty, unrivaled in the world.
Talking about himself, naturally due to his recent fame, which some people have noted, comparing his appearance and stature with the rumored ’Ding Ling’.
Some people, after comparing, seem to be sure that Ding Ling is indeed the world’s number one Ding Ling, and couldn’t help but exclaim.
"Unexpected that the name of the world’s number one has already reached Luoyang."
Ding Ling reflected, pondering:
"Even some natives of Luoyang seem to know me.
Ren Woxing’s ability to stir trouble is really significant.
Or maybe, Ren Yingying is a master strategist, comparable to Zhuge Liang among women?"
Whatever the truth is.
Perhaps once meeting Ren Yingying, everything will become clear.
But despite reaching Luoyang.
Ren Yingying still hasn’t appeared?
Ding Ling was puzzled.
But he didn’t pursue it further.
Whether she appears or not hardly affects his determination to go to Huashan to learn the Dugu Nine Swords.
Inner strength is important.
But martial skill is equally vital!
As the pinnacle sword technique in martial arts, Ding Ling could not miss witnessing the Dugu Nine Swords.
Coming to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World and not learning the Dugu Nine Swords, where would he learn it?
Ding Ling didn’t want to miss the opportunity.
Clip-clop!
Just as Ding Ling’s group settled in the private room.
The waiter quickly brought platters of delicacies.
Chicken, duck, fish, seafood, deer antler, bird’s nest—and everything one could wish for.
Truly a sumptuous feast.
As Ding Ling signaled that they could start eating, Huang Zhonggong laughed heartily, saying:
"Traveling with Ding Ling all the way, I’ve been truly fortunate to enjoy delicious meals.
I seem to have gained quite a bit of weight over this period."
"Indeed."
Dan Qingsheng stretched out his chopsticks, picked up a chicken leg, and was about to put it in his mouth when Ding Ling suddenly said:
’Wait!’
"What?
The chicken leg was almost at his lips.
As Ding Ling spoke, Dan Qingsheng restrained his saliva, pulled the chicken leg back from his mouth, and looked at Ding Ling with confusion:
"What’s the matter?"
"Hmm."
Ding Ling’s eyes scanned the table full of dishes; under his Innate Expert gaze, every dish seemed to emit a faint glow.
This is the glow of poison.
With the True Water in Ding Ling’s Dantian nearing six drops!
Under the operation of Pure Yang True Skill, Medicine King Breathing Technique, Qingnang Scripture, Inner Scripture, and others, everything was utterly clear in his eyes.
"Poison!"
Ding Ling uttered two words.
Everyone’s expressions changed drastically and they stood up abruptly, instinctively clutching the weapons at their waists.
"Hahaha..."
A wild laugh erupted from outside the private room:
"You truly deserve the name of the world’s number one Ding Ling!
Exceptional eyesight.
Too bad, too bad, no matter how strong you are, now you can only drink my footwashing water and fall!"
With those words.
It seemed to trigger a chain reaction.
Plunk!
Plunk!
Consort Yhu, Qu Feiyan, Huang Zhonggong, Lin Pingzhi, and others unexpectedly fell to the ground one after another, looking pale at Ding Ling.
Qu Feiyan even opened her mouth to say:
"Brother Ding, there’s poison in the air.
Run quickly, don’t mind us!"
"Hehe.
Want to run?
It’s too late!"
Crackling!
Thunderous sounds sliced through the air, and subsequently, the private room where Ding Ling was located was locked by iron bars descending from the sky.
In an instant.
The private room turned into a cage.
And at that moment.
A figure appeared outside the door, revealing a person who was tall, over eight feet, composed in demeanor, with an overbearing aura, a middle-aged man.
His aura was flamboyant and unrestrained, resembling a whirlwind sweeping through.
He coldly stared at Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling.
Finally seeing you!
You truly kept me waiting!"
Ding Ling sneered at the man, coldly:
"Who do you think you are?"
Ding Ling hadn’t imagined that even though he was so cautious, he still fell into a trap.
It can only be said.
The power of habit is terrifying.
From south to north, he was always praised and flattered, becoming accustomed and numb to it.

Coming to Luoyang, gifted with the Five Immortals Rejuvenating Wine by Blue Phoenix, and then entering Luoyang City, being told by the servant that someone invited him and specifically waited, seemed natural and normal.
Now upon reflection.
Once such a habitual thought process is established, it becomes overwhelming.
The person scheming in the shadows.
Probably seized this habitual thought process to give Ding Ling a severe blow.
Thus, it is evident.
The one scheming and poisoning must be a venomous snake or wolf, who wouldn’t act unless certain, and once they do, it must be with a deadly plan!

chapters.title: Chapter 344: Ding Ling vs. Zuo Lengchan
paragraphs: Qu Feiyan’s eyes were misty with thoughts drifting far away.
The only two people she cared about in this life, besides her grandfather, were her Brother Ding.
Grandfather was gone.

She was very reluctant to part with her Brother Ding. She was even less willing to see Brother Ding walk ahead of her. If she could block arrows for Brother Ding, she would rush over without hesitation, but unfortunately.
She couldn’t even move now.
"This multitude of arrows piercing my heart might lead to an ugly death; I just hope Brother Ding doesn’t see it."
Thinking about the sorrow and embarrassment, tears hung at the corner of her eyes unwillingly.
Almost at the same time.
Just as the rain of arrows was about to obliterate Qu Feiyan and the others, Ding Ling moved.
Boom!
It seemed as if muffled thunder exploded across the sky, and within moments, Ding Ling stood in front of Qu Feiyan’s group as if he’d instantly teleported there.
His hand moved like lightning.
Profound Celestial Finger!
One finger after another struck out like a sudden clap of thunder, and the dazzling cold light flashed, causing the arrows to freeze in mid-air and turn to frost!
In Zuo Lengchan’s astonished expression.
Clang!
The Giant Que Sword unsheathed.
Overlord Saber Technique!
Using the great sword as a saber, one strike revealed resplendent blade light, stunning the world!
Even though it was a sword, it exhibited the weight, dominance, and fierceness of a grand saber!
Crackling!
The saber light shot through, traversing the void!
The frozen arrows in the air were pierced, shattered, and exploded in an instant, then fell in pieces all around.
"How can this be?!"
Zuo Lengchan gasped, pointing at Ding Ling:
"You, you’re not poisoned!"
"Heh heh."
Ding Ling sneered, his aura radiating outward, conjuring Xun Wind from thin air!
With a swish, his clothes flapped loudly in the fierce wind!
He stood there with the sword, like an awe-inspiring Grandmaster, bearing the demeanor of a Sword God descending to earth!
"Boom!"
The Giant Que Sword seemed fully activated, continuously humbling with a resonant sound!
As Ding Ling raised the Giant Que Sword, waves of Primordial Qi storm gathered towards the sword’s edge, seemingly ready to explode at any moment.
The towering energy entity, bright, majestic, and grand, carried an eerie sense capable of reaping the undead souls of all things in the world!
Zuo Lengchan watched in horror, unable to suppress a roar:
"Release the arrows!"
"Shoot him to death for me!
His elite Mount Songh Sect disciples were also shocked, and upon hearing the command, dared not delay any further.
In unison, they furiously shot at Ding Ling’s vital points.
For a moment, the sound of bowstrings echoed continuously; the whistling of arrows disrupted the universe!
Looking out.
The arrows appeared like torrents from nine heavens, akin to a meteor shower streaking across the sky!
Every arrow, sharp and dazzling to the extreme.
Clearly, the elite of the Mount Songh Sect had exerted their full strength at this moment, with the Inner Qi contained within the arrows reaching peak levels.
Boom!
At this moment, Ding Ling also slashed out with the Giant Que Sword in hand!
With a single slash, it was as if the sun descended upon the world, with sword light piercing and glaring everywhere in sight! Boom boom boom!
The sword light exploded all the way forward, resembling a torpedo breaking through the air, a missile soaring into the sky!
Every explosive impact was unstoppable!
Any arrow encountered was disintegrated instantaneously, like snow meeting the scorching sun, melting and breaking apart! Leaving destruction in its wake, unmatched, boom!
A loud crash.
The Sword Qi struck the iron fence in front, and amidst the rumbling sound, it directly cleaved a massive breach into it!

Ding Ling’s Breathing Technique operated swiftly, merging Vigorous Qi with True Qi, with what seemed like a propulsion device beneath his feet exploding, boom! With a light tap of his toes, Ding Ling was propelled forward by a tremendous force at lightning speed!
In just the blink of an eye, he charged to the archers’ front.
Then.
In the archers’ horrified expressions.
Ding Ling swung his sword!
Sword God Skill!
Pine Wind Swordsmanship!
Moon Shadow Swordsmanship!
Mount Songh Swordsmanship!
Hundred Transformations and Thousand Illusions Hengshan Cloud Mist Thirteen Techniques!
One-Character Electric Sword Technique!

One exquisite sword move after another unfolded in Ding Ling’s hands, turning the Giant Que Sword into lightning crossing the sky, sometimes firm as pine, swift as wind, sometimes with the sword edge sketching a crescent moon, and sometimes sword flowers blooming at the sword tip, each Flowers in Bloom pattern flashed briefly in the void.
Thud thud!
Clang clang clang!
In the crisp sound, lines of blood spurted out, and heads flew into the sky, one by one!
In just the blink of an eye!
Dozens of elite archers were swept away by a terrifying wave of Sword Qi!
The ground was awash with blood!
Severed limbs scattered all around!
These events seem lengthy to recount.
But from the time Ding Ling cleaved open the iron fence, charged through the breach, and annihilated the archers.
It all happened within two breaths of time.
Two breaths.
The time was so short that Zuo Lengchan hadn’t fully reacted before the battle ended.
Clang clang clang!
Ding Ling spun the sword edge, naturally and seamlessly slicing towards Zuo Lengchan’s head after eliminating the archers!
"Ah!"
Zuo Lengchan yelled, a mix of shock and anger on his face, unable to believe it. His feet moved quickly as he roared out, retreating over thirty meters like the wind, boom!
Ding Ling’s sword slashed at his former standing position, cleaving through the floor, furniture, and all obstructions in its path.
Wherever the Giant Que Sword pointed!
Everything seemed to be annihilated!
Zuo Lengchan watched in horror, his heart pounding heavily!
He realized he had severely underestimated Ding Ling’s strength, which was at least ten times more terrifying than anticipated!
How could this be possible?!
How long had it been?!
How could Ding Ling have improved so much?!
Cleaving through even the heavy iron fence, was this something humans could accomplish?!
He saw Ding Ling’s sword edge spinning and his feet lightly tapping, instantly seeming to teleport before him like a specter. Zuo Lengchan had no time to dodge and hurriedly swung his sword to block!
Seventeen Paths of Mount Song Swordsmanship!

His sword technique was high and profound, with the Mount Songh Swordsmanship unfolding, appearing mighty and majestic, resembling an army charging, like the rolling Yangtze River flowing eastward, unstoppable in its path.
But such swordsmanship.
Facing the slashing Giant Que Sword from Ding Ling, seemed to shatter in an instant.
Boom!
With just one strike!

Zuo Lengchan felt a vast, ocean-like force transmitted from the sword edge, causing his tiger’s mouth to crack instantly. With a muffled groan, the Treasure Sword in his hand slipped and fell to the ground with a thud!
Thud!
The Giant Que Sword slashed down.
Directly aimed at the center of Zuo Lengchan’s forehead!
A soul-stirring Sword Qi surged straight into his Sea of Consciousness!
Zuo Lengchan was terrified to death, forced to desperately dodge the vital spot, but with a plop, he couldn’t hold back a scream. Looking again, he saw his left arm completely cleaved off.
"Ding Ling!"
Zuo Lengchan couldn’t hold back any longer, shouting:
"Stop!"
Ding Ling looked coldly at him, as if staring at a dead man, with no intention of stopping, the Giant Que Sword vibrating continuously, turning the sword’s cry into a rolling sound wave.
Zuo Lengchan bore the full brunt, feeling stifled and nauseous, daring not delay for a moment, rolling on the ground in an extremely embarrassed manner, shouting:
"Li Yuanba!"

chapters.title: Chapter 345: Li Yuanba
paragraphs: As the words fell!
Boom!

The door to the next private room suddenly exploded, and two massive hammers, as big as small mountains, burst out from within. They smashed through countless items like a hurricane, then were raised high up, and with a loud shout, were brought crashing down towards Ding Ling’s head!
In that moment.
Like a hare leaping and a hawk diving.
Extreme speed!
Ding Ling’s pupils slightly contracted.
Too late to retreat.
But his hands were quick, and the Giant Que Sword swiftly blocked in front of him, boom!

The giant hammer smashed heavily against the blade of the Giant Que Sword, sending Ding Ling reeling back as if struck by lightning. He staggered a few steps back, each step leaving a deep footprint in the floorboards.
A few steps later.
Ding Ling crashed through the door of a private room behind him.
Only then did he manage to stand firm.
"Oh!"
A surprised sound suddenly rang out.
Ding Ling looked in the direction of the voice and saw a person standing behind the giant hammer.
This person was no more than six feet tall, with a sharp mouth and cheeks like a monkey, pale as a ghost, bone-thin, without an ounce of flesh!
Cloaked in a layer of precious armor, he wore a Hair-Binding Black Gold Crown with two short pheasant feathers swaying to and fro, making him look slightly comical, much like a circus monkey.
Yet, he brandished two giant hammers, many times larger than his own frame!
This contrast delivered a striking visual impact.
Anyone who saw it couldn’t help but be moved.
Ding Ling was no exception; it was his first time seeing such an abnormal person, recalling Zuo Lengchan’s words, he composed himself:
"Li Yuanba?!"
"It’s your grandpa, me."
Li Yuanba grinned, revealing a mouth of large yellow teeth, making him seem even more comical and ugly:
"I heard Brother Zuo say you’re the World’s Number One. I’m not convinced. Now I see, you’re nothing special."
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow.
Li Yuanba actually ascended as well.

It seems that during the late Sui Dynasty, quite a few people must have climbed the Celestial Ladder too. Apart from Li Yuanba, it’s hard to say how many other ascenders from other worlds have arrived in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.
What surprised Ding Ling the most was that the Mount Songh Sect had encountered ascenders like Consort Yhu and Li Yuanba consecutively!
Why do they have such great fortune?
Or is it simply sheer coincidence, and they’ve just managed to seize these opportunities for their benefit?
It’s just that Consort Yhu fled quickly. But Li Yuanba was detained by them.
From the skirmish just now.
Li Yuanba’s hammer was tremendously powerful, certainly exceeding three thousand pounds, most likely reaching the world’s maximum strength of four thousand pounds.
Ding Ling was astonished; he had cheating abilities to reach the world’s maximum strength.
How could Li Yuanba?!
Ding Ling, having ascended from the Historical Plane, naturally knew where the strength limit of the Historical Plane lay.
No matter how extraordinary, Li Yuanba couldn’t break the limit values in the Historical Plane.
The likelihood is that he came to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World and then advanced rapidly.
But so quickly reaching the maximum strength value of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, his talent is undoubtedly astonishing!
"Yuan Ba."
Zuo Lengchan struggled to get up and walked behind Li Yuanba, cast a vicious glare at Ding Ling:
"Kill him! I want him dead!"
"Oh."
Li Yuanba dumbly responded, then lifted his giant hammer, looked at Ding Ling, and chuckled:
"Brother Zuo wants you dead, so I can only beat you to death."
"Brother Ding."
Qu Feiyan and the others looked worriedly, and Qu Feiyan said:
"If you can’t defeat him, don’t worry about us."
It was Qu Feiyan’s first time seeing someone force Ding Ling back!
Her heart couldn’t help but leap to her throat.
From the recent surprise to now becoming anxious.
Ding Ling wasn’t poisoned, and in a flash, he broke free from captivity, swept through the archers, severely injured Zuo Lengchan!
This left Consort Yhu, Lin Pingzhi, Huang Zhonggong, Qu Feiyan and their group both shocked and pleasantly surprised!
They didn’t know why Ding Ling wasn’t poisoned, but to them, it was nothing short of a tremendous morale boost.
Just when it seemed Zuo Lengchan was about to be killed, the tide turned.
From out of nowhere, Li Yuanba appeared, clutching at their hearts involuntarily.
Huang Zhonggong and the others thought:

"The world is truly chaotic! The ascent of Consort Yhu from the late Qin Dynasty was one thing. But now another ascender, Li Yuanba, from the late Sui Dynasty! It seems this Jianghu will inevitably become more tumultuous and chaotic in the future!"
"None of you will escape."
Zuo Lengchan’s expression was somewhat fierce:
"You all must die."
At this moment.
The battle on the second floor had already alarmed many guests on the first floor.
However, a row of people in brown clothing stood at the staircase to the second floor; they were the elite of the Mount Songh Sect, driving some people away from the tavern.
Even so.
After these people left.
Most still watched outside the tavern, not straying far.

They didn’t dare go upstairs, for the commotion upstairs was earthshaking, obviously not caused by ordinary people. Driven by curiosity and unwisely seeking a closer look might cost them their lives; where would they seek redress then?
Even from a distance, hearing the constant explosions from the second floor, they couldn’t help but look at each other in astonishment:
"What’s happening on the second floor? Is it Ding Ling? Who is he battling?!"
Some players commented:
"Ding Ling is truly formidable. Ever since he came to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, it’s been nothing but bloodshed and sweeping victories. He’s truly made us players proud!"
"With Ding Ling here, we as players have a place and some voice; otherwise, we might not even qualify to stand here and watch."
The players began discussing heatedly.
Some natives joined in the conversation.
Due to the crowd.
The Mount Songh Sect couldn’t possibly keep all the first-floor guests, only drive them away.
Zuo Lengchan’s goal was to kill Ding Ling and Qu Feiyan and others.
Kill them and leave immediately.
In his method.
It would be perfect.
No loopholes.
Kill and leave.
Silent as whispers.
Unseen, unnoticed.
Who would have thought.

Ding Ling not only avoided poisoning, but his combat strength far exceeded Zuo’s expectations, annihilating the elite archers he brought and himself severely wounded, greatly diminishing his combat capacity, making a confrontation with Ding Ling nearly impossible.
He had to pin his hopes on the peculiar strength of Li Yuanba.
To gain Li Yuanba’s trust.

Zuo Lengchan exhausted every trick, finally earning the iron-willed Li Yuanba’s recognition, making him acknowledge him as a big brother. With Li Yuanba in hand, Zuo Lengchan’s confidence soared, for he found Li Yuanba to truly be an exceedingly rare genius.
Not only possessing formidable physical prowess.
When cultivating Inner Strength, he advanced at lightning speed, practically unhindered.
Zuo Lengchan was overjoyed, considering Li Yuanba as his trump card.
But what he didn’t expect was.
That this trump card would be forced to reveal so soon against Ding Ling.

sentences.text: As the words fell!
Boom!
The door to the next private room suddenly exploded, and two massive hammers, as big as small mountains, burst out from within.
They smashed through countless items like a hurricane, then were raised high up, and with a loud shout, were brought crashing down towards Ding Ling’s head!
In that moment.
Like a hare leaping and a hawk diving.
Extreme speed!
Ding Ling’s pupils slightly contracted.
Too late to retreat.
But his hands were quick, and the Giant Que Sword swiftly blocked in front of him, boom!
The giant hammer smashed heavily against the blade of the Giant Que Sword, sending Ding Ling reeling back as if struck by lightning.
He staggered a few steps back, each step leaving a deep footprint in the floorboards.
A few steps later.
Ding Ling crashed through the door of a private room behind him.
Only then did he manage to stand firm.
"Oh!"
A surprised sound suddenly rang out.
Ding Ling looked in the direction of the voice and saw a person standing behind the giant hammer.
This person was no more than six feet tall, with a sharp mouth and cheeks like a monkey, pale as a ghost, bone-thin, without an ounce of flesh!
Cloaked in a layer of precious armor, he wore a Hair-Binding Black Gold Crown with two short pheasant feathers swaying to and fro, making him look slightly comical, much like a circus monkey.
Yet, he brandished two giant hammers, many times larger than his own frame!
This contrast delivered a striking visual impact.
Anyone who saw it couldn’t help but be moved.
Ding Ling was no exception; it was his first time seeing such an abnormal person, recalling Zuo Lengchan’s words, he composed himself:
"Li Yuanba?!"
"It’s your grandpa, me."
Li Yuanba grinned, revealing a mouth of large yellow teeth, making him seem even more comical and ugly:
"I heard Brother Zuo say you’re the World’s Number One.
I’m not convinced.
Now I see, you’re nothing special."
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow.
Li Yuanba actually ascended as well.
It seems that during the late Sui Dynasty, quite a few people must have climbed the Celestial Ladder too.
Apart from Li Yuanba, it’s hard to say how many other ascenders from other worlds have arrived in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.
What surprised Ding Ling the most was that the Mount Songh Sect had encountered ascenders like Consort Yhu and Li Yuanba consecutively!
Why do they have such great fortune?
Or is it simply sheer coincidence, and they’ve just managed to seize these opportunities for their benefit?
It’s just that Consort Yhu fled quickly.
But Li Yuanba was detained by them.
From the skirmish just now.
Li Yuanba’s hammer was tremendously powerful, certainly exceeding three thousand pounds, most likely reaching the world’s maximum strength of four thousand pounds.
Ding Ling was astonished; he had cheating abilities to reach the world’s maximum strength.
How could Li Yuanba?!
Ding Ling, having ascended from the Historical Plane, naturally knew where the strength limit of the Historical Plane lay.
No matter how extraordinary, Li Yuanba couldn’t break the limit values in the Historical Plane.
The likelihood is that he came to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World and then advanced rapidly.
But so quickly reaching the maximum strength value of The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, his talent is undoubtedly astonishing!
"Yuan Ba."
Zuo Lengchan struggled to get up and walked behind Li Yuanba, cast a vicious glare at Ding Ling:
"Kill him!
I want him dead!"
"Oh."
Li Yuanba dumbly responded, then lifted his giant hammer, looked at Ding Ling, and chuckled:
"Brother Zuo wants you dead, so I can only beat you to death."
"Brother Ding."
Qu Feiyan and the others looked worriedly, and Qu Feiyan said:
"If you can’t defeat him, don’t worry about us."
It was Qu Feiyan’s first time seeing someone force Ding Ling back!
Her heart couldn’t help but leap to her throat.
From the recent surprise to now becoming anxious.
Ding Ling wasn’t poisoned, and in a flash, he broke free from captivity, swept through the archers, severely injured Zuo Lengchan!
This left Consort Yhu, Lin Pingzhi, Huang Zhonggong, Qu Feiyan and their group both shocked and pleasantly surprised!
They didn’t know why Ding Ling wasn’t poisoned, but to them, it was nothing short of a tremendous morale boost.
Just when it seemed Zuo Lengchan was about to be killed, the tide turned.
From out of nowhere, Li Yuanba appeared, clutching at their hearts involuntarily.
Huang Zhonggong and the others thought:
"The world is truly chaotic!
The ascent of Consort Yhu from the late Qin Dynasty was one thing.
But now another ascender, Li Yuanba, from the late Sui Dynasty!
It seems this Jianghu will inevitably become more tumultuous and chaotic in the future!"
"None of you will escape."
Zuo Lengchan’s expression was somewhat fierce:
"You all must die."
At this moment.
The battle on the second floor had already alarmed many guests on the first floor.

Even so.
