chapters.title: Chapter 346: Ding Ling VS Li Yuanba
paragraphs: At the signal from Zuo Lengchan.
Li Yuanba chuckled foolishly twice, then suddenly revealed a bloodthirsty grin. He let out a long howl, screamed twice, stomped the ground, and leaped high into the air, wielding two massive hammers.
He was airborne.
The two massive hammers, carrying a seemingly overwhelming momentum that could crush everything, thundered down towards Ding Ling’s head.
Ding Ling’s heart was filled with dread.
He activated the Human Emperor Swordsmanship!
Sword God Skill!
Defend himself!
In an instant, it was like a flourishing of flowers, with dense sword shadows tightly protecting Ding Ling, making it impenetrable by water or needles.
Boom boom boom!
Li Yuanba’s hammers came crashing down, the two hammers pounded heavily on the sword shadows like smashing iron, producing non-stop clanging sounds.
"Die die die!"
Li Yuanba looked frenzied, as if he possessed endless strength within his body, continuously swinging the massive hammers heavily at Ding Ling.
The pounding sound was earth-shattering, within ten miles, everyone could hear it clearly, attracting even more people outside the inn.
Huang Zhonggong and the others watched in shock, their eyes twitching wildly.
They had a premonition; being hit even once by Li Yuanba’s hammer would likely result in severe injury, and if hit twice, they might have to meet King Yama!
Too wild!
Too terrifying.
The hammers, like small mountains, kept hammering down, eventually even creating illusions!
Showing that the speed of swinging the hammer must be at its peak.
"Die die die!"
"Why aren’t you dead yet!"

Li Yuanba shouted madly, his eyes gradually turning completely red, and the speed of his hammers became faster and faster, to the point where it was impossible to distinguish where the hammers were, only a faint shadow could be seen!
This speed was as fast as a swift wind or lightning.
What kind of person is Ding Ling?
His cultivation was at its peak, with all kinds of divine skills at full level.
At this moment too, he was forced to retreat step by step by Li Yuanba’s hammering, sinking, all within a few blinks of an eye.
The places Ding Ling stepped on became a complete mess!
Each elegant room was shattered.
Wherever Ding Ling and Li Yuanba passed, there was no place left intact.
Zuo Lengchan, fearing being affected, had already moved to the stairway on the first floor to watch the battle.
But even so.
He was watching with a heart full of fear, sucking in cold air:
"This Li Yuanba is even more formidable than I imagined. Fortunately, I wisely won him over. Otherwise..."
If he were to become enemies with Li Yuanba.
The outcome would be unimaginable.

But Ding Ling was able to fight against the likes of Li Yuanba, this rampant and fierce beast, not only not falling into disadvantage, but occasionally counterattacking, driving Li Yuanba even crazier and more ferocious, and in the end, his eyes turned completely red, his hammers getting heavier and faster.
Boom boom boom!
Wherever the hammers passed, everything was easily smashed and collapsed!
The entire second floor was almost about to collapse.
Ding Ling glanced at Qu Feiyan and others not far away, frowned secretly, suddenly gathered energy at his feet, combining Breathing Technique’s vigorous Qi, True Qi, boom!
He moved as fast as a specter, dodging Li Yuanba’s invisible phantom hammer in an instant!
Boom boom boom!
Li Yuanba’s hammers missed Ding Ling’s Giant Que Sword, hitting the second floor’s floor and elegant room, collapsing an exquisite room into ruins.
Not only that.
The second floor’s floor was also smashed into a large hole!
Li Yuanba, failing to stand firm, fell through the hole.
"Aiya!"
He called out, tumbling down onto the ground.
The massive hammers also fell heavily, smashing a section of the first-floor’s tables and chairs.
Li Yuanba got up again as if nothing happened, patting the armor on his body, his eyes seemed clearer from the fall, not as blood-red.
He picked up the two hammers from the ground, about to head back upstairs to resume the battle with Ding Ling, when suddenly he heard Zuo Lengchan’s scream.
He was stunned for a moment, holding the hammers, started running wildly, knocking over who knows how many tables and chairs along the way.
At this moment, he was on the first floor.
There were quite a few curious guests, players on the first floor who hadn’t left, blocking Li Yuanba’s path.
Li Yuanba crashed them away with tables and chairs.
Some unlucky ones hit their faces against the hammers, getting their foreheads smashed on the spot, dying tragically.
Da-da!
As Li Yuanba ran through, trampling and crippling countless people.
Instantly, screams rose one after another, many turned and ran away in panic.
Many deeply understood at this moment what ’avoidable disaster’ and ’curiosity killed the cat’ meant!
However.
So many people died.

Li Yuanba seemed to feel nothing, only looking agitatedly towards the staircase of the second floor, happening to witness Zuo Lengchan being decapitated by Ding Ling with a single sword, with the headless body kicked down the stairs.
He was stunned for a moment, then furiously roared at the sky, lifted his heavy hammers, and charged towards Ding Ling:
"Die die die! Grandpa wants you dead!"
Boom boom boom!

He resembled a tornado sweeping across the ground, or like a thunderbolt crashing down from the heavens, wielding the hammers, sending over a dozen of the Mount Songh Sect elites at the staircase either dead or injured, knocked over in a heap.
"Grandpa, we’re on the same side!"
"Slow down, slow down!"
The Mount Songh Sect elites were shocked and shouted loudly.
To not die at Ding Ling’s hands but instead at this young master’s hand was really too wrong!
But Li Yuanba’s mind was now fully occupied with the thought of slaying Ding Ling, his eyes were completely blood-red as if he lost his mind, caring for nothing else but charging towards Ding Ling.
Seeing this, Ding Ling’s brow furrowed wildly, grabbing a bag from Zuo Lengchan’s chest.
Then he flew upstairs, like a flash of lightning, to Qu Feiyan and the others, opened the bag, quickly identified it, and took out a bottle, smashing it to the ground.
Splat!
The bottle hit the ground, shattering into pieces!
A cool breeze blew past.
The foul-smelling airflow inside the bottle, with a wave of Ding Ling’s hand, all blew towards Qu Feiyan and Consort Yhu, and in just a blink, they seemed to be able to move again.
Ding Ling watched, took a deep breath of relief.
Turning back, seeing Li Yuanba had already made it to the second floor, he casually tossed the bag to Qu Feiyan and said:
"I’ll lead this guy away. You all stay safe."
Saying this.
Ding Ling flashed to a window on the second floor, looked at Li Yuanba, and called out:
"Li Yuanba. Here."
"Ah!"
Li Yuanba indeed obeyed, wielding his hammers and charging at him:
"Die die die! Come die for grandpa!"
Boom boom boom!
He was like a rampaging wild dragon on the plains, breaking countless floorboards along the way, and with Ding Ling, crashing through the second-floor window, leaped onto the long street.
The street Ding Ling chose had quite a few Mount Songh Sect members.
Ding Ling targeted these people.
After jumping out the window, he used the Ascending Skill, Cloud-Piercing Step, with the Innate Level’s True Water circulating in his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 347: Innate Talent Player
paragraphs: Ding Ling was like a Peng Spreading Its Wings, riding the wind and controlling it from the void. In mid-air, the Giant Que Sword slightly trembled, and the Seven Extremes Swordsmanship unfolded, transforming waves of sound into shockwaves that surged towards the crowd from the Mount Songh Sect.
"Ah!"
The elite of the Mount Songh Sect, under Zuo Lengchan’s orders, once again encircled Ding Ling’s group to prevent anyone from escaping, and to eliminate Ding Ling and his companions completely.
But upon hearing the commotion from the tavern, they had a bad feeling.
At this moment, seeing Ding Ling break through the window, soaring through the air, some clever individuals instinctively turned to flee.

Yet who could have anticipated that Ding Ling’s Sword Technique would suddenly produce an invisible airwave amidst the clanging sounds, instantly enveloping them all, making each feel a splitting headache, nauseous, and feel compelled to either hold their head and groan or roll on the ground screaming.

Ding Ling seized the opportunity to fly above them, activating Flying Swallow Technique, Cloud-Piercing Step, Ascending Skill, and Five Animals Qigong, swiftly and lightly stepping over their heads, floating far away like a gentle breeze.
Li Yuanba smashed through the window but did not possess Ding Ling’s superior Lightweight Skill. Instead, he landed on the ground like a mountain, stamping a three-inch deep pit into the earth!
Li Yuanba’s eyes were bloodshot as he fixated on Ding Ling, seeing no one else but him.
Holding his giant hammer high, he charged recklessly, instantly crashing into and crushing countless Mount Songh Sect members.
The spectators paled, anxious and fearful.
In the grand city of Luoyang! In broad daylight, such a horrific event occurred!
Suddenly.
Cries of alarm and shouts of fear echoed everywhere.
Everyone fled from Li Yuanba.
Ding Ling took note of this.
So he chose the plaza at the end of the street to duel Li Yuanba.
Inside the tavern is not suitable for a duel.
Destroying the tavern could bury Qu Feiyan and others alive, injuring them for certain, which Ding Ling wanted to avoid.
As for the casualties among the crowd, they were inevitable.
Only fighting Li Yuanba in the open area could minimize harm to the innocent.
Ding Ling landed on the plaza like the wind, with eyes like lightning scanning all directions, seeing some people still lingering there, he cleared his throat and shouted:
"Quickly leave the area, to avoid being affected!"
His voice was exceptionally clear.
Audible miles away.
Such profound Inner Strength.
Made some concealed experts in the crowd change their expressions dramatically, pondering:
"The depth of Ding Ling’s skills is truly unbelievable. But this strong man can’t subdue Li Yuanba for the moment.
Just who is Li Yuanba?
Where did he come from?"
Aside from the players.
The local Natives did not associate Li Yuanba with the fierce warrior from the late Sui Dynasty known for wielding Drumming Golden Hammer.
Instead, each was incredibly baffled, feeling that there are more and more nameless experts emerging recently in the Jianghu.
Especially Ding Ling.
He was among the best, rumored to have the World’s Number One title.
Many were unconvinced.
Until today, witnessing Ding Ling’s battle with Li Yuanba, they suddenly realized they had underestimated Ding Ling’s abilities.
Whiz! Whiz!
Many people on the plaza quickly left.
Li Yuanba charged recklessly like an enraged tiger or ferocious lion, leaving a bloody trail wherever he went.
The remaining elite from the Mount Songh Sect.
Were trampled, crushed, and smashed by him, countless of them.
The surviving Mount Songh Sect elite glared at Li Yuanba, wishing to eat him alive!
Each one was gnashing their teeth in hatred, their animosity for Li Yuanba had completely overshadowed their hatred for Ding Ling!
Li Yuanba seemed oblivious.
Or rather.
Even if he noticed, he wouldn’t care, annoying him might just lead to a swing of his hammer, and then the world quiets!
He could then do whatever he wanted.
He was fiercely dominant and exceedingly brutal.
Unlike any mortal!
A jump spanned seven or eight meters, without any Lightweight Skill, yet he carried two giant hammers with speed surpassing galloping horses, his agility was evident.
Moreover, fighting till now.
Li Yuanba grew braver as the battle went on, showing no sign of fatigue, his physical quality and stamina were unrivaled in the world!
Furthermore, his strength has reached the world’s limit.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but glance sideways, deeply moved, thinking:

"Li Yuanba is truly a typical talent-type strong man. Arriving in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World for just a few months at most, yet his physical condition evolved so easily to the peak of the world!
His Inner Strength even reached the pinnacle of second-rate!
Given time.
Li Yuanba will easily break the void and ascend away!"
Not only that.
Ding Ling also noticed that once Li Yuanba went berserk, losing all reason, his power increase seemed to make even the void tremble, evidently.
Under violent amplification, Li Yuanba could break the world’s limit anytime, were it not for shackles and world constraints, his power would surely surpass this level.
Such a person with boundless potential, regards Zuo Lengchan as a brother, determined to kill him.
Ding Ling’s killing intent surged, his eyes grew deeper and darker, and his gaze towards Li Yuanba cooled.
"There’s no need for such a talent to be left."
"Failing to kill him today, he will surely kill me someday."
"Despite my admiration and envy for Li Yuanba’s talent and potential."
"But the enemy is the enemy. To be merciful to the enemy is a form of cruelty to oneself!"
Ding Ling’s heart instantly steadied.
The Giant Que Sword in his hand slightly trembled, the Sword Qi of the Seven Extremes Swordsmanship surged on the blade, transformed into waves of sound, rushing towards Li Yuanba’s location.

However, Li Yuanba seemed oblivious, still blood-red eyed, roaring ’Kill Kill Kill’, gaining speed instead of slowing, seemingly triggered the fusion of Inner Strength and Breathing Technique Vigorous Qi, his speed exploded, crossing dozens of meters in an instant, landing heavily on the ground, stamping out a three-inch deep pit!
"Roar!"
Li Yuanba roared to the sky, swinging his giant hammer, heavily hurling it towards Ding Ling’s location.

Ding Ling continuously operated Flying Swallow Technique, Ascending Skill, Cloud-Piercing Step, and various Lightweight Skills, coupled with the fusion of Breathing Technique Vigorous Qi and True Qi, enabling him to erupt and roam anywhere at any time.
Thus, with this smash.
He easily avoided it.
"Kill Kill Kill!"
Li Yuanba saw Ding Ling evading rather than blocking, growing more furious, his eyebrows stood up like blades, swinging the giant hammer, chasing after Ding Ling relentlessly.
Ding Ling utilized Lightweight Skill, maneuvering around Li Yuanba.
His sword occasionally unleashed bursts of Sword Qi, shooting onto Li Yuanba’s body.
Clang! Clang! Clang!
The two fought rapidly.
One with an unrivaled giant hammer, its speed exploding, hammer shadows countless, seemingly able to smash the Celestial Palace;

sentences.text: Ding Ling was like a Peng Spreading Its Wings, riding the wind and controlling it from the void.
In mid-air, the Giant Que Sword slightly trembled, and the Seven Extremes Swordsmanship unfolded, transforming waves of sound into shockwaves that surged towards the crowd from the Mount Songh Sect.
"Ah!"
The elite of the Mount Songh Sect, under Zuo Lengchan’s orders, once again encircled Ding Ling’s group to prevent anyone from escaping, and to eliminate Ding Ling and his companions completely.
But upon hearing the commotion from the tavern, they had a bad feeling.
At this moment, seeing Ding Ling break through the window, soaring through the air, some clever individuals instinctively turned to flee.

Yet who could have anticipated that Ding Ling’s Sword Technique would suddenly produce an invisible airwave amidst the clanging sounds, instantly enveloping them all, making each feel a splitting headache, nauseous, and feel compelled to either hold their head and groan or roll on the ground screaming.

Ding Ling seized the opportunity to fly above them, activating Flying Swallow Technique, Cloud-Piercing Step, Ascending Skill, and Five Animals Qigong, swiftly and lightly stepping over their heads, floating far away like a gentle breeze.
Li Yuanba smashed through the window but did not possess Ding Ling’s superior Lightweight Skill.
Instead, he landed on the ground like a mountain, stamping a three-inch deep pit into the earth!
Li Yuanba’s eyes were bloodshot as he fixated on Ding Ling, seeing no one else but him.
Holding his giant hammer high, he charged recklessly, instantly crashing into and crushing countless Mount Songh Sect members.
The spectators paled, anxious and fearful.
In the grand city of Luoyang!
In broad daylight, such a horrific event occurred!
Suddenly.
Cries of alarm and shouts of fear echoed everywhere.
Everyone fled from Li Yuanba.
Ding Ling took note of this.
So he chose the plaza at the end of the street to duel Li Yuanba.
Inside the tavern is not suitable for a duel.
Destroying the tavern could bury Qu Feiyan and others alive, injuring them for certain, which Ding Ling wanted to avoid.
As for the casualties among the crowd, they were inevitable.
Only fighting Li Yuanba in the open area could minimize harm to the innocent.
Ding Ling landed on the plaza like the wind, with eyes like lightning scanning all directions, seeing some people still lingering there, he cleared his throat and shouted:
"Quickly leave the area, to avoid being affected!"
His voice was exceptionally clear.
Audible miles away.
Such profound Inner Strength.
Made some concealed experts in the crowd change their expressions dramatically, pondering:
"The depth of Ding Ling’s skills is truly unbelievable.
But this strong man can’t subdue Li Yuanba for the moment.
Just who is Li Yuanba?
Where did he come from?"
Aside from the players.
The local Natives did not associate Li Yuanba with the fierce warrior from the late Sui Dynasty known for wielding Drumming Golden Hammer.
Instead, each was incredibly baffled, feeling that there are more and more nameless experts emerging recently in the Jianghu.
Especially Ding Ling.
He was among the best, rumored to have the World’s Number One title.
Many were unconvinced.
Until today, witnessing Ding Ling’s battle with Li Yuanba, they suddenly realized they had underestimated Ding Ling’s abilities.
Whiz!
Whiz!
Many people on the plaza quickly left.
Li Yuanba charged recklessly like an enraged tiger or ferocious lion, leaving a bloody trail wherever he went.
The remaining elite from the Mount Songh Sect.
Were trampled, crushed, and smashed by him, countless of them.
The surviving Mount Songh Sect elite glared at Li Yuanba, wishing to eat him alive!
Each one was gnashing their teeth in hatred, their animosity for Li Yuanba had completely overshadowed their hatred for Ding Ling!
Li Yuanba seemed oblivious.
Or rather.
Even if he noticed, he wouldn’t care, annoying him might just lead to a swing of his hammer, and then the world quiets!
He could then do whatever he wanted.
He was fiercely dominant and exceedingly brutal.
Unlike any mortal!
A jump spanned seven or eight meters, without any Lightweight Skill, yet he carried two giant hammers with speed surpassing galloping horses, his agility was evident.
Moreover, fighting till now.
Li Yuanba grew braver as the battle went on, showing no sign of fatigue, his physical quality and stamina were unrivaled in the world!
Furthermore, his strength has reached the world’s limit.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but glance sideways, deeply moved, thinking:
"Li Yuanba is truly a typical talent-type strong man.
Arriving in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World for just a few months at most, yet his physical condition evolved so easily to the peak of the world!
His Inner Strength even reached the pinnacle of second-rate!
Given time.
Li Yuanba will easily break the void and ascend away!"
Not only that.
Ding Ling also noticed that once Li Yuanba went berserk, losing all reason, his power increase seemed to make even the void tremble, evidently.
Under violent amplification, Li Yuanba could break the world’s limit anytime, were it not for shackles and world constraints, his power would surely surpass this level.
Such a person with boundless potential, regards Zuo Lengchan as a brother, determined to kill him.
Ding Ling’s killing intent surged, his eyes grew deeper and darker, and his gaze towards Li Yuanba cooled.
"There’s no need for such a talent to be left."
"Failing to kill him today, he will surely kill me someday."
"Despite my admiration and envy for Li Yuanba’s talent and potential."
"But the enemy is the enemy.
To be merciful to the enemy is a form of cruelty to oneself!"
Ding Ling’s heart instantly steadied.
The Giant Que Sword in his hand slightly trembled, the Sword Qi of the Seven Extremes Swordsmanship surged on the blade, transformed into waves of sound, rushing towards Li Yuanba’s location.

However, Li Yuanba seemed oblivious, still blood-red eyed, roaring ’Kill Kill Kill’, gaining speed instead of slowing, seemingly triggered the fusion of Inner Strength and Breathing Technique Vigorous Qi, his speed exploded, crossing dozens of meters in an instant, landing heavily on the ground, stamping out a three-inch deep pit!
"Roar!"
Li Yuanba roared to the sky, swinging his giant hammer, heavily hurling it towards Ding Ling’s location.

Ding Ling continuously operated Flying Swallow Technique, Ascending Skill, Cloud-Piercing Step, and various Lightweight Skills, coupled with the fusion of Breathing Technique Vigorous Qi and True Qi, enabling him to erupt and roam anywhere at any time.
Thus, with this smash.
He easily avoided it.
"Kill Kill Kill!"
Li Yuanba saw Ding Ling evading rather than blocking, growing more furious, his eyebrows stood up like blades, swinging the giant hammer, chasing after Ding Ling relentlessly.
Ding Ling utilized Lightweight Skill, maneuvering around Li Yuanba.
His sword occasionally unleashed bursts of Sword Qi, shooting onto Li Yuanba’s body.
Clang!
Clang!
Clang!
The two fought rapidly.
One with an unrivaled giant hammer, its speed exploding, hammer shadows countless, seemingly able to smash the Celestial Palace;

chapters.title: Chapter 348: Aunt
paragraphs: A person with outstanding sword technique, unmatched lightweight skill of the time, roaming the world, with sword light shining brilliantly, the sound of the sword ringing clearly. With one stab, it seems to easily pierce through a giant shield. Countless sword shadows spread across the void, as if they could annihilate all enemies!
The two are evidently both of peak-level strength in the world!
One is a top-level general of innate talent, growing increasingly stronger in a frenzy, often breaking through in battle, truly an unparalleled prodigy.

The other is an ordinary person who acquired divine skill automatic full level cheats, with a profound foundation as solid as a mountain, breaking through in mindset time and again, now wielding countless skills with ease, yet also a top-tier master hard to find in the world!
The battle of two unparalleled masters.
From the very start.
It directly escalated to a boiling point.
Wherever the eye could see, the ground was shattered, trees fell and grass was broken, one facility after another on the square was smashed and destroyed.

The place where the two passed was like a flying waterfall crashing onto the ground, with a thunderous noise, as if it could create a lake on the ground! Even more like a storm passing through, with thunderbolts descending from the sky. Mortal eyes could hardly see the real process of their fight, only a mess left in their wake.
"So powerful."
The players were shocked, watching from afar with telescopes.
For several months now.
In this world, players have already developed telescopes and began selling them to make money.
At this moment, these people were all watching this battle.

"Is Ding Ling really that terrifying?! Even Li Yuanba is being suppressed by him. Li Yuanba, in the Sui and Tang World, is a bug-style character suppressing heroes of all paths, truly an unsolvable anomaly!"
"Yes. And isn’t Ding Ling also an anomaly, a bug-style character among us players? Now looking at it, in the comparison of the two, the players’ side still has the upper hand!"
"Seeing these two anomalies, my self-confidence immediately hits rock bottom! Watching them, I feel like a third-rate cripple!"
’You’re not alone!’
Players were either filled with passion, gossiping, or puzzled.

Those puzzled mostly came from old players of the Three Kingdoms World. Some of these old players had seen Ding Ling’s grand powers in the Three Kingdoms, not feeling he is much stronger now than in the Three Kingdoms, possibly even weaker.
But for the moment, they couldn’t understand the reason behind it.
They could only watch.
Because even the current Ding Ling is a monumental figure beyond their reach! Someone they can only admire!
So it is with the players.
Among the natives, many were also watching the battle.
Among them was a woman sitting on the second floor of a restaurant directly facing the square, wearing a hat, extraordinarily beautiful, and with a graceful demeanor.
Leaning by the window, she was also watching the battle with a telescope.
She seemed to discern something, with a jade-like face showing shocked expressions from time to time.
"What’s wrong, aunt?

Sitting opposite the woman was an elderly man of elegant appearance and very ordinary attire, who was surprised to see this usually expressionless woman changing expressions repeatedly in a short time, and hurriedly asked in a low voice:
"Is something the matter?"
"Yes."
Without taking her telescope down, the woman kept staring at the location of the square, watching the fight.
At this moment, Ding Ling and Li Yuanba’s battle was becoming more and more intense, each move causing chaos in the sky and earth, constantly erupting thunderous booms.
From the woman’s perspective:

She could clearly see Ding Ling’s sword going down, with sword qi condensing into frost, instantly freezing a large hammer several meters away. But Li Yuanba, with a tiger’s roar, forcibly broke through the frozen air, then with a ferocious and grim look, charged towards Ding Ling like a tiger descending the mountain!
Boom boom boom!
The two once again entered intense combat!
"Truly worthy of the man praised by Xiaang Left Envoy and father."
The woman marveled, her voice as crisp as an oriole’s song and very pleasant to listen to:
"His inner strength, even if not unprecedented, is certainly rare in this world!"
"Oh?"
The man opposite took a telescope from a bamboo basket and began watching too, quickly becoming captivated:

"I did not expect Ding Ling to be this strong. By my judgment, even Dongfang Bubai is definitely not a match for him. Every move of his seems to have reached the transformation realm and not just that!

He can easily freeze Li Yuanba several meters away. If not for Li Yuanba being truly bizarre, an ordinary master hit by this frozen attack would probably instantly become an ice sculpture, dying silently!"
"That’s not the main point. Look carefully."
The woman said:
"Ding Ling’s inner strength is extremely peculiar. With every burst, his speed becomes extremely fast, almost like instant teleportation."
"Indeed."
The man seemed to have discovered:
"Not only speed. His strength also suddenly increases tenfold, often forcing Li Yuanba to retreat several meters with a single sword strike."
"Such inner strength is not only present in Ding Ling. It seems Li Yuanba also possesses it."
The woman was extremely curious:

"If we could also master this technique that can instantly unleash ten times the combat power. Dongfang Bubai is definitely not going to be our opponent; we wouldn’t have to painstakingly curry favor with Ding Ling."

"Ding Ling, this child, is unrivaled in the world, hard to find through the ages! With him assisting Sect Leader Ren, uniting Jianghu will surely be smooth! Our previous effort was not in vain. At the very least, we can earn his favor. We just didn’t expect, upon reaching Luoyang City, that Zuo Lengchan would intercept."
"Hehe.
The woman coldly chuckled:
"Zuo Lengchan tried to steal the chicken but lost the rice. Now, even losing his life, he has cleared a major obstacle for us!"
The woman could timely and accurately know what was happening around Ding Ling.
This shows just how many spies she had!
Two hours later.
"It’s about to end."
The woman suddenly said:
"Li Yuanba is about to die."
She sighed:
"Such a capable person is going to die. If he could also be recruited into our Divine Sect. Why worry about our Divine Sect not flourishing?!"
The battle was indeed approaching its conclusion.
This fight.
Lasted over two hours.
It was beyond Ding Ling’s expectations.
Li Yuanba’s stamina and physical quality were terrifically terrifying, almost monstrous!
Ding Ling misestimated earlier, as Li Yuanba not only had power at the world’s peak but also physique, agility, and defense reaching it.
Such high defense was evident from how he could easily break through the frosty air of Ding Ling’s Profound Celestial Finger!
If it weren’t for Ding Ling having various divine skills at full level.
And his lightweight skill surpassing Li Yuanba.
His inner strength far exceeding Li Yuanba’s.
In this prolonged battle.
He would most likely have not won against Li Yuanba.
Because when Li Yuanba went berserk, he was extremely violent, and even when injured, he seemed not to feel pain, maintaining peak fighting capability.
Such a combat genius.
Is extremely rare.
In comparison to him, Lü Bu was instantly crushed!
At this moment, Ding Ling deeply comprehended why among the heroes of the Sui and Tang, Li Yuanba stood out as unparalleled in combat power!

chapters.title: Chapter 349: Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique
paragraphs: This person is definitely a monstrous talent of genius level!
Give him time.
He will definitely develop into a top-notch expert.
But Ding Ling will not allow such an enemy to survive.
Boom!
Ding Ling raised the Giant Que Sword high.
The vigorous qi from the Breathing Technique and the True Qi of Pure Yang True Skill continuously poured into it.
The sword blade vibrated with a resonant hum, and moments later, Ding Ling slashed heavily toward the charging Li Yuanba!
Human Emperor Swordsmanship!
A single sword strike fell.
A vast rush of sword qi seemed to penetrate the sky! With a loud explosion, it transformed into a surging "Sword Sea," directly hitting the giant hammer swung by Li Yuanba!
Boom!
The sword struck the giant hammer, sending it flying at an angle, and even the body of Li Yuanba, who held the hammer tightly, was almost lifted into the air.
Ding Ling took the opportunity to launch at high speed, merging vigorous qi and true qi, swoosh! Instantly reaching Li Yuanba’s side, Moon Shadow Swordsmanship!
A crescent moon swept by.
Poof!
Li Yuanba’s shoulder was completely cut off.
"Ah!"
Li Yuanba screamed miserably, his blood-red eyes seemed to clear somewhat from the excruciating pain, but soon they turned red as blood again due to hatred and anger!
His entire body was broken and battered.
Now even his left arm was severed.
Yet he remained ferociously wild, like a dying beast roaring, gripping the giant hammer with his remaining right hand and smashing it down heavily toward Ding Ling.
This strike.

Seemed to fuse the vigorous qi of the Breathing Technique and the inner power of inner strength, making constant thunderous sounds as if the void would be hammered down, and you could visually see ripples radiating out as this hammer fell.
Ding Ling had no doubt that if this hammer were to hit him, he would be at least half-dead if not completely!
His heart was shaken greatly.
By now.
How is Li Yuanba’s combat power still at its peak?
This man is simply a fighting machine.

Ding Ling didn’t dare to underestimate or slight him in the least; instead, he became even more vigilant, first avoiding its sharpness and then preparing to swing the hammer again, Ding Ling activated the Sword God Skill!
Ching ching ching!
Countless sword petals condensed into a Flowers in Bloom pattern, flashing and disappearing in the void.
Poof!
Directly slicing through Li Yuanba’s other arm. The giant hammer he was preparing to swing fell heavily to the ground with the severed arm.
"Ah!
Li Yuanba let out another heart-wrenching scream, this time his eyes cleared again as he looked at Ding Ling, rage and killing intent filled his eyes:
"Ding Ling. My second brother will avenge me!"
Ding Ling snorted coldly and swung his sword again!
Overlord Saber Technique!
Though it was a sword, it unleashed a brilliant saber light.
Poof!
Li Yuanba’s body was completely cleaved.
This time, he was thoroughly dead.
The fallen remains on the ground still stared at Ding Ling with blood-red eyes as if they wouldn’t rest until Ding Ling was dead.
"This guy is absolutely the toughest, hardest to kill I’ve ever encountered."
His defense was too high.
And the armor on him was extraordinary!
Not until Ding Ling shattered his armor did he start getting injured.
But even so.
It was difficult to kill him for a while.
Only when Ding Ling’s vigorous qi and true qi merged and exploded could he truly be hurt.
Otherwise, regular means were utterly ineffective against him.
His pair of giant hammers swung madly, rendering the air full of fierce and domineering hammer shadows.
An average person couldn’t even block it.
Just seeing this insane-like momentum would weaken one’s own threefold courage first!
"But at least he’s finally dead."
Ding Ling emerged unscathed, having won this battle.
But he didn’t feel any pride or complacency; instead, he fell into deep reflection.
He had been overpowered.
And almost couldn’t defeat a talented, explosive opponent!
If he didn’t have power-ups.
It’s conceivable.
He would definitely be crushed by such a person.
But thinking about how Li Yuanba was a legendary martial artist who crushed an entire era, Ding Ling came to terms with it.
The Three Heroes could still fight Lü Bu.
Who would dare gang up on Li Yuanba? Who could gang up on him?
Now that Li Yuanba died at his hands, the world has lost a legend.
’This Zuo Lengchan tricked Li Yuanba into calling him big brother. And it seems Li Yuanba really treated him like a big brother. I wonder what methods he used.’
Ding Ling took a deep breath.
Success or failure, statesmen.
Zuo Lengchan and Li Yuanba were both dead.
That solved a major threat.
[Achievement Medal Obtained: Intimidate Zuo Lengchan]

[Note: As the Sect Leader of the Mount Songh Sect. Zuo Lengchan was ambitious and grand in ambition! He considered himself intelligent and unrivaled, determined to merge the Five Mountains Sword Sect and then, with their combined strength, become a figure in Jianghu that could shake even Wudang and the Sun and Moon Divine Sect with a single stomp!
However, your presence disrupted his plans.
He was enraged and determined to kill you.
Even as his plans unfolded smoothly. He felt you were doomed.
Yet he could never have calculated that your Breathing Technique’s vigorous qi and true qi fusion would explode with power not less than five times, even ten times your own strength!
He was utterly shocked, injured, and realized he was not your match, and could only release Li Yuanba.
But with Li Yuanba in hand, he too was cut by you.

He died very uncontent, also very frustrated and regretful. If he could be reborn, he would never personally execute the kill-plan against you again rashly. Even if he wanted to kill you, he would send others and strategize from behind the scenes.]
This is the achievement medal obtained when killing Zuo Lengchan.
[Achievement Medal Obtained: You have earned Ren Yingying’s high approval.]

[Note: Ren Yingying witnessed the entire battle between you and Li Yuanba, and no longer doubts your world’s number one strength! And decided, she must find ways to recruit you and capture your heart!]
[Achievement Medal Obtained: You have earned Green Bamboo Elder’s approval]
[Note: Green Bamboo Elder is indifferent to power. But he highly regards Ren Yingying. By gaining Ren Yingying’s favor, naturally, he also began to regard you favorably.]
Another two achievement medals.
There was no achievement medal from Li Yuanba.
It seems that even to his death, Li Yuanba was not convinced by Ding Ling.
Ding Ling didn’t dwell on it.
Those who are gone, are gone.
No need to compete with the dead.
He glanced at Li Yuanba’s corpse, where a corner of what seemed like a secret manual was exposed alongside the remains, and he nudged it with his sword, as expected.
A bloodstained secret manual was flipped into the air.
Ding Ling caught it with a hand, opened it:
Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique!
Ding Ling’s pupils slightly contracted:

"Could it be Li Yuanba’s supreme skill? How did his supreme skill end up in such a secret manual, and judging by the handwriting, it seems quite fresh, was it recently written? Who was he planning to pass the supreme skill to? Zuo Lengchan? On what basis was Zuo Lengchan given such high approval by him?!"
Ding Ling was puzzled.
But this was a good thing.

Ding Ling didn’t dare to underestimate or slight him in the least; instead, he became even more vigilant, first avoiding its sharpness and then preparing to swing the hammer again, Ding Ling activated the Sword God Skill!
Ching ching ching!
Countless sword petals condensed into a Flowers in Bloom pattern, flashing and disappearing in the void.
Poof!
Directly slicing through Li Yuanba’s other arm.
The giant hammer he was preparing to swing fell heavily to the ground with the severed arm.
"Ah!
Li Yuanba let out another heart-wrenching scream, this time his eyes cleared again as he looked at Ding Ling, rage and killing intent filled his eyes:
"Ding Ling.
My second brother will avenge me!"
Ding Ling snorted coldly and swung his sword again!
Overlord Saber Technique!
Though it was a sword, it unleashed a brilliant saber light.
Poof!
Li Yuanba’s body was completely cleaved.
This time, he was thoroughly dead.
The fallen remains on the ground still stared at Ding Ling with blood-red eyes as if they wouldn’t rest until Ding Ling was dead.
"This guy is absolutely the toughest, hardest to kill I’ve ever encountered."
His defense was too high.
And the armor on him was extraordinary!
Not until Ding Ling shattered his armor did he start getting injured.
But even so.
It was difficult to kill him for a while.
Only when Ding Ling’s vigorous qi and true qi merged and exploded could he truly be hurt.
Otherwise, regular means were utterly ineffective against him.
His pair of giant hammers swung madly, rendering the air full of fierce and domineering hammer shadows.
An average person couldn’t even block it.
Just seeing this insane-like momentum would weaken one’s own threefold courage first!
"But at least he’s finally dead."
Ding Ling emerged unscathed, having won this battle.
But he didn’t feel any pride or complacency; instead, he fell into deep reflection.
He had been overpowered.
And almost couldn’t defeat a talented, explosive opponent!
If he didn’t have power-ups.
It’s conceivable.
He would definitely be crushed by such a person.
But thinking about how Li Yuanba was a legendary martial artist who crushed an entire era, Ding Ling came to terms with it.
The Three Heroes could still fight Lü Bu.
Who would dare gang up on Li Yuanba?
Who could gang up on him?
Now that Li Yuanba died at his hands, the world has lost a legend.
’This Zuo Lengchan tricked Li Yuanba into calling him big brother.
And it seems Li Yuanba really treated him like a big brother.
I wonder what methods he used.’
Ding Ling took a deep breath.
Success or failure, statesmen.
Zuo Lengchan and Li Yuanba were both dead.
That solved a major threat.
[Achievement Medal Obtained: Intimidate Zuo Lengchan]
[Note: As the Sect Leader of the Mount Songh Sect.
Zuo Lengchan was ambitious and grand in ambition!

He considered himself intelligent and unrivaled, determined to merge the Five Mountains Sword Sect and then, with their combined strength, become a figure in Jianghu that could shake even Wudang and the Sun and Moon Divine Sect with a single stomp!
However, your presence disrupted his plans.
He was enraged and determined to kill you.
Even as his plans unfolded smoothly.
He felt you were doomed.
Yet he could never have calculated that your Breathing Technique’s vigorous qi and true qi fusion would explode with power not less than five times, even ten times your own strength!
He was utterly shocked, injured, and realized he was not your match, and could only release Li Yuanba.
But with Li Yuanba in hand, he too was cut by you.
He died very uncontent, also very frustrated and regretful.
If he could be reborn, he would never personally execute the kill-plan against you again rashly.
Even if he wanted to kill you, he would send others and strategize from behind the scenes.]
This is the achievement medal obtained when killing Zuo Lengchan.
[Achievement Medal Obtained: You have earned Ren Yingying’s high approval.]
[Note: Ren Yingying witnessed the entire battle between you and Li Yuanba, and no longer doubts your world’s number one strength!
And decided, she must find ways to recruit you and capture your heart!]
[Achievement Medal Obtained: You have earned Green Bamboo Elder’s approval]
[Note: Green Bamboo Elder is indifferent to power.
But he highly regards Ren Yingying.
By gaining Ren Yingying’s favor, naturally, he also began to regard you favorably.]
Another two achievement medals.
There was no achievement medal from Li Yuanba.
It seems that even to his death, Li Yuanba was not convinced by Ding Ling.
Ding Ling didn’t dwell on it.
Those who are gone, are gone.
No need to compete with the dead.
He glanced at Li Yuanba’s corpse, where a corner of what seemed like a secret manual was exposed alongside the remains, and he nudged it with his sword, as expected.
A bloodstained secret manual was flipped into the air.
Ding Ling caught it with a hand, opened it:
Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique!
Ding Ling’s pupils slightly contracted:
"Could it be Li Yuanba’s supreme skill?
How did his supreme skill end up in such a secret manual, and judging by the handwriting, it seems quite fresh, was it recently written?
Who was he planning to pass the supreme skill to?
Zuo Lengchan?
On what basis was Zuo Lengchan given such high approval by him?!"
Ding Ling was puzzled.
But this was a good thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 350: Drumming Golden Hammer
paragraphs: Ding Ling didn’t think too much and instead decided to avoid unnecessary delays.
He immediately began to flip through the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique.
Whirr, whirr!
Ding Ling rapidly scanned through each line, hundreds of lines.
Amidst the rustling sound of turning pages, he quickly finished reading.
A book simultaneously appeared in his sea of consciousness, in the mental library.
In an instant.
[Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique Full Level]
The essence, truths, and mysteries of the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique surged and flowed in his mind.
Soon after, it transformed into an instinct and was etched into every part of Ding Ling’s body, from limbs to organs.
In just a blink, Ding Ling had completely mastered the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique!
"Such a powerful hammer technique!"
After truly mastering it.
Ding Ling finally understood why Li Yuanba swung his hammers so aggressively and unrivaled!
This was the essence of the hammer technique.
Once the great hammer was swung, it was like the thunderbolt of the Nine Heavens striking down to the mortal realm, unstoppable, invincible, overwhelming all under heaven!
"Such a hammer technique, if it can increase the four-dimensional attribute value, might directly boost power by more than 0.4."
Such was the lethal nature of this hammer technique!
Absolutely a top-notch mystic technique rarely found in the world.
Surpassing countless sword techniques and spear techniques.
Among all the sword techniques, spear techniques, and saber techniques Ding Ling had mastered, almost none could compare to this Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique!
Even the Sword God Skill, on which he relied as his trump card, was slightly inferior to the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique.
This seemed like a hammer technique not of the human world.
Not meant for mortals to learn.
After seeing it, Ding Ling only felt its difficulty in training was defying the heavens, a common person wouldn’t even be able to wield several thousand jin hammers through mere physical strength!

Li Yuanba must have mastered the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique to full level, which is why he could skillfully utilize the intricacy of the technique and easily lift the two giant hammers, running with them wildly!
"So even if this Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique was written down and placed here, it would be useless to others even if they got it."
Ding Ling was relieved.
That’s why he could cheat.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t be able to learn this Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique either.
"The Sword God Skill is incomplete. If the Sword God Skill was complete, it might contend with the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique, but now it can only fall a bit behind."
Ding Ling indeed hadn’t expected.
After learning the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique.
His strongest martial skill turned from the sword to the hammer.

"However, the four-dimensional attributes cannot be increased. It’s a bit of a pity; perhaps in the future, when breaking through the void, I can try to bring some secret manuals while ascending. If I can, I might rapidly grow powerful in another world."
But Ding Ling guessed this was impossible.
Because ascension strictly specifies how much can be brought.
Secret manuals are not within the allowable items.
As for memorizing and then bringing them?
Other players could, but for Ding Ling, his Divine Skill automatically reaches full level once memorized. What’s the use of memorizing?
So he could only attempt and let go if it wasn’t possible.
"Tap, tap."
Ding Ling casually tucked the secret manual into his pocket, walked over to Li Yuanba’s corpse, glanced at it, and thought:
"Li Yuanba said his second brother would avenge him. Was he talking about Li Shimin?"
He walked past the body, approached the giant hammer, grasped its handle, and lifted it with a slight pull.
Very heavy.
At least seven to eight hundred jin!
Such a heavy hammer, if smashed down, could collapse a city gate; ordinary first-class experts could only be crushed facing this heavy hammer.
"Is this the Drumming Golden Hammer?"
Ding Ling activated the Breathing Technique, operated the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique, and instantly felt the heavy Drumming Golden Hammer become much lighter.
"This is a hammer highly compatible with the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique!"
Ding Ling was moved:
"This is definitely not a mundane item."
Ding Ling observed that the hammer had almost no scratches, further affirming his thoughts.
This hammer had been clashing with the Giant Que Sword numerous times.
Yet it remained unscathed, not even with a scratch, an absolute top-grade Divine Weapon!
Ding Ling looked at the other hammer.
He walked over, lifted it, also very heavy.
But unlike the previous one, this hammer was dented and cracked all over, seemingly ready to shatter at any moment.
Ding Ling remembered the ascension rules.
"Ordinary ascenders can only bring one weapon, one set of clothing!"
Surely Li Yuanba only brought one Drumming Golden Hammer through the realm barrier.
Ding Ling was relieved.
He casually threw away the tattered giant hammer and, carrying the Drumming Golden Hammer, set off towards the direction of Qu Feiyan and the others’ inn.

"In legends, the Drumming Golden Hammer is recorded as a pair weighing eight hundred jin. And this one Drumming Golden Hammer is perhaps eight hundred jin. Seems that the military generals of the Sui and Tang Dynasty World in the lower realm became stronger and fiercer after the Breathing Techniques and martial arts were disseminated!
"An eight-hundred-jin Drumming Golden Hammer."

Once Ding Ling grasped the Drumming Golden Hammer with his right hand, he found that the full-level Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique was operating on its own within his body, making the Drumming Golden Hammer in his hand ever lighter, like a floating feather, light as can be to smash outward!
"No wonder Li Yuanba could run so fast carrying this hammer. Turns out this is a Divine Weapon specially designed for the Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique."
Ding Ling marveled secretly.
It was his first time seeing such a weapon.
The person who crafted this weapon for Li Yuanba must be a Divine Being!
Ordinary people wouldn’t have this kind of skill.
"I wonder who crafted this weapon for Li Yuanba? If they knew I killed Li Yuanba, would they come seeking revenge?"
"Or is it that the Drumming Golden Hammer wasn’t crafted by anyone, but a historical relic godly weapon, which matched Li Yuanba so perfectly that it came to be possessed by him?"
Exactly what the truth is.
Is unknown.
But since Ding Ling had obtained this Drumming Golden Hammer, there was no possibility of returning it.
Though this hammer was indeed quite large.
Ding Ling shook his head, decided not to worry; such a giant hammer, forged of divine iron, could be melted and remodeled to craft numerous Divine Weapons.
For Ding Ling, there’s no reason to give it up.
Moreover, he couldn’t possibly melt it down.
Tap, tap!
He walked along the way.
Swish, swish!
Passersby along the path avoided him as if they saw a ghost god.
In an instant.
A wide ’avenue of hope’ opened up before Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was speechless.
He glanced at the surrounding people; no one dared to meet his eyes. Those who did either looked panic-stricken, quickly lowered their heads, stepped back a few steps, or had faces full of tension...
Of course, among them, there were those with fanatical faces and eyes gleaming with joy, who raised their hands toward Ding Ling, uttering words that completely mismatched the scene:
"Idol, idol! Can I shake your hand!"
"Idol, I really like you. Is there a chance for us to have a good exchange?"
"Idol. Can I become your apprentice?"
The players included both young and old, men and women.
This battle.
Inspired many young men whose blood boiled with excitement.
